We'll discuss real-world considerations including latency, telephony, evaluation, observability, customization, cost, and operational readiness. Bring your architecture questions and learn from the decisions other teams are making as they move voice agents into production.

Join product leaders and practitioners to discuss where prompt agents, hosted agents and harness-based agents fit, how customers are making architecture decisions today, and what the ideal developer journey looks like tomorrow. Explore migration paths between approaches, lessons learned from real-world deployments, and the challenges customers still face when choosing the right agent model for production.

descriptions.1787854982024001tGxB-1791588133619001CZW: Every infrastructure decision carries tradeoffs between performance, efficiency, scalability, and cost. In this session, discover how Microsoft leverages AMD technology across Azure to support critical database platforms, confidential computing capabilities, and emerging AI workloads. Walk away with practical insights on optimizing your cloud infrastructure today and an understanding of the technologies shaping what's next on Azure.
descriptions.1787854986488001tyGP-1791588176259001CQI: Join Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Blue Yonder to see how organizations can build greater control and flexibility into their AI architecture. Learn how Blue Yonder pairs frontier models on Azure with NVIDIA Nemotron open-source models tailored to its workflows, creating a hybrid approach designed to deliver fast, precise warehouse decisions while optimizing cost and performance.
descriptions.1787856575330001ETra-1791587926182001F4Q: See how Microsoft Agent 365 turns Shadow AI from a blind spot into a Monday morning routine. In this live demonstration, we'll open the Shadow AI page to a named list of unmanaged agents detected across the tenant, map each to devices and users running it, block the riskiest through Intune policy, and sanction legitimate developer tools into the governed Registry, where runtime protection, data security, and access controls take over. Leave ready to run the same triage in your tenant tomorrow.
descriptions.1787856577012001Ed9A-1791588086796001CQR: Follow a real-world journey from establishing spending policies and controls to optimizing AI investments and demonstrating business impact, with a live walkthrough of governance, analytics, forecasting, ROI insights, and experiences for IT admins, business/team leaders, and end users.
descriptions.1787856588133001ES2u-1791588153418001CXh: Partner skilling is often treated as a cost. New data science and SCCM modeling shows it is a growth lever. This theatre session unpacks the quantified relationship between partner capability and revenue, pipeline volume, deal conversion, and operating margin — including which skilling signals predict commercial outperformance. Walk away with the evidence to justify skilling investment and a playbook for converting capability into measurable growth.
descriptions.1787856589863001EnX0-1791588145661001CQE: Not sure where to begin your learning—or what AI Skills Navigator can do for you? Join us for a live exploration of the experience, from playlists and guided sessions to credentials and hands-on practice. With AI-powered capabilities and learning tailored to your needs and goals, whether you’re learning for yourself or supporting others, you’ll leave knowing how AI Skills Navigator is useful, where to find it, and what to try first.
descriptions.1787856599348001EwTg-1791587925210001Ff4: Discover practical retrieval patterns that make agents more useful, grounded, and accurate when working with organizational or domain knowledge.
descriptions.1787856603496001EOOR-1791588069487001CY0: Discover how Home in the Microsoft Copilot app helps you move seamlessly between quick assistance and complex task delegation to get from intent to outcome. Through demos with product experts, see how Home brings Chat and Cowork together in one experience, with new capabilities for creating skills, completing long-running work, and editing Office files. In addition, get a first look at what's next for Home in the Copilot app.
descriptions.1787856605931001EI5K-1791588217922001CW4: Organizations are moving beyond AI experiments and into production. See how customers are using Copilot in SharePoint to modernize knowledge management, organize content at scale, automate business processes, preserve expertise, and strengthen Copilot experiences. Through real-world examples and customer stories, learn practical approaches for turning scattered content into organizational knowledge and transforming knowledge into action across the enterprise.
descriptions.1787856608289001EXor-1791814913161001Cf9: Organizations are moving beyond AI experimentation to transform how work gets done. Microsoft and customers will showcase functional solutions built on Microsoft Copilot that redesign workflows, accelerate decisions, and drive business outcomes across legal, finance and more. Learn how leaders identify high-value opportunities, align AI to strategy, and scale repeatable solutions across teams.
descriptions.1787856608608001EBSP-1791588069088001Cwn: Stop managing work. Start accelerating it. Join this session to see how AI agents can intelligently connect people, data, and applications to move business processes forward with less friction and fewer delays. Explore what the next era of business applications looks like and how it can help your organization make faster decisions, free up valuable resources, and achieve more with every team.
descriptions.1787856609563001Ep0b-1791588070636001Cou: See the complete journey from a developer’s first line of agent code to measurable business impact. Build locally with GitHub and VS Code, deploy to hosted agents, connect governed tools through Toolboxes, and ground agents across enterprise data with Foundry IQ. Then use tracing, evaluation, optimization, and cost and ROI insights to continuously improve quality and economics before publishing agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams.
descriptions.1787856613640001EPcc-1791587921531001Fi0: A keynote-style talk on the biggest recent Copilot Studio features, including the newly upgraded all-in-one platform to build apps, workflows, and agents as well as exciting updates coming in the near future.
descriptions.1787856616924001Efgs-1791588070871001CRT: AI agents are reshaping engineering beyond code generation. Discover how GitHub provides an agent-native system where humans and agents collaborate across defining, delivering, and assessing software. Learn how integrated governance, shared knowledge, and continuous feedback help organizations safely scale agentic development—accelerating delivery while maintaining quality and focus on customer value.
descriptions.1787856617524001EVUv-1791588071811001C0F: Unveiling new features in Microsoft IQ to enable enterprises users to equip agents with the context they need to succeed. See how teams can curate data that bring together knowledge, data, tools, and skills, then publish them for agents across the enterprise. Learn how a shared, governed context can accelerate agent development, improve consistency, and help every agent understand how your organization works.
descriptions.1787856619047001E5dp-1791587924732001F1n: Your next customer may never visit your website. AI assistants and agents increasingly research products, evaluate vendors, and influence buying decisions. Learn how WebIQ powers AI discovery, why some brands get recommended while others are overlooked, and what you can do to improve visibility and trust. Leave with a practical playbook to help your business get found, recommended, and chosen in the AI web.
descriptions.1787856619193001EGTP-1791588121156001CxF: Discover the latest innovations in Work IQ. descriptions.1787856622200001ENO2-1791588069949001CZu: How must security operations evolve when AI can act? Explore Microsoft’s agentic security vision and roadmap and learn how people, AI agents, and trusted controls can work together to accelerate defense across the security lifecycle.
descriptions.1787856624183001EWra-1791588098160001C0a: Learn how to accelerate AI innovation with confidence by securing AI across its lifecycle. descriptions.1787856627080001EXHJ-1791588097251001Cao: Microsoft Copilot is evolving into a platform where apps are built, shared, and run. See how Rayfin enables anyone to create intelligent applications powered by Fabric data, enterprise APIs, and AI models directly within Copilot. Learn how Rayfin provides the runtime, connectivity, governance, and deployment capabilities needed to move from a simple prompt to a production-ready application. Discover how you can use Copilot to build the next generation of business solutions.
descriptions.1787856627862001Esxb-1791588069717001CCx: AI is changing how people interact with data, but trusted answers still depend on shared business meaning. Explore how Power BI and Microsoft Fabric provide a trusted semantic foundation that connects data and business context across analytics and AI experiences. Learn how to create consistent definitions, reuse trusted semantics, and help everyone move from questions to insights and decisions faster.
descriptions.1787856634726001E24O-1791814916437001CEU: Your digital estate is the control point for AI. See how Microsoft Intune unites intelligence, policy, action, and proof to help IT reduce complexity, strengthen trust, and turn ambitious AI pilots into secure, scalable practice.​
descriptions.1787856636240001E6X6-1791587921774001Fl1: Microsoft engineers are building and scaling AI applications and agents on Azure at enterprise scale. Through Customer Zero, get an inside look at the use cases, architectures, operational practices, and governance strategies that power frontier AI workloads across Microsoft. Learn proven approaches for accelerating AI adoption, avoiding common pitfalls, and delivering AI solutions that are secure, reliable, and ready for production.
descriptions.1787856639452001EQey-1791814913867001C2B: Oracle and SAP are among the most critical and complex enterprise workloads. Join us to see how new solutions combine workload intelligence and AIOps to help teams proactively monitor health, identify issues, diagnose root causes, and streamline remediation through a unified view of infrastructure, databases, applications, and cloud resources.
descriptions.1787856641742001EXqJ-1791588100685001CG0: Performance and AI innovation should not come at the expense of compliance and control. descriptions.1787856658187001Etji-1789751959279001dn4: As AI workloads and agents scale in production, infrastructure is more critical than ever. descriptions.1787856914710001heQs-1791588083295001CVJ:
One agent serves 40,000 requests a month and costs 40 dollars. The next serves 9,000 and costs 1,440, which is 85% of the bill. Volume does not predict agent cost. Orchestration does. Agents are stateless, so a loop rereads its whole history and input grows quadratically | ten steps bill 42,500 tokens against a naive 20,000. We derive that math on stage, price it live against public cloud pricing APIs, and find the cascade break even that flips a saving into an overspend. Code included.

descriptions.1787858586194001SCij-1791588096085001Cki: AI tools have the power to transform organizational productivity while exponentially increasing risk. descriptions.1787858586362001SEV8-1791588109445001Cfx: Using AI was supposed to save you time. descriptions.1791389148065001QJMP-1791898611869001MlP: Federal agencies are moving from AI experimentation to operational deployment. descriptions.1792531027428001Dz9v-1792689160460001UUP: Learn how to turn AI innovation into measurable business outcomes at scale. Microsoft shares lessons from its own experience as Customer Zero alongside Frontier customer examples with practical steps on how to apply AI to redesign work, embed agentic workflows, and deliver on your Frontier ambitions.
descriptions.1787856663960001Ewo4-1791588084952001CLg: Work charges a tax: hunting space, guessing the right day, joining from the edge. AI removes it. The workplace knows why you came in and who's there. It reads the space and everyone in it, and adapts to how people actually work. Reach scales without losing the audience. Copilot and agents thread it all together. The result is a workplace that anticipates instead of asks, where collaboration feels seamless and natural, and being in the office is the best seat, not the only one.
descriptions.1787856665826001EdNe-1791588085183001Cwx: As AI becomes more capable, how do you help your employees make the most of it? Explore how employees’ roles evolve as they work alongside AI and agents, from creating work to directing it, and why human skills become even more valuable. Leave with practical ideas for developing your teams’ skills and confidence, beyond teaching them how to use the tools.
descriptions.1787856670675001EzzF-1791588085407001CSV: Learn how to deploy knowledge bases in Foundry IQ for production agents. Compare architectures for indexed and remote sources, design for multitenancy, and choose between serverless and consumption deployments for cost and scale.
descriptions.1787856678670001EYvW-1791588085638001Cry: AI delivers the most value when it shows up where work is already happening: the browser. For IT and Security leaders, the challenge is enabling that value without adding management complexity or compromising organizational requirements. Join this Edge for Business lightning talk to learn how new productivity experiences work alongside controls, compliance, and greater visibility to support AI adoption from day one.
descriptions.1787856680960001EU9s-1791588107382001CMS: After moving a multi-distro Linux estate to Azure, what happens when you put an AI agent in the operator’s seat of a real Linux environment? Can an agent make sense of an unfamiliar system, navigate distribution differences, and help restore the business without overstepping its authority? This fast-paced demonstration explores what agentic Linux operations look like when the environment and the failure are real.
descriptions.1787856689681001ElmI-1791588101833001Cqi: Deploying AI is only the beginning. The big opportunity lies in transforming AI adoption into business outcomes that matter. Learn how organizations are approaching AI adoption with a focus on productivity, operational excellence, and business growth.​
descriptions.1787856690447001EWrG-1791588086317001CxN: AI is transforming software development, but what happens when accessibility isn’t part of the process? This lightning talk explores practical ways to embed accessibility across the development lifecycle, from design-time guidance and code review to automated testing and scanning. AI amplifies the practices and guardrails we already have. Build accessibility in, and AI can scale inclusion. Leave it out, and AI can scale barriers.
descriptions.1790705391561001SCiD-1793034633480001mK2: Build and deploy intelligent AI agents using NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint and Nemotron with Microsoft Foundry, Azure Container Apps, and Azure AI Search. In this hands-on lab, you'll create an agent for enterprise deep research that combines AI reasoning, multimodal data extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation to synthesize data into actionable insights. Learn how to connect data sources and run inference at scale—then apply these patterns to your own production workflows.
descriptions.1787856575177001Eg2u-1791587925940001Fz7: AI workforce transformation starts with understanding your people and the work they do. Discover how people and organizational context in Work IQ personalizes Copilot experiences with trusted answers, while helping leaders identify opportunities and redesign workflows so teams are AI-ready. Learn how organizations can move beyond AI adoption and accelerate workforce transformation with actionable insights grounded in real work.
descriptions.1787856578535001ECBr-1791588094638001CDz: Most organizations won't jump from copilots to autonomous defense overnight. Learn how security teams are progressing from AI-assisted workflows to agentic security, and the trust, governance, and platform foundations required along the way. We'll share lessons from early Project Perception adopters and provide a practical framework to assess readiness and build a roadmap toward scalable autonomous defense.
descriptions.1787856580022001El3j-1791588087248001CNO: Go beyond copilots and build agents that can act on real business processes. Take a technical deep dive into Dynamics 365 ERP MCP, ERP apps for Cowork, and Copilot Studio. Learn how to connect agents to finance and operations data, workflows, and actions while maintaining enterprise security and governance. Leave with practical architecture patterns and development techniques you can apply immediately.
descriptions.1787856588770001EAz8-1791588108760001CQR: Trust is foundational as organizations move AI into production and expand it across teams, workflows, and business processes. Hear lessons from leaders who are scaling AI across their businesses while strengthening governance, accountability, and confidence in AI-powered experiences.​
descriptions.1787856589392001Eptt-1791814915062001CVo: What separates organizations that create value with AI from those that struggle to move beyond experimentation? Hear customer insights on tailoring AI learning to different roles, embedding learning into everyday work, and building cultures that sustain adoption over time.
descriptions.1787856594216001EjZ4-1791588088168001CIe: How do you rethink project portfolio management after 20 years of doing it the same way? Join Microsoft MVP Peter Kestenholz and learn how Context& used AI, Power Platform and Dataverse to replace traditional dashboards with AI-driven insights and build a fully interactive what-if scenario engine. Real-world lessons from serving 100+ global enterprises and accelerating innovation through AI-assisted development and user experience.
descriptions.1787858586817001SgTE-1791588109673001CKD: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.
descriptions.1787858591169001SUm7-1791588165357001CFA: Rackspace and Rubrik explore business resiliency beyond backup, starting with identity. See how to sequence recovery across Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, Microsoft 365 data, and Azure infrastructure. Learn about immutable backups, rapid restoration, air-gapped protection, and the importance of a tested recovery runbook. Leave with a practical model for restoring identity, access, data, and infrastructure in the right order.
descriptions.1787856665982001E5Nj-1791588089096001CTS: Watch GitHub Copilot open an app reproduce a bug collect evidence update the code and confirm the fix in a browser. See how sandboxes permissions tests and human review keep the agent focused and make the result easy to trust.
descriptions.1787856672664001Ezzq-1791588089323001CbE: Fifteen minutes, five controls. See the Zero Trust for AI guidance practitioners apply first across identity, data, endpoints and SecOps, how to baseline where you stand, and what to fix before your agents go live.
descriptions.1787856676206001EzuD-1791588089551001CG3: What if 'all or nothing' just worked across your whole database? In 15 minutes, go deep on ACID-compliant distributed transactions in Azure Cosmos DB: atomic multi-item writes across partitions and containers, serializable isolation, and automatic rollback when anything fails. We'll live-code the classic move-money-and-place-order scenario, look at how two-phase commit works under the hood, and cover where it fits today. If you've been hand-rolling consistency, this one's for you.
descriptions.1787856683760001EtBz-1791588115849001C7g: Azure Monitor health models combine monitoring signals with application architecture, dependencies, and business context to provide continuous insight into workload health. Discover how this structured context empowers AI agents to investigate incidents, trace cascading failures identify potential root causes, recommend remediation and automate operational workflows, moving towards more intelligent and autonomous operations.
descriptions.1787856688452001E4lE-1791588256917001CRn: Microsoft offers a wide range of go-to-market benefits, tools, programs and opportunities to help CSP channel partners grow. But knowing what’s available and where to start isn’t always easy. In this lightning session, discover GTM Titan, a foundational learning path designed to help you navigate Microsoft GTM, connect your business priorities to the right opportunities, and identify what to activate next.
descriptions.1787856691890001EghO-1791933307746001Jox: Dynamics 365 Contact Center represents one of the fastest-growing opportunities in the Microsoft ecosystem, but where do partners start? This session provides a practical roadmap for building a successful practice, covering skills development, certifications, solution positioning, sales motions, AI capabilities, and implementation readiness. Learn how to identify opportunities, create customer value, and build a scalable business around Microsoft's AI-powered customer engagement platform.
descriptions.1787856692370001EF2V-1791933310065001kpg: See what GitHub Copilot can do when given real Azure architecture and security requirements. descriptions.1791389467091001losl-1791898588340001anh: Domain-specific AI depends on more than a model. Teams need to bring enterprise data close to compute, support demanding training workflows, and deploy inference services that can scale. Join Microsoft, NVIDIA, and NetApp to discuss how these pieces fit together on Azure, compare approaches and trade-offs, and share what you're learning as you move enterprise AI into production.
descriptions.1787856590804001E89B-1791814915758001C4m: The Microsoft Pro Badge just dropped. Learn what it means, how to get it, why it matters for getting noticed, and why you should be in the early adopters.
descriptions.1787856599653001ERae-1791588248175001CsA: Join Microsoft women leaders for an inspiring panel discussion on navigating careers, driving innovation, and shaping the future of AI, cloud, security, and technology. Stay after the session for a community happy hour to connect with peers, expand your network, and continue the conversation.
descriptions.1787858586508001SUb8-1791588122064001CVa: What if IT could understand not just what broke, but why? TeamViewer and Microsoft show how Tia takes agentic IT beyond the endpoint. Work IQ explains what changed, Fabric IQ defines what should be, and Tia brings those signals together to diagnose and remediate issues with approval. Through an MCP-native integration, Microsoft 365 Copilot calls on Tia as a specialist agent, enabling faster, smarter, context-aware IT operations at scale.
descriptions.1787858587109001SxCN-1791588122526001CjU: Learn how to take a user question or instruction, retrieve relevant information from your company’s datasets, and provide it to the model at generation time. Walk away knowing how to create a search pipeline using a combination of Cohere search models.
descriptions.1787854985876001tT18-1791588339892001ChG: Discover how the NVIDIA full-stack accelerated computing platform on Microsoft Azure can transform demanding AI, data science, and simulation workloads. Learn how the powerful combination of Azure cloud infrastructure and NVIDIA GPUs, software, and services can improve performance, scale efficiently, and accelerate the journey from experimentation to production through practical approaches and use cases.
descriptions.1787856609892001EgHv-1791588100232001CFk: In a world of abundant models, winning means continuously adapting to customer context—not just choosing the best model. The hill-climbing machine connects inference, observability, evaluations, optimization, model selection, post-training, and RL into one learning loop. Every interaction improves quality, cost, and reliability, turning AI into a governed, self-improving business platform.
descriptions.1787856614099001Ef93-1791588270465001C7C: Build a new feature while agents investigate issues, add tests, and prepare other changes for review. Keep track of what's running, step in where needed, and validate the results, so you can take on more without losing control of what ships.
descriptions.1787856614835001EeAx-1791588099981001CAI: What do you build when the answer is “anything”? We'll take you on a fast, fun tour of Windows, GitHub, OSS and all the fun new shiny things. Expect big ideas, surprises, and a parade of demos showing what happens when powerful tools meet relentless curiosity. Come for the awesome. Leave with new possibilities and an urge to build something.
descriptions.1787856615427001E5OT-1791588325140001CU1: Benchmarks alone can’t predict how a model will perform in a real product. Follow Microsoft AI’s journey building a model for coding and agentic software development, with GitHub Copilot as its proving ground. Explore how model design, training, real-world workflows, and product signals shape iteration across quality, latency, cost, and control—and leave with practical lessons for building specialized production models.
descriptions.1787856622650001EwCX-1791588268695001CKD: Zero Trust principles are the design; secure foundations are the build. Walk the four evidence-based controls across identity, devices, endpoints and email, see the attack paths each closes, and scale AI across your organization.
descriptions.1787856624332001E4L2-1791588172254001Cfj: AI agent risk is not static. As agents gain new permissions, access additional data, use new tools, and take autonomous actions, their risk profile can change over time. Learn how Microsoft helps security teams continuously understand, investigate, and respond to evolving risk across their AI agent ecosystem.
descriptions.1787856626174001EOEX-1791588129625001C4T: As AI transforms how organizations work, Power BI is evolving from business intelligence to decision intelligence. Join us to explore how Power BI helps organizations turn insights into action with AI, trusted business context, and enterprise-scale analytics powered by Microsoft Fabric. Get a first look at upcoming innovations, including new application experiences in Power BI Desktop and semantic views that extend business context across your data estate.
descriptions.1787856627685001EqFG-1791588154353001CFZ: Discover Microsoft Fabric HorizonDB, a Fabric-native PostgreSQL experience that helps developers build operational applications on a unified platform for transactions, analytics, and AI. Learn how HorizonDB enables applications to query operational and analytical data through a single PostgreSQL experience, reducing data movement and ETL complexity while delivering real-time insights. Build AI-ready applications faster with built-in governance and seamless access to OneLake-scale analytics.
descriptions.1787856631787001EYot-1791588232300001C1O: Every seller and service rep knows the cost of CRM tax. See how Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and AI agents help reduce manual work and improve customer experiences. Explore the latest innovations, customer stories, and Microsoft's vision for bringing CRM into the flow of work.
descriptions.1787856631949001EQzf-1791588350490001C50: Microsoft Power Platform reimagines what's possible for makers and developers. Join this session for a guided tour of the latest innovations across Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Pages. See how AI is reshaping how solutions are built, deployed, and managed at scale and how low-code and agentic development unite in the most adopted AI-augmented low-code platform.
descriptions.1787856635039001EPGT-1791588097705001CXC: Most organizations have proven AI can work. The challenge is moving from experimentation to secure, scalable operations. See how Windows helps organizations govern agents, put intelligence to work across devices and Cloud PCs, embed AI into everyday workflows, and move from pilot to practice through new innovations and a featured customer conversation.
descriptions.1787856637610001E284-1791587922010001F67: AI has raised the bar on velocity, and enterprises need an application platform that ships fast without giving up operations, management or enterprise readiness. See how Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps and Azure Functions now form an agentic application platform, with secure isolation for agent code, native connections to enterprise systems, event driven scale and built in governance. Customer examples show it running in production today. Leave knowing where applications go next.
descriptions.1787856640049001EoQy-1791588100457001Ctm: Does digital sovereignty require a local cloud provider? Is disconnected always more secure? Does data residency alone address sovereignty requirements? Join Microsoft experts as we separate fact from fiction and examine the real-world tradeoffs behind sovereignty, AI governance, resilience, data protection, and cloud operations. Through practical examples and customer scenarios, you'll gain a framework for evaluating requirements and making informed cloud and AI decisions.
descriptions.1787856642196001E70E-1791588100918001CIY: AI, cloud-native applications, and business-critical workloads are changing how organizations think about storage. In this session, get up to speed on the latest Azure Storage innovations across object, file, block, and data movement solutions. Learn how new capabilities are helping organizations improve performance, strengthen resiliency, simplify operations, optimize costs, and build AI-ready data foundations.
descriptions.1787856643249001EdAR-1791588097028001C4n: Brown University Health is moving from AI-assisted documentation to agentic workflows across clinical and operational settings. Learn how Dragon Copilot helps clinicians reduce documentation burden and stay focused on patients, while AI agents built with Copilot Studio surface hospital guidance, connect care teams with specialists, and streamline operations. Hear practical lessons for embedding trusted AI into existing workflows and scaling innovation across a health system.
descriptions.1787856643699001E1i2-1791588337854001CPN: Disconnected systems, manual processes, and fragmented workflows can slow healthcare operations and make it harder to advance priorities such as patient safety. Hear how Intermountain Health is approaching this challenge and how workflow orchestration and Microsoft technologies can help organizations operate more efficiently, support better decisions, and advance meaningful outcomes with security, privacy, and governance in place.
descriptions.1787856646604001EsgZ-1791588099082001C48: AI is creating unprecedented opportunities for partners, but success requires more than innovative solutions. It requires managing the economics behind AI. In this session, Microsoft leaders and industry experts share a practical FinOps framework for AI to help partners anticipate and govern costs, optimize token consumption, and build repeatable, profitable services. Hear real-world partner examples and leave with actionable guidance to turn AI cost management into a competitive advantage.​
descriptions.1787856646751001Eyi3-1791588216115001CsD: Agents are reshaping the software development lifecycle, helping partners accelerate time to market and create new opportunities to educate and enable customers through managed services. Learn how to build and scale a high-growth practice that enables organizations to ship agents and software at speed and at scale, with the quality, security, and control to trust everything they release. Explore delivery models, skills, go-to-market strategies, and IP creation approaches.​
descriptions.1787856649029001EggS-1791588099760001Cps: In July we launched Agentify Your Business Processes, unifying the agentic vision for Business Applications and demonstrating how AI can transform every business process. Join us to explore how partners are evolving their practices, differentiating in the market, and positioning for growth, along with the Microsoft resources and programs available to support their success.​
descriptions.1787856653441001EC65-1791588334917001Cj1: Government AI moves faster when the right partner is in the room. Join a state transportation leader on stage with Microsoft. Hear it in their words: what they set out to achieve, what they needed from a partner, and what it changed. Partners will leave with a clear view of where they add value in government.​
descriptions.1787856654144001EJMs-1791588097480001CnD: Microsoft has learned firsthand that deploying AI isn't the same as transforming with it. Drawing on Microsoft's Customer Zero journey, Katy George shares the lessons and recipes helping Microsoft redesign work, build new capabilities, measure impact, and scale what works. Leave with a practical playbook for applying those lessons to your own AI transformation.
descriptions.1787856666895001E0LE-1791588106923001CFC: In this lightning session, learn how to build one agent plugin and use it across VS Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and GitHub Copilot App. See how portable plugins bring reusable skills and MCP integrations to each environment while still feeling native. descriptions.1787856673903001Ejbx-1791588103695001Crd: As AI makes credentials more valuable to attackers, trust must be built deeper into the platform. Learn how silicon-based credential protection helps prevent device impersonation and creates a stronger foundation for trusted AI agents, devices, and services.
descriptions.1787856681731001EKPb-1791588101607001CTF: How do you know your architecture is well designed? The result is faster design, greater consistency, and reusable enterprise knowledge at scale.
descriptions.1787856694832001E4Pp-1791933346363001ab8: Security Copilot is reaching more teams, but successful adoption takes more than turning it on. In this demo-led session, follow a practical blueprint to activate the right experiences, measure real usage and SCU consumption, and decide when and how to scale. See how prompts, embedded experiences, and agents fit together, and leave with a repeatable approach for growing Security Copilot without losing visibility or control.
descriptions.1787856704930001EnN5-1791588102286001Cvl: Learn how to make agent building with Copilot Studio approachable through practical examples, community Q&A, and real-world scenarios that connect agentic AI concepts to everyday work for everyone!
descriptions.1787856574691001EA7h-1791587925448001FVZ: As AI usage expands across users, agents, and workloads, organizations need confidence in cost planning. Learn practical strategies for forecasting, cost governance, consumption insights, and building greater visibility, predictability, and control.
descriptions.1787856594371001ENmu-1791588095543001CYG: Exposing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enterprise production introduces massive scalability and security hurdles. Drawing from real-world FastTrack deployments, we will dissect advanced multi-tenant routing, stateless load balancing, and prompt-injection mitigation. Learn how to securely scale AI data pipelines without compromising corporate data boundaries.

See a practical identity resilience workflow in action, from incident to remediation.
descriptions.1787858587557001SRoh-1791588110129001C6V: There's no single right speed for moving to the cloud. Explore how to modernize desktop delivery today, using AVD Hybrid as a bridge or Windows Cloud as the destination, and build the path that fits where you are now.
descriptions.1787856662254001E3LU-1791588084721001Cbq: Learn practical approaches to visibility, governance, forecasting, optimization, and flexible purchasing that help organizations accelerate AI adoption while keeping investments aligned to business outcomes.
descriptions.1787856669537001EYPh-1791588101383001Cff: Most enterprise agents can search. The real opportunity is agents that act. See how Work IQ, MCP servers, and enterprise connectors extend agents into ERP, CRM, ITSM, and other business systems where work actually happens. Learn how to create reusable business skills that connect systems, automate actions, and can be shared across copilots and agents throughout your organization.
descriptions.1787856688605001EkUR-1791588257133001CMr: Microsoft offers a wide range of go-to-market benefits, tools, programs and opportunities to help CSP channel partners grow. We'll cover the key steps, roles, and experiences that make identity setup simple and secure, and share a look at what's coming next for ALDO.

descriptions.1790705177215001bKjW-1791818206961001iuO: Get hands-on with local AI model fine-tuning in this beginner-to-intermediate, instructor-led workshop. Using Unsloth on an AMD Ryzen AI Strix Halo laptop, you'll prepare a dataset, format prompts, and work through the fine-tuning pipeline step by step, with no cloud required. Pick up practical tips from industry experts, then put your newly fine-tuned model to the test in a short challenge, all running locally on your machine.
descriptions.1790705299182001YkwU-1791818497814001oxt: An always-on agent is only worth having if you can trust it with real work. In this hands-on lab, you'll build an agent on an AMD Ryzen™ AI PC and define what it can access and do. Use Lemonade Server to keep model calls local across the NPU and GPU, and Microsoft MXC to run the agent in a sandbox with policies you control. You'll use a synthetic dataset and simulated environment to build and experiment with a fun productivity use case.
descriptions.1787856657745001EewR-1789751958676001dVT:
AI is changing how people work and how organizations build new business capabilities. Join Jacob Andreou, Executive Vice President, Copilot, to explore how Copilot brings asking, delegating, building, and scaling together, and how Windows extends that experience across the PC. Learn how Teams connects people, agents, and business processes across functions, and how new FinOps capabilities help organizations manage and scale Copilot with confidence. See what becomes possible when AI is built into the flow of work, from the individual to the organization.
Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.
descriptions.1787856665348001EcwB-1791588106661001CvJ: Learn to build an AI Customer Support Agent with Microsoft Foundry to triage requests, coordinate specialized agents, analyze diagnostic data, and draft customer updates. Explore hosted agents, routines, and tools to create long-running workflows that help teams manage cases from intake to resolution, with human oversight. Ideal for AI developers, support engineers, and solution architects.
descriptions.1787856676657001EQBS-1791588107157001CHm: Validate recovery before an outage becomes the test. Watch a controlled PostgreSQL failure exercise and trace how backup, restore, immutability, geo-redundancy, and retention choices affect recovery objectives. Leave with a resilience-testing pattern your team can adapt today with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
descriptions.1787856692677001EeNv-1791933315501001MR3:
Most Azure Landing Zone guardrail policies ship as Audit, not Deny | that's safe for rollout because nothing blocks deployment. Over time, that default causes environments to drift: Audit reports violations but doesn't stop them, and once go-live pressure fades, few teams tighten it.
This session explains how to decide which controls need Deny from day one versus which stay Audit, using real governance patterns: a framework for deciding before go-live, not after a finding.
descriptions.1787856694220001Evhy-1791933351807001WMO: You've spent years building semantic models ù but Fabric IQ Ontology asks for something different: entities, relationships, rules, and data bindings that ground AI agents in what your business actually means, not just what your tables contain. In 15 minutes, see a live before/after ù a hand-built lineage layer versus what ontology gives natively ù and get a straight answer to "do I need this yet?"
descriptions.1787856694373001EiWA-1791933328180001bPK: Enterprise agents often know the data but miss its meaning. I will build a Fabric IQ ontology over operational and analytical data, connect it to a Microsoft Foundry agent through the Fabric IQ MCP tool, and test questions that require relationships, rules, and business vocabulary - not keyword matching. You will see where ontology improves an agent, where a semantic model is enough, and how to introduce a governed context layer without rebuilding the data estate.
descriptions.1787856704463001Ez9S-1791588125351001Cr9: Building a larger AI community takes more than great speakers and good events. I’ll share lessons from helping grow the Global AI Community Dallas chapter, covering what worked, what didn’t, and practical approaches to increasing attendance, membership, partnerships, and long-term engagement.
descriptions.1787856708334001EYdE-1791588108308001CBL: Cloud-native applications often become tied to a specific runtime, making workloads difficult to move without significant rework. Radius, an open-source application platform from Azure Incubations, separates application intent from infrastructure. In this live demo, well deploy one application across AKS and ACI using the same definition and no code changes, showing how platform teams can support multiple Azure runtimes while preserving a consistent developer experience.
descriptions.1787856578683001ERhF-1791587926432001FYl: Most organizations with Microsoft 365 E5 own more security capability than they use. See how E5 already helps you stop attacks, control access, protect data, and reduce risk, all within the same license. Then, discover what’s new with ISOC and expanded SIEM capabilities and see them in action in a live demo. Leave with a clearer view of your E5 security capabilities and three concrete steps to get more from what you already own.
descriptions.1787856578828001ERR0-1791588087023001CpZ: AI agents need access to apps, data, and resources, but should they get a blank check? See how Microsoft Entra Agent ID helps secure agent connections, limit risky permissions, and apply network controls to reduce risk and block compromised access before it becomes an attack path.
descriptions.1787856580175001EjSE-1791588087475001C7H: AI is moving beyond individual productivity to take on work across the business processes that run your organization. What does that mean for your business applications and architecture? Join this session to see demos of how Copilot Cowork with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and ERP plugins can connect how people work with how your business operates—and what it takes to enable agentic business processes with the governance and controls your organization requires.
descriptions.1787856580477001Ewun-1791588094863001CSv: See Aion Instruct and Windows AI APIs in action. Learn how to add on-device language and vision capabilities to Windows apps using practical APIs, patterns, and tools for responsive AI experiences on Windows.
descriptions.1787856587819001EZ5S-1791588135280001Ceu: Customers are moving beyond AI pilots. They want trusted, production-ready solutions they can buy now. descriptions.1787856591737001Ewwa-1791588258906001C3w: A profile tells you what someone says they know. What if it could also show what they’ve proven they can do? Learn how Microsoft verified proficiency, everyday work in GitHub Copilot, and LinkedIn Connected Apps turn learning and real work into trusted talent signals: proof people can carry with them, that hirers can see, and that connects skills to opportunity.
descriptions.1787856593753001EIiI-1791588259123001CTG: Inclusive Design is not a checklist. It’s a product development approach that helps teams build experiences that work better for more people. In this demo-driven session, learn how Inclusive Design can be applied across the product lifecycle to identify unmet needs, uncover innovation opportunities, and improve AI-powered experiences. Through real-world examples and live demos, explore practical techniques for product strategy, research, design, and development.
descriptions.1787856593905001EnZP-1791588181822001C4j: Many organizations have moved beyond experimenting with AI, and turning pilots into measurable business impact remains a challenge. Walk away with practical strategies for transforming AI from a promising technology into a daily productivity engine.
descriptions.1787856594825001EWii-1791588109215001CiD: Organizations are rapidly deploying Copilot agents, but many lack the governance needed to scale securely. Leave with actionable guidance for preventing agent sprawl, protecting sensitive data, and enabling innovation while maintaining control.

descriptions.1787856678061001E50o-1791588114941001C6T: Get started with Foundry Local on Windows. This lightning talk shows how to find, run, and integrate local AI models into your apps, enabling faster experiences, reduced cloud dependency, and greater control over data.
descriptions.1787856679280001EUw0-1791588292224001COE: Discover how Windows 365 AI operations use AI and agents to simplify Cloud PC management. Predict issues, automate routine tasks, recommend changes, summarize insights, and help IT troubleshoot through AI-powered operations.
descriptions.1787856680052001E3z2-1791588115394001Cvu: Azure uses AI agents to transform 10,000 to 15,000 monthly feedback reports into prioritized insights and actionable engineering work. See how the Great Experiences Matter initiative connects fragmented signals, human judgment, engineering action, and outcome measurement in a continuous learning loop, reducing manual synthesis time by more than 95%. Learn practical patterns for building auditable, human-guided agentic workflows that improve with every cycle.
descriptions.1787856681114001EjQl-1791588085862001Cgk: Learn what’s new in Azure Linux 4.0, Microsoft’s Linux distribution built for Azure workloads. Explore its Azure integration, security-focused design, modern package ecosystem, and streamlined experience across virtual machines, containers, and Kubernetes. See how Azure Linux 4.0 provides a consistent, supported foundation for organizations building modern and AI-enabled applications on Azure.
descriptions.1787856703841001ELpP-1791588116297001CwG: Explore lessons from leading a global AI community, including how to scale programming, support local leaders, and create an inclusive experience across regions.
descriptions.1787856705251001ERYT-1791588125582001CXy: Explore how MVPs introduce WebIQ with relatable examples that show how web knowledge, research, and discovery can support better technical decision-making.
descriptions.1787856706633001ETjc-1791588108070001CTT: Generative AI can help users chat with data, but how do you set it up for enterprise data and ensure the answers are accurate? In this demo you'll see how AI can accelerate the creation of a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent from an existing semantic model. Then we'll take it a step further by automatically generating and maintaining a ground truth dataset used to validate responses, improve trust, detect drift and measure agent quality at scale.
descriptions.1787856603644001EiOR-1791588098392001CZY: What if AI could keep work moving without the next prompt? Explore how Autopilot works against goals, events, and signals to monitor what matters, surface risks and opportunities, and take proactive action with enterprise controls and human oversight. Through demos and real-world scenarios, learn where always-on automation fits, which use cases are ready, and how to prepare for adoption.
descriptions.1787856604402001Ec2D-1791588173232001Cx8: Discover how Copilot in OneNote helps turn your notes into action and your collection of information into instant answers and insights. Copilot is unlocking AI-powered work in OneNote and beyond. Join to see demos of the refreshed OneNote app and experiences that help you reason over all types of notes and take action to support your workflows.
descriptions.1787856607657001ESZB-1791588172728001CvQ: Most organizations know their goals; the hard part is finding the right path, resources, and investments to scale. Learn how to close that gap across everyday work, team productivity, and business processes. Discover Microsoft offerings and benefits aligned to your priorities, use cases, and maturity stage.
descriptions.1787856615279001E134-1791588324909001CfQ: Merge your code with confidence after Copilot reviews it. Learn how Copilot pulls context from the right places to conduct informed reviews, and how it can be tailored to your team's coding standards. We'll show how we built 3 review effort levels, each backed by an ensemble of agents and tuned to different cost and quality preferences. Finally, learn how we built confidence in Copilot's ability to approve pull requests. You'll leave knowing how to make Copilot code review work for you.
descriptions.1787856617222001EdSN-1791814918968001CFE: What if engineering systems could learn from what teams have already solved? The GitHub platform holds knowledge across code, pull requests, reviews, and AI agent activity. Bringing these signals together can reveal what's happening, why, and what should change next. We'll show how patterns across teams can identify affected repos, shape a shared plan, and guide coding agents under human review—with real results from Microsoft and customers showing how organizations can learn and act at scale.
descriptions.1787856618127001Eh8M-1791588130096001C7D: The market is moving from app-specific RAG to shared context layers to give many agents secure access to trusted enterprise knowledge. We'll explore how Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search) improves grounding across the stack: from core search innovations and knowledge graphs to purpose-built models that make agentic retrieval faster, higher quality, and easier to configure. We'll also show how Foundry IQ fits into Microsoft IQ, enabling people and agents with easier knowledge discovery and consumption.
descriptions.1787856621535001EDYg-1791588118834001CkK: Accelerate vulnerability discovery with multi-model agentic security. Codename MDASH orchestrates specialized AI agents and security-focused AI models to identify, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities, helping teams understand risk and focus on the issues that matter most.
descriptions.1787856628329001EEBg-1791951573069001Nul: Growing data estates create fragmented tools, limited visibility, and operational complexity that slows innovation. See how database hub in Fabric and database agents work with the tools your teams already use—SSMS and the MSSQL extension for VS Code—to surface the issues that matter, explain the likely cause, recommend a fix, and act with your approval. Come away with practical ways to reduce risk, cut operational overhead, and boost productivity, no matter where your data lives.
descriptions.1787856629419001E4Pf-1791588117679001C18: Build AI applications grounded in operational data without assembling a fragmented data stack. descriptions.1787856580930001Erqc-1791588176748001Cbg: Security and IT teams face growing pressure to patch devices quickly in order to reduce exposure while maintaining business continuity. descriptions.1787856598413001Exz7-1791588134591001CWa: AI agents are quickly moving from experimentation to enterprise deployment, but most organizations lack a governance model to manage them at scale. Learn how leading enterprises are governing agent lifecycles, ownership, permissions, security, compliance, and business value using Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI. descriptions.1787858588435001SOwl-1791588110609001Ctz: AI is only as effective as the data, architecture, and domain expertise behind it. descriptions.1787858588582001SAMi-1791588123468001Clu: Enterprises face a catch-22: modernize for AI, yet maintain control of your intelligence. Concierto breaks the bind. Dual-engine architecture combines deterministic rules with private inference. Concierto delivers versatility, protecting and growing your intelligence solely for your company’s benefit.
descriptions.1787854981813001tiyc-1791588133385001Cs1: Organizations often evaluate productivity tools, developer platforms, devices, and security solutions separately, but greater business impact happens when they work together. descriptions.1787854982135001twbi-1791588271585001C9W: AI builders need choice, from simple open-model deployment to greater control for inference and training. descriptions.1787854982474001t9tR-1791588158189001CUU: See an AI technician resolve incidents end to end by taking real actions across Windows endpoints and servers, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, mainframes, and networks. descriptions.1787854983310001tpL4-1791588158659001Ces: Discover how Hitachi Rail and Microsoft are transforming rail operations through HMAX, using real-time data from more than 2,500 trains and critical infrastructure assets to predict failures, optimize maintenance, and improve reliability. See how Hitachi and Microsoft bring together industry expertise, operational technology, and AI to create intelligent solutions across mobility, energy, infrastructure, and the industries that power modern society.
descriptions.1787856604099001E2sI-1791588098623001Ceg: Real work changes when AI moves beyond chat to handle repeatable tasks and workflows. In this expert-led breakout, see how organizations use Copilot Cowork to delegate complex, multi-step work across apps, files, and business systems. Product demos and expert guidance will show where Cowork creates value, what to consider for implementation, and how to accelerate adoption.
descriptions.1787856604549001Ehho-1791588119062001CBh: Collaboration has always been conversation, and the gap between deciding and doing is where time and momentum quietly disappear. See how Microsoft Teams, Copilot, and agents close it. Agents join your meetings, chats, and channels as teammates you @mention and assign work to, grounded in your context by Work IQ and governed by Agent 365. Learn from specific scenarios where coordination becomes built in, moving your team from fragmented work to coordinated execution.
descriptions.1787856609242001EnzD-1791588157003001CYm: AI success depends on more than the model. Learn how Frontier Tuning helps organizations optimize models, tools, skills, knowledge, and evaluation frameworks to improve performance on real business workflows. See how Copilot Studio and Foundry work together to deliver better outcomes, higher quality, and improved cost efficiency at scale.
descriptions.1787856609732001EXxL-1791588156764001CGm: Most AI agents tackle a single task. descriptions.1787856610796001ElME-1791588120928001CdY: As Microsoft deploys AI across products used by hundreds of millions of people, trust has become an operational imperative. Learn practical lessons in risk-based governance, embedded guardrails, continuous monitoring, and scalable controls that enable trusted AI at scale.
descriptions.1787856613341001ExL3-1791588120437001CBB: Discover how Copilot Studio brings apps and agents together on one governed platform for business transformation. descriptions.1787856637312001EsdU-1791588336733001CAm: As Kubernetes deployments expand across regions, public cloud, virtualized and bare-metal environments, and sovereign clouds, operational complexity grows. descriptions.1787856653985001Eij3-1791588154589001Cjx: As AI capabilities expand, human judgment, creativity, domain expertise, and leadership become more valuable, not less. descriptions.1787856597956001EOxm-1792715062319001joI: Every business unit wants its own agent, and most platforms give each one its own identity, tool access and blind spots. This session traces a production multi-domain architecture end to end: one governed entry at the Azure API Management AI gateway, per-domain agents with scoped Entra Agent IDs, brokered tool access through governed MCP with content safety on tool-call arguments, and Foundry Control Plane across the fleet, all in the customer's own tenant.
descriptions.1787858588728001SSsa-1791588123705001Clf: As AI transforms the workplace, organizations need secure, resilient ways to deliver applications, desktops, and data across cloud and hybrid environments. Join Shawn Bass (Citrix) and Igal Figlin (Microsoft) to explore how Citrix Platform Flex and Microsoft Azure are advancing application delivery, security, performance, and operational efficiency. Learn how the partnership is evolving to support AI-ready workspaces and the future of enterprise digital work.
descriptions.1787858589042001SQWA-1791588096799001Clo: Build cyber resilience across data, identity, and AI as one Microsoft estate. As Copilot and AI agents read, write, and act across enterprise data, traditional human review can’t operate at the same speed. descriptions.1787856668788001EFoj-1791588162187001Cas: The future is not a single agent but ecosystems of agents, tools and skills. Learn how reusable toolboxes, skills platforms, MCP integrations and agent orchestration can accelerate development while improving maintainability. Explore emerging patterns for composing capabilities once and enabling their reuse across teams, projects and business processes.
descriptions.1787856672831001EVYE-1791588162422001CxB: Modern applications rely on containers. descriptions.1787856675283001EZqR-1791588162676001CpP: See how dbt and Microsoft Fabric help analytics engineers build trusted, AI-ready data products at enterprise scale. The key point here is to share field lessons learned that help architects choose the right approach.
descriptions.1787856582756001EPqp-1791588164886001Coy: eSIM has transformed connectivity across phones, wearables, vehicles, and IoT, creating new demands for scale and resilience. We'll explore the multi-region architecture, security model, and deployment approach that accelerated multi-market expansion.
descriptions.1787856587507001EwPo-1791588353875001CXh: Building an impressive agent is now straightforward. Repeating, governing, and scaling it across customers is where the work begins. In this live demonstration, see how organizations can eliminate costly data copying, staging, and migration while accelerating AI workloads, improving GPU utilization, and bringing compute directly to their data.
descriptions.1787858593079001Snio-1791588229785001C9U: Explore how modern SaaS data protection can extend Microsoft 365 and Azure to support backup, recovery, and archiving while optimizing storage and cost. Microsoft and CrashPlan experts will demonstrate an Azure-based approach to rapid recovery, space-saving archiving, eDiscovery, and anomaly detection. See how organizations can protect and preserve critical data while managing data growth and costs.
descriptions.1787858594275001SnEg-1791588300833001Cmq: When an Azure incident fires, an SRE Agent starts from zero, even if root cause was found elsewhere. See how Elastic Nightshift’s detection engine exposes live, cited investigations to Azure SRE Agent via a connector to ground its answers. Explore the architecture, triage, root cause, and governed remediation, and see a live Azure Monitor alert route into Nightshift. Learn how to pair Azure’s agentic platform with Elastic’s investigation engine.
descriptions.1790726705581001TBjS-1791898390719001M2g: Microsoft partners are being asked to help customers become Frontier Firms, but transformation is never achieved through technology alone. In this small group discussion, partners share real journeys and work through how leadership, organizational change, experimentation and peer learning turn AI ambition into outcomes. Through IAMCP's global community, the group explores how shared experience helps partners transform their organizations, strengthen customer guidance and avoid common pitfalls.
descriptions.1787854981920001tfCF-1791588271357001CSw: Cyber resilience starts long before an incident occurs. Join Jeremy Nelson, CISO at Insight, to explore how leading organizations are shifting from a response-first mindset to a readiness-first strategy. Learn how greater visibility across assets, identities, and software, risk-based patching, managed SOC services, and well-defined response plans can help your organization reduce risk, accelerate recovery, and create the resilience needed to thrive in today's evolving threat landscape.
descriptions.1787854982582001trpE-1791588272046001C4H: Employees lose time daily to IT friction. For years, the answer was more efficient ticketing: detect, flag, suggest, and route faster. But what happens when AI agents eliminate the ticket altogether? See how AI agents autonomously resolve incidents end to end within the tools your team already uses, giving employees their time back; and what that shift means for IT teams when issues no longer require a technician in the loop.
descriptions.1787854982894001tEoN-1791588219541001CBf: Selling Microsoft solutions brings opportunity and complexity. Discover how ArrowSphere and AI agents can simplify the sales journey, helping you identify opportunities, access the right insights, and accelerate customer conversations. See how distribution can evolve beyond transactions into an intelligent sales engine that reduces complexity, improves seller productivity, and helps turn Microsoft opportunities into revenue.
descriptions.1787854984059001tl2k-1791588311661001CaT: How do you move agentic AI from pilot to production at enterprise scale? Join Cognizant and Premera Blue Cross to learn how they modernized claims operations for more than 2 million members using AI-powered automation and custom processing agents. Discover how a phased three-year rollout is increasing automation, improving operational efficiency, and creating a scalable foundation for AI-driven healthcare operations.
descriptions.1787854984803001tDfb-1791588221578001CQK: No enterprise runs on one system, and neither should your AI. Learn how SAP and Microsoft deliver AI interoperability across business processes, data, and workflows. Explore Autonomous Domains, Joule Agents and Joule Assistants, Joule Work, and the bidirectional integration between Joule and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Walk away with a better understanding of how connected AI experiences can work across enterprise systems.
descriptions.1787854985011001tbAl-1791956570360001OrS: Scaling AI is one challenge. Realizing value from it across the enterprise is another. Join Accenture and Avanade for a candid discussion on scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 740,000 employees globally. Hear Anthony Leraris, Accenture CIO, and Ben Beath, Chief AI Officer, Avanade, share critical lessons on governance, adoption, and value realization, and learn how leading organizations can move beyond productivity gains to achieve frontier transformation.
descriptions.1787854989502001tslL-1791588203462001C0F: Some AI answers require a higher level of confidence, particularly when regulatory, financial, safety, or reputational considerations are involved. In this conversational lightning talk, getAbstract shares four checks for the answers that matter most: curated sources, current knowledge, clear attribution, and human verification. Learn how a verified knowledge layer can strengthen AI responses for higher-stakes scenarios and help you apply these checks to your own Copilot and AI agent use cases.
descriptions.1787856605173001E6Pi-1791588198567001CV7: Autopilot keeps work moving, taking action across apps, data, and devices without constant direction. But how do you secure work that continues when you're away? Learn how to protect Autopilot's access and actions, safeguard sensitive data even when AI is misled, and contain activity across computers, apps, and networks. Because when AI works independently, security can't be an afterthought.
descriptions.1787856611240001E5kl-1791588219313001COj: Getting an agent into production is only the beginning. Learn how Microsoft Foundry helps teams observe agent behavior, evaluate quality, uncover unexpected issues, and optimize performance over time. Through practical guidance, demos, and a customer story from Tata Consultancy Services, explore how tracing, evaluations, insights, human feedback, and optimization come together in a repeatable continuous improvement loop. You’ll also see how to monitor quality, reliability, latency, safety, and cost across your agent fleet.
descriptions.1787856613195001Eigo-1791588173931001C2o: When should you not build using the GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio? Come learn about how factors like the business process, its complexity, user experience, and cost influence which harness you would want to build your agent with. Leave the session knowing how to match the right harness to the job, while building agents that are fit for their intended purpose.
descriptions.1787856615129001ELFm-1791588322657001CZr: In this session, we'll open up the GitHub Copilot SDK harness and trace how context, tools, models, and execution fit together. Learn to add custom tools and MCP servers, intercept prompts and tool calls with hooks, and scope specialized agents to the context and permissions they need. See where Microsoft Entra, Purview, and Defender apply identity, data, and threat controls throughout the harness. You’ll leave with starter templates and the confidence to begin testing your own ideas safely.
descriptions.1787856619943001EJJ0-1791588352762001C3G: Every grounding call is a trade-off. The highest-quality answer isn’t always the right one — sometimes your agent needs speed, sometimes freshness, sometimes precision at any cost. This session breaks down the quality-latency-cost frontier behind agent retrieval with Web IQ: when to let auto routing decide, when to orchestrate yourself, and how to design grounding strategies that hold up in production. Leave with a decision framework for any agent you’re building.
descriptions.1787856621701001E9Ma-1791588172987001CrW: Explore the real-time architectural breakdown of what happens when agentic AI hits production IT environments. Together, Forrester principal analyst Allie Mellen and two Microsoft executives will tear down a modern SOC architecture live on stage—mapping out where agents safely automate outcomes, where non-deterministic AI breaks IT change controls, and how to design guardrails that CISOs and IT Directors can actually trust.
descriptions.1787856628953001E5nm-1791814920587001CYw: AI apps and multi-agent systems need operational data, memory, state, and retrieval to work together. Learn how to design these patterns with Azure Cosmos DB through real-world use cases and customer examples. See how full-text, vector, hybrid, semantic, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval can ground agents in current application data, while Azure Cosmos DB supports conversation history, memory, personalization, and global production scale.
descriptions.1787856629261001EJny-1791588196937001CxB: AI applications are evolving beyond chat and copilots into systems that reason, retrieve context, maintain memory, and take action. These workloads demand a database that can unify transactional, vector, analytical, and agentic workloads without sacrificing scale, performance, or governance. Learn how Azure SQL Hyperscale provides the foundation for building production-ready AI applications with the scale and resilience required for the agentic era.
descriptions.1787856630362001EPk2-1791588197416001COd: What happens when CRM stops tracking work and starts doing it? Welcome to agentic CRM. Discover how headless Dynamics 365 Sales, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and AI agents transform CRM from a system of record into a system of action. Learn how organizations reduce administrative burden, automate sales processes, and equip every seller with an AI-powered sales team. Explore Microsoft’s vision for Dynamics 365 Sales in the flow of work, where people and agents collaborate to drive revenue growth.
descriptions.1787856632736001EDzS-1791588285068001CR2: As AI agents move into production, enterprises need governance and a trusted execution layer. See how Windows provides the environment while Intune, Entra, Defender, and Purview discover, secure, and audit agents at scale without slowing innovation.
descriptions.1787856639748001EzEE-1791588218408001C2O: What happens when the unexpected occurs? Join us to explore real-world incident learnings, the platform investments driving greater resilience, and the established reliability practices and resiliency principles that help customers prepare for, respond to, and recover from force majeure events with confidence.
descriptions.1787856640202001EbGn-1791588234328001CsH: Compute efficiency has become a first-order design constraint for modern workloads, and gains no longer come from silicon alone. Join us for an inside look on how Cobalt 200 is engineered end-to-end from silicon through systems to deliver exceptional price-performance compute on Azure. Learn more about the Cobalt roadmap, what's new in Cobalt 200 virtual machines (VMs), and hear how Azure customers are translating the performance gains in Cobalt 200 into greater business value.
descriptions.1787856641427001EIEu-1791588175102001CcC: Every enterprise is discovering how running agents in production is a platform problem, not a model problem. Agents need secure isolation, identity, governance, observability and cost control before anyone trusts them. This session defines how Azure Container Apps enables you to deliver an agentic platform with production-ready defaults, microVM isolation and governance. Learn how Copilot Studio and Foundry Agent Service leverage this architecture and how you can implement it in your enterprise.
descriptions.1787856645522001ESfS-1791588217467001Ctz: Manufacturing intelligence lives in people, data, and operating systems. See how Azure connects that context with artificial intelligence (AI) agents across edge and cloud. Explore the architecture behind Physical AI for factory operations, with insights from Unilever on existing environments, exception management, and human oversight.
descriptions.1787856646898001EgZT-1791588099308001CLU: Learn how Microsoft partners are scaling agentic AI practice on Microsoft’s Agent Platform with Microsoft IQ. Explore proven go-to-market tools, managed services opportunities, and delivery models that can deepen customer relationships and position you as a strategic partner driving Frontier Transformation. Hear Microsoft sales leaders share lessons learned, winning sales motions, and practical insights from real-world deployments.​
descriptions.1787856652949001EyRo-1791588219770001CNS: Telecommunications is entering its most consequential shift in a generation - from static infrastructure to autonomous, AI-native operations. Explore the customer challenges and proven use cases driving this shift, and hear how Microsoft partners are helping operators put this into practice with trust and security at the core - equipping you with a playbook to scale your IP and services and build your Frontier telco practice in FY27.
descriptions.1787856656393001E9aq-1791588132914001C2R: Go deep on how LSEG can turn your financial data into trusted, finance-native intelligence. The session should unpack the data foundation, semantic/ontology layer, permission-aware retrieval, grounding, citations, and workflow integration required to move from a finance-native question to an answer professionals can trust and act on.
descriptions.1787856584119001EX6C-1791588181355001CZR: Bosch and Microsoft are taking AI from the workplace to the vehicle with an AI-powered cockpit that combines automotive expertise and Microsoft AI. A custom-trained SLM delivers low-latency, context-aware experiences, voice, memory, and vehicle functions across offline and online scenarios. Microsoft AI adds cloud intelligence, orchestration, APIs, and governance. See how Bosch is building the journey from AI assistant to AI-powered companion.
descriptions.1787856588460001EOWa-1791588214252001CxI: AI transformation isn’t only for organizations with large IT teams. Hear how growing businesses are adopting AI, reimagining how work gets done, and building the skills and operating practices needed to move from AI experimentation toward practical business outcomes. Through real-world examples, explore how lean teams are putting AI into practice and building a foundation to scale responsibly.​
descriptions.1787856665039001EkYi-1791588230473001C0G: Build supervised or reinforcement fine-tuning workflows with Microsoft Foundry's serverless interactive training API. Control sampling, training steps, and checkpointing with your own loss functions, rewards, rollout logic, data, and hyperparameters. Foundry manages the GPUs while you control how models learn. Go from Python code to a customized model artifact with self-service, pay-as-you-go post-training, without securing GPU quota or managing a fleet.
descriptions.1787856680204001EJpr-1791588204409001CRU: Azure Networking is using AI agents as digital coworkers to help engineers investigate issues, reduce operational toil, and accelerate remediation. Learn how Microsoft evolved from AI-assisted experiences to agentic workflows that perform meaningful operational tasks, keep engineers in control, and improve service reliability at scale. Take away practical lessons for introducing digital coworkers into engineering operations.
descriptions.1787856694984001EwjY-1791933733256001kHr: Your employees are already using AI, whether or not IT approved it. The risk isn't AI itself, it's what happens when someone shares sensitive enterprise information with no visibility or control. In this session, we walk through a real scenario and how to protect it: an employee shares sensitive data with a third-party AI tool. You'll leave knowing how to stand up DSPM policies that protect data without slowing your teams down across third-party AI apps and agents.
descriptions.1787856695133001E8tJ-1791933737159001MBQ: In addition to a SIEM, which is reactive, every shop needs insight into misconfiguration issues and compliance risks in the cloud--a logical extension of Zero Trust policies. Learn how the multi-cloud features of Defender for Cloud integrated with Defender XDR continuously monitors cloud infrastructure including DevOps platforms for gaps in security policy enforcement across all clouds and all platforms. Leverage agentless vulnerability scanning, secrets scanning, and Security Copilot plug-ins.
descriptions.1787858601106001SogJ-1791588318158001CMg: AI agents are expanding the attack surface, while manual security struggles to keep pace. Explore how organizations can build resilience by hardening infrastructure and enforcing Zero Trust principles across agents, endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and data centers. See how identity, segmentation, vulnerability shielding, and AI-assisted response can help teams limit exposure, govern agent actions, and respond at machine speed with human expertise guiding decisions.
descriptions.1791392966349001uLwg-1791934059499001p8m: AI coding assistants deliver powerful results, but every token comes at a cost. Experience NVIDIA SwitchYard, an AI router that connects tools such as Cursor and Codex to Microsoft Foundry and local models. See real examples of routing configurations designed to optimize token usage and lower AI costs.
descriptions.1791504878686001iREP-1791926621756001pHF: An energy services company with tens of thousands of field workers wanted to do AI. You cannot hand an agent to everyone on day one. Microsoft's Frontier Firm puts people and agents side by side, and people come first: map people, processes, and goals before picking a tool, then route each piece of work to an agent, a workflow, a process change, or leave it with people. Kori Hale of CultureBanx moderates a conversation with Ludia's Lucas Diaz and Danielle Estrada on a real engagement.

Explore where AI should automate and people differentiate. Discuss how organizations balance efficiency with experience, automation with human connection, and personalization with empathy. Compare real-world strategies for using AI in routine interactions while empowering people to handle complex, emotional, and high-stakes moments. Share how you balance humans and AI to build loyalty, improve employee experience and business outcomes, and deliver consistent “wow” experiences.

See how Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork, Work IQ, and Power Platform come together to create a single intelligent experience for getting work done. Learn how Work IQ grounds agents in business context and how existing apps can plug directly into Copilot and Cowork to drive productivity and automation. Live demos included.
descriptions.1787856579719001EEoe-1791845862597001MYy: Database work still slows delivery. Schema changes, query tuning, and drift pull developers out of flow and into ticket queues. In a live demo, watch an agent carry a feature request from schema change to working query with your approval at each step.

In this session you’ll discover how Duke Health improved resilience and strengthened security with Microsoft Defender - resulting in reduced downtime risk and lowered costs, while enabling future AI readiness.
descriptions.1787856591256001Etjz-1791814919653001C2R: Technology alone doesn't drive AI transformation, people do. Learn how Microsoft Training Services Partners help customers translate newly acquired AI skills into measurable business impact. Through a customer success story, see how organizations move from learning concepts to implementing AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, streamline operations, and deliver tangible results.
descriptions.1787856597624001EJQn-1791588228866001Cau: What happens when the endpoint at risk is a Windows 365 Cloud PC? In this demo-led session, watch a healthy Cloud PC encounter a simulated threat and follow the resulting Defender risk, Intune compliance, and Entra Conditional Access signals. YouÆll see how Cloud PCs fit into a Zero Trust security model and leave with a practical pattern for detecting, containing, and recovering cloud-hosted Windows endpoints.

See how Seismic Aura's AI agents surface approved content, ground responses, and drive consistent execution in the flow of work. Learn how to move GTM teams from preparation to performance, turning AI into action and revenue impact.

See how Wipro, with Everpure and Rubrik, approaches data protection, cyber resilience, and seamless data mobility to help organizations manage data across complex cloud environments.
