descriptions.1787856692981001EbT8-1791588224070001CA5: Learn five keys to successfully adopting AI at work, in a financially responsible way, pulled from my experience deploying Copilot Basic, Copilot Premium, and Copilot Cowork at a non-profit, non-partisan research institute.
descriptions.1787856702919001EsBo-1791588142196001COt:
Some of the biggest career opportunities begin with surprisingly small decisions—attending a meetup, answering a question, submitting a session, finding a mentor, or simply saying yes.
Real stories about the unexpected places community can take you.
descriptions.1787856706784001ErHb-1791588223614001C2M: AI agents are getting remarkably good at building software. Now imagine if they could put that software online, too. In this lightning talk, see how an AI coding agent can build and publish a complete Rayfin app without requiring an account, then hand it off to a person who can bring the app and its data into Microsoft Fabric. It’s a glimpse at a future where the path from idea to working enterprise app starts with an agent and takes seconds, not setup.
descriptions.1787856708487001Ena1-1791588179615001CCx: Agents are only as capable as the tools you hand them, and hand-writing tool integrations is the slowest part of building one. Fast, live, and designed to spark the question of what the same approach would unlock across your own systems.

Along the way, you'll see how better-organized knowledge helps strengthen Copilot experiences across Microsoft 365. Leave with practical techniques you can apply immediately to build a modern, AI-powered knowledge workspace.

descriptions.1790705089430001luN0-1791911931366001pMr: In this lab, you'll build a single endpoint for multiple models on AMD Instinct™ GPUs and use vLLM Semantic Router to match each request to the right model. Route simple tasks to smaller models and complex work to larger ones to save tokens and compute, while keeping sensitive requests on trusted local models. Connect an agent, explore routing decisions, and put your skills to the test by building your own router in a short challenge.
descriptions.1790705227843001lkKT-1791912092586001WOa: Utilize open-weight models from Microsoft Foundry on AMD GPUs to build a team of AI agents. Start with one OpenClaw agent, explore the files that give it memory and behavior, and use it to find a bug in a live Python environment. Then build a team of specialists working in parallel, with a coordinator that delegates tasks to resolve the bug. Finish with a challenge to add a new agent and tackle a new problem. Beginner friendly, with no prior agent experience required.
descriptions.1787856603799001ERbS-1791588070407001CFZ: Work is full of ideas that could improve a process, simplify a task, or solve a problem, but turning those ideas into working software has traditionally required coding expertise, specialized tools, or an engineering backlog. Join Copilot product leaders for a look at Copilot Code, a new coding experience in Microsoft Copilot. Through live demos, see how people can turn natural language into working dashboards, apps, automations, and other custom tools grounded in their work.
descriptions.1787856605482001EkbC-1791588233878001Cuo: Move from experimentation to AI agent adoption at scale. In this session, explore how Microsoft Agent 365, the control plane for agents, can help your organization operate and scale agents with confidence by providing comprehensive visibility, built-in governance, and enterprise-grade security across your AI ecosystem. See what's new with Agent 365 and learn how to accelerate agent adoption while maintaining trust, meeting compliance requirements, and keeping operational control.
descriptions.1787856607181001E7wq-1791588199028001CBT: What does AI transformation look like in the realities of an enterprise? Hear from Microsoft’s customer-facing teams on what organizations are experiencing as they put Copilot and AI to work. Explore the questions, challenges, and tradeoffs around trust, governance, adoption, readiness, and value, and learn how Microsoft works with customers to address them and move forward with confidence.
descriptions.1787856608929001E4Ws-1791588218162001Csh: Getting value from agents takes more than deployment. Learn how to help users discover, trust, and use agents in Microsoft 365. See practical approaches for identifying the right use cases, guiding everyday workflows, and driving adoption so teams can get more value from Copilot and agents.
descriptions.1787856611387001ESPE-1791588234779001CWC: Frontier models are available to everyone. Your advantage is how you train them for your business. See how Microsoft Foundry unites fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and RL environments to turn production data and agent experience into continuous model improvement. Explore managed and programmed training, and how task feedback boosts agent performance and token efficiency. Hear how PayPal and Heidi Health customized open models with Fireworks on Foundry.
descriptions.1787856612754001EwNc-1791588132209001Cdt: Learn how to build Copilot Studio agents that behave like teammates for recurring business processes. See how agent accounts, triggers, business process memory, and agent refinements help agents work as their own entity, act proactively, retain process context, and continuously improve to facilitate recurring business processes - while the makers stay in control. See how these agents benefit from additional capabilities like app UIs in agents and computer use too.
descriptions.1787856614396001ENAG-1791588288203001CJ3: What if core technology modernization that once took 2 days could happen in just 45 minutes? Bradesco is putting agentic AI to work across 5,126 services, building on the AI foundation behind 600+ initiatives serving 74 million customers. With Azure AI Foundry and GitHub Copilot, teams are transforming how they assess, plan, and modernize services while maintaining architecture, security, and quality gates. Join Bradesco and Microsoft to see agentic AI in action across the engineering lifecycle.
descriptions.1787856619636001E66J-1791588325591001CbD: Our agents can only reason over what they can retrieve. Classic RAG answers fact lookups but misses themes, trends, and relationships that live across a whole corpus. Get an early look at what's next in Foundry IQ: retrieval that clusters content into topics, graph structures that turn documents into entities and relationships, and a Microsoft-hosted agentic retriever you don't supply model capacity for. Live demos, before-and-after quality, and where enterprise context is headed.
descriptions.1787856620403001EBkn-1791814922891001CYx: AI is entering a new era where agents reason, collaborate, and take action across business systems. As intelligence becomes more autonomous, trust becomes the critical infrastructure that enables innovation to scale. Join Sarah and Mohammad to explore Microsoft's vision for the next generation of Trustworthy AI: from policy and oversight to security, transparency, and accountability. Learn how organizations can confidently unlock the promise of agentic AI while staying in control.
descriptions.1787856625393001EoiU-1791588198339001ClL: Learn how to build secure, enterprise-ready AI agents without slowing developer productivity. We'll explore how to secure agents by design, use Agent 365 to govern and secure them at enterprise scale, and protect them in production. Bring consistent security and governance across a heterogenous environment of agents, platforms, and ecosystems. Discover an end-to-end approach to protecting AI from development through runtime.
descriptions.1787856626014001EdXu-1791814914336001Cbg: Secure AI starts with understanding your data. Discover how Microsoft Purview uses AI-powered classification and sensitivity labels to identify sensitive content, automate protection, and help organizations confidently scale Copilot adoption.
descriptions.1787856626323001EznF-1791588232979001CUX: Fabric Data Warehouse is an AI-native warehouse built for high-performance analytics. Learn how its open, SaaS-first architecture on OneLake combines enterprise scale, reliability, and predictable performance with innovations like GPU acceleration and built-in AI experiences to simplify your analytics architecture and power demanding analytics and AI workloads.
descriptions.1787856626625001E368-1791588350713001CAz: Managing data and AI at scale requires a platform that balances agility with control. In this session, we'll explore the latest investments across development workflows, automation, observability, governance, security, and cost management. Learn how organizations can build, deploy, and operate modern data and AI solutions while maintaining reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.
descriptions.1787856628019001EiXI-1791588232759001CPK: Modern AI apps and agents demand low latency, scale-out architecture, enterprise resiliency, and native AI capabilities. See how Azure HorizonDB supports mission-critical applications in the AI era, and how Azure Managed Redis cuts the cost and latency of repeated retrieval and model work through semantic caching and close-at-hand context and memory. Compare hits and misses across response time, database load, and token use. Leave with guidance on cache selection, thresholds, and invalidation.
descriptions.1787856634108001EZjL-1791588267330001Cac: As AI and agents rapidly reshape how work gets done, organizations need a flexible computing foundation that can adapt quickly. Windows 365 delivers an AI-ready foundation for desktop computing that is simple to manage and scale, where agents can work securely just like people do. From like-local experiences for Cloud PC users to new ways of running agents securely to a new AI-powered admin experience, see the latest Windows 365 innovations.​
descriptions.1787856635794001EvWl-1791588234103001CJ6: Mainframe modernization is not one-size-fits-all. Bringing together Microsoft Frontier Company and expertise from across Microsoft’s partner ecosystem, this session outlines how to assess the estate and decide what to retain, replatform, refactor, or retire. Explore how phased execution, cloud-native architecture, and modern engineering practices on Azure can reduce risk and technical debt, preserve critical business logic, and create a foundation for continuous innovation and AI transformation.
descriptions.1787856639900001E6cl-1791588218637001CGL: Organizations are adopting AI and modernizing critical systems while facing increasing requirements for operational control, resilience, and continuity. Learn how our Sovereign Private Cloud combines Azure Local, Microsoft 365 Local, GitHub Enterprise Local, and sovereign AI capabilities to support mission-critical workloads across connected, hybrid, and disconnected environments. See real architectures, deployment models, and demos that help you maintain control without sacrificing innovation.
descriptions.1787856640975001Eumd-1791588234558001Co4: To modernize on Azure, resilience must be built into the fabric of cloud environments across compute, storage, networking, and apps. Use Azure to move from reactive recovery to proactive resilience by identifying critical dependencies, validating recovery readiness, and architecting for failure. Learn practical approaches and discover the innovations for building resilient apps and infrastructure that can adapt, recover, and operate during disruptions, improving confidence and reducing risk.
descriptions.1787856644766001Efm0-1791588233427001CPO: Move beyond supply chain visibility to agentic action and intelligence. Explore Microsoft’s vision for agentic supply chains, emerging opportunities, and practical examples to accelerate your journey. Go inside Microsoft’s cloud supply chain to see AI in action across planning, logistics and operations. Learn how AI-forward architectures and human-in-the-loop workflows drive faster decisions, improve efficiency and deliver measurable business value, with resources to support your transformation.
descriptions.1787856650067001Eood-1791588231852001Cuk: AI is reshaping how enterprises operate, innovate and create value, opening a huge opportunity for partners to lead the next wave of transformation. In this session, we’ll explore why building solutions, services and practice capabilities on the Microsoft AI platform is critical to helping customers become Frontier organizations, with trust, intelligence and model choice at the foundation. Learn how we can accelerate AI sales and adoption together turning the AI opportunity into shared success.​
descriptions.1787856650829001EdIT-1791588174401001CWc: Support is no longer a cost center—it's a growth engine. Unified for Partners shifts you from reactive, partner-led support to a scalable, AI-ready model that drives retention, adoption, and expansion, with pricing that rewards performance and quality.​
descriptions.1787856650977001EsUx-1791588232072001CbY: Microsoft Marketplace is how we go-to-market and co-sell with partners. Get the playbook for aligning your business to Marketplace to drive growth—whether you build software or deliver cloud services. Learn about new investments and capabilities that turn customer demand into pipeline, with real-world insights from partners putting them into practice.​
descriptions.1787856652501001El2p-1791588235473001C6d: Discover how manufacturing partners use a case-led GTM strategy and Microsoft Marketplace to expand reach and accelerate growth. Explore opportunities across digital engineering, factory operations, and frontline workforce productivity while aligning solutions to customer priorities. Hear from Sight Machine and Microsoft on proven approaches to customer engagement, solution differentiation, and Marketplace success. Leave with practical ideas to sharpen your GTM strategy and drive growth.​
descriptions.1787856661746001ELN7-1791588236141001CHp: The Copilot experience is evolving, bringing together new ways to work across Home, Code and Autopilot. In this lightning session, IT Administrators and AI Champions will learn how to prepare their organization, help users navigate what’s new, and support the journey from discovery and first use to repeat usage and sustained adoption.
descriptions.1787856692062001EVMA-1791933761562001byi: Real-time voice agents are generally available in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. The demo always works. Production is harder. I build one live: barge-in, DTMF fallback, mid-call language switching, and deterministic handling for identity checks. Then I break it and show the escalation that carries full context to a human rep. You leave with a latency budget, the guardrails that matter, and the three failures that hit every deployment.
descriptions.1787856693289001ErHb-1791588236588001CwW: Copilot Chat answers questions. Cowork does work. But most users treat Cowork like a bigger chat window and miss the point. I'll demo the daily use cases where delegating beats prompting: multi-step tasks, working across many files, and the review patterns that make hand-offs safe. Plus the decision that matters most: when to chat, when to cowork. Live demos, minimal slides. You'll leave with use cases your users can try the same afternoon.
descriptions.1787856695434001Ear9-1791933764924001Mgt: Everybody's talking about AI, but many of the best productivity features are already sitting on your Windows device waiting to be used. Join this fun, demo-packed session where we'll explore Copilot on Windows, voice, Recall, Windows 365 integrations, and other hidden gems that will save time, help you work smarter and have a better day with your Windows device. No technical deep dives - just intelligent work at your fingertips.
descriptions.1787856706935001E9Hv-1791588237046001CB7: As organizations accelerate AI adoption, trusted data has become the foundation for innovation. Join this lightning talk to discover how the OneLake Catalog reimagines data governance with a unified experience for data discovery, governance, and protection for your data estate. Learn how organizations can empower users to find trusted data faster, govern at scale with insights and recommended actions, and build an AI-ready data estate.
descriptions.1790726559414001fCaD-1791934066790001Wyz: AI may catalyse Frontier Transformation, but the real challenge begins after the technology works. Drawing on partner journeys, this session explores the leadership, culture, skills and change practices that turn experimentation into lasting outcomes. See how transforming their own work builds customer credibility and how IAMCP's connect, learn and grow community model helps peers share experience, avoid repeated mistakes, accelerate adoption and move from AI activity to business impact.
descriptions.1792115387008001rDRs-1792436748191001DiU: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.
descriptions.1787856577935001EMGH-1791588161480001CIB: See how Fabric IQ can help teams create governed business context once and reuse it across analytics, copilots, and custom agents. This session shows how shared concepts, relationships, and rules can reduce duplicated grounding work, improve consistency, and help organizations prepare for broader AI adoption across domains with ontologies in Fabric IQ.
descriptions.1787856583650001EggL-1791588181122001CDH: Subsurface decisions carry the most risk and the biggest prize, and both start with accessible, governed data. Learn how Azure Data Manager for Energy connects seismic, well, and reservoir data with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, and Snowflake, while enabling advanced analytics, AI, and reservoir modeling at scale. Discover how organizations turn complex energy data into intelligence that powers analytics, copilots, and agents, accelerating decisions and reducing uncertainty.
descriptions.1787856592677001Eu4q-1791588313010001C6k: An IT Pro and a business pro trade perspectives on the real cost of running AI. In 25 minutes, see how token spend, model choice, and workload placement translate into budget lines — and how each side can stop surprising the other.
descriptions.1787856595452001ENDX-1791588228643001Cyi: How do you build an AI-ready data platform when your estate spans Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks? This session examines a real enterprise architecture using medallion layers, Azure Data Lake Storage, Apache Iceberg, catalog federation, identity, and governed agent access. Learn the interoperability decisions, performance traps, and cost trade-offs that appear when multiple platform engines must operate as one trusted Data and AI ecosystem.
descriptions.1787856596396001Eu0n-1791588214717001CmM: AI initiatives struggle to scale when platforms unify where data lives, but not what it means. Disconnected tables leave agents without business context. This session shows how a German wholesaler built a unified intelligence foundation with Fabric IQ. We deconstruct designing an Ontology over existing semantic models and OneLake data. Learn how this layer fuels Data Agents and Microsoft 365 Copilot with factual context, connects business meaning, and avoids schema-centric design pitfalls.
descriptions.1787858591752001SE9f-1791588088633001CiM: Every hop between an agent and a GPU can expose a prompt, and agent loops repeat that exposure with every plan, tool call and retry. For regulated data, strategy or source code, that's a dealbreaker. Richard Rizk, Co-Founder and CTO of BLACKBOX AI, shows how prompts can be sealed on the client and decrypted only inside an attested GPU enclave, taking the proxy, host and operator out of the trust equation.
descriptions.1787858592493001SCP1-1791588207644001CdI: Microsoft AVD and Windows 365 adoption is accelerating, but migration complexity, costs, and ongoing operations can slow progress. See how Liquidware helped three enterprise customers deliver applications, profiles, and a consistent user experience across AVD, Windows 365, and physical PCs. Learn how to resolve issues faster, connect experience and cost insights, and get a first look at new ways to simplify AVD management and optimization.
descriptions.1787858592781001SFke-1791588207899001C4i: AI is now in production, expanding the attack surface beyond models and prompts. Modern AI connects to APIs, enterprise data, workflows, and autonomous agents across Azure and the edge, requiring organizations to protect the applications, interactions, and data that power it. Learn from Nirav Shah, SVP Products and Solutions at F5, how to secure AI apps, agents, APIs, and sensitive data, and how F5 and Microsoft enable secure, visible, and consistent AI scaling in Azure.
descriptions.1790726364973001mMVt-1791841491233001krh: We'll reveal 10 overlooked Partner Center features, settings, and best practices that can help partners drive more incentives, improve co-sell readiness, strengthen performance, and uncover hidden growth opportunities. This will help you and your organization improve profitability, visibility, and operational efficiency within your Microsoft partnership. From referrals and business profiles to benefits, analytics, and incentive programs, gain new insights from Partner Center.
descriptions.1787856667203001EtGn-1791588222043001C6O: Agent Mode in Visual Studio has been rebuilt on the GitHub Copilot SDK. Watch agents break down complex tasks, invoke tools, edit code, and carry work through a real-world development scenario. See how GitHub Copilot’s production-proven runtime powers agentic workflows in Visual Studio with support for both Copilot and BYOK models. Walk away with a deeper understanding of the architecture and practical guidance for adopting agentic workflows in your development process.
descriptions.1787856668327001E7fs-1791588239784001CjU: Tracing shows what happened. Evaluation shows whether it was successful. Optimization helps agents improve. Learn how observability, evaluations, agent insights and optimization loops combine to create continuously improving AI systems. This session focuses on practical engineering patterns for measuring quality, reducing cost and increasing business value from agent deployments.
descriptions.1787856694373001EiWA-1791588240906001Cr9: Enterprise agents often know the data but miss its meaning. I will build a Fabric IQ ontology over operational and analytical data, connect it to a Microsoft Foundry agent through the Fabric IQ MCP tool, and test questions that require relationships, rules, and business vocabulary - not keyword matching. You will see where ontology improves an agent, where a semantic model is enough, and how to introduce a governed context layer without rebuilding the data estate.
descriptions.1787856655331001EQqE-1791588220671001CqC: AI is accelerating software development, but speed doesn’t guarantee accessibility. Without accessibility built into design, development, and AI-assisted workflows, organizations risk creating accessibility debt faster than ever. Learn how Microsoft is shifting accessibility left with design guidance, developer tooling, AI assistance, and automated validation, with practical strategies for scaling inclusive development.
descriptions.1787854974793001tgKF-1791588251768001Cyx:
Planning a migration to Microsoft 365? Explore how to protect access, keep people productive and prepare for AI. Using anonymized customer scenarios, discuss assessment, workload sequencing, identity, coexistence and trade-offs when migrating at scale. Explore where assessment and migration capabilities can help, where more planning is needed and how to validate success. Bring your questions and leave with practical guidance for your next migration decision.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787854984905001twyj-1791588326258001CW3: Building agents is now a commodity. Building agents that understand how your business runs is the next level. This session covers the full lifecycle: the right tooling, semantically rich data so AI can reason accurately, and governance to keep agents observable and accountable across SAP and Microsoft. Leave with a practical understanding of the architecture connecting both platforms so your agents work as intended and scale with confidence.
descriptions.1787854985556001tkkD-1791588326929001C5L: Chevron and IBM share how a large enterprise is scaling AI to drive measurable business value. Learn how Chevron applied IBM's Client Zero approach, powered by Microsoft, to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and accelerate transformation. Through real-world examples and lessons learned, discover what it takes to move AI from isolated initiatives to scalable enterprise outcomes.
descriptions.1787856575631001EtU1-1791588144950001Crp: The pace of innovation in Microsoft Copilot for U.S. Government has never been greater. Join this demo-rich session to see how the latest AI innovations can help government organizations work more efficiently, make better decisions, and realize greater value from AI. See what’s new and discover new ways to move your mission forward.
descriptions.1787856591411001EAUC-1791814923343001CSB: AI can now generate a convincing résumé, portfolio, interview, and even a face. What it cannot fabricate is a signed credential from the organization that assessed the skill. Microsoft Certifications issued through Credly already provide trusted, verifiable proof. See how organizations can use verified skills today and how Pearson's vision for a digital wallet could make that proof more portable across learning, workforce, and hiring experiences.​
descriptions.1787856599501001EZtz-1791588247950001Cr2: Panel: A practical discussion on how to match models to scenarios by balancing quality, cost, latency, and user experience in AI applications.
descriptions.1787856606691001Ezww-1791588244584001CKd: Go deeper into how Microsoft Copilot and Cowork supports high-value functional work. See how Copilot plugins and Microsoft apps bring trusted business and industry data into everyday workflows across legal, finance, sales, and more. Explore flexible, role-specific solutions across priority functions, with customer examples showing business impact.
descriptions.1787856612005001EK31-1791588245510001C1B: Choosing the right video model is only the first step. Learn how Microsoft Foundry helps organizations build, optimize, and govern video AI applications using leading models. Through demos and practical examples, explore how to evaluate model quality, compare performance and cost, and operationalize video generation workloads with the security, observability, and scale needed for production deployment.
descriptions.1787856612152001EML6-1791588246178001Cxp: Expertise is scarce. Demand is not. Discover how Microsoft uses Foundry agents to scale expert knowledge in two very different teams: Product Marketing and Engineering Operations. From content reviews to incident and problem management, explore how teams capture expertise, automate repeatable work, and preserve human judgment. Leave with practical patterns for building agents that scale quality and consistency while freeing experts to focus on complex decisions and meet growing business demands.
descriptions.1787856613048001EwFK-1791588246407001CKn: See the tools IT needs to govern, control, and optimize AI spend at scale. Join this deep dive into Agent 365 and Microsoft 365 Admin Center capabilities for AI FinOps. Learn how to establish guardrails with policies, monitor consumption across AI vendors, measure value, and confidently scale AI across your organization. This is the essential session for IT to understand the latest innovations in AI cost management and governance.
descriptions.1787856618741001ENa1-1791588242748001CtA: What if your agents could reason with the full intelligence of your organization? Learn how Microsoft IQ grounds agents in your company’s unique data, knowledge, work, and business context across Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, and Web IQ. Discover how your IQ helps agents take more relevant actions, enable trusted decisions, and accelerate business outcomes.
descriptions.1787856621370001E15q-1791588156528001Cqc: Stay ahead of evolving threats with Project Perception, Microsoft’s new agentic security system. See how specialized red, blue, and green team agents work together with shared security context to expose weaknesses, investigate threats, prioritize risk, and strengthen defenses. Learn how coordinated multi-agent defense helps your team move from reactive security to continuous protection, while keeping people in control of critical decisions.
descriptions.1787856621879001E3ud-1791588220447001CZD: Go beyond static threat intelligence feeds. See how Microsoft combines industry-leading visibility, expert-led research, and AI automation to turn intelligence into action. Explore demos and practical strategies to defend against today’s top threats.
descriptions.1787856625713001ED74-1791588244356001Cbj: Learn how Microsoft Purview provides unified data security and compliance to help you identify risk, protect sensitive data across Microsoft 365 and Copilot, and accelerate investigations — so you can scale AI securely and confidently.
descriptions.1787856628645001Etkf-1791588243215001CYF: Everyone's shipping AI agents - but are they fast, cheap, and actually working? We'll instrument a multi-agent app with Azure Cosmos DB and Fabric to analyze cost, latency, and outcomes and build feedback loops for optimization. We'll also show how Kinectify applies these same principles to a 15+ agent KYC platform, using deep observability, QA agents, and quality gates to improve reliability and prevent bad data from reaching production.
descriptions.1787856631006001Ed7w-1791588243464001CBS: Modernizing a contact center takes more than adding AI. See how Dynamics 365 Contact Center brings together intelligent routing, Copilot, unified engagement, and operational insights in a single platform. Learn how organizations are improving self-service, increasing productivity, and delivering better customer experiences with less complexity.
descriptions.1787856633196001EAXC-1791588232533001CWL: Discover how WinUI provides the modern native foundation for building great Windows apps - and how a new generation of tools makes development faster and more flexible. Catch up on the latest WinUI platform updates and momentum and see how WinUI Agent and WinAppCLI support agent-ready workflows across Visual Studio, VS Code, and the command line.
descriptions.1787856640517001EIKl-1791588245037001C6m: Learn how Foundry Local on Azure Local brings model deployment, evaluation, agents, retrieval, and scalable inference to customer-controlled datacenters, factories, branches, and sovereign environments. See live demonstrations, evaluate model quality without data leaving the environment, and explore patterns for sovereign AI, disconnected operations, multi-GPU inference, and Azure-consistent management.
descriptions.1787856641893001EP9N-1791588245259001C9D: Migrations stall when risk, downtime, and governance aren't clear from the start. In this session, we share the playbook for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations using AI-assisted and built-in tools that simplify assessments, schema and code conversion, and data movement. Best practices plus a live demo will show you how to spot blockers earlier, coordinate migration steps, and build a repeatable path to Postgres on Azure.
descriptions.1787856645372001Euij-1791588243916001CFO: What does it take to move from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide transformation at global scale? Learn how Aon is leveraging Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Platform to empower 60,000 employees, accelerate workforce transformation, simplify a fragmented automation landscape, and unlock millions in business value, all while building a future-ready foundation for autonomous agents and AI-driven growth.
descriptions.1787856647047001Ezwq-1791588242070001Coc: Modernization is now a budget priority—94% of customers plan to invest within 6–12 months to modernize aging applications, databases, and infrastructure as the foundation for AI transformation. In this session, explore how partners can identify modernization opportunities, leverage agentic tooling to increase delivery velocity, and create repeatable practices that lead to new business opportunity across AI, data, security, sovereignty, and cloud-native innovation. ​
descriptions.1787856648572001EGN5-1791588270688001CoU: Security teams need faster, simpler operations without abandoning existing investments. See how Microsoft Sentinel capabilities are coming into the Microsoft Defender experience and what the integrated SOC means for new and established customers. Identify opportunities across assessment, migration, deployment, adoption, optimization, and managed services.​
descriptions.1787856651422001ERTl-1791588241831001Cgr: Frontier growth is partner-powered. See how Microsoft's partner investments are evolving to reward the motions that matter most: Copilot, Agents, Data, and Security. This session walks through the partner opportunities in FY27, how incentives work together across the customer lifecycle, and the practical steps partners can take now to turn Microsoft investment into pipeline, capacity, and customer outcomes.​
descriptions.1787856652801001EBYQ-1791588245955001CyP: After the pilots, what will media companies actually own? The tools are for rent; the intelligence is not. Explore how Frontier Transformation helps customers build owned, trusted intelligence across content, rights, and audiences. Hear proven use cases, partner proof points, and repeatable plays for attaching IP and services, and leave with a blueprint to grow your media business with Microsoft in FY27.
descriptions.1787856653823001EI7L-1791588243690001CYw: Many of the biggest AI opportunities come from more than automating a single task. They come from rethinking how decisions are made, how teams collaborate, and how value moves through the organization. Learn how leaders can identify workflows ready for reinvention and redesign work around the combined strengths of people and AI.​

Go inside Zurich’s approach to connecting cloud modernization, modern workplace, Copilot and agentic solutions across the technology stack. Learn how Zurich is advancing resilience, modernization and AI adoption together to automate complex processes and build a secure, adaptable foundation for what’s next.
descriptions.1787856662729001EkCU-1791588249758001CzT: Trusted AI starts with trusted content. As agents and Copilot experiences become integral to business workflows in Microsoft 365, SharePoint security and resiliency are more critical than ever. Join us to see how the #1 citation source of Copilot - SharePoint protects organizational knowledge, ensures resilience against threats and disruptions, and provides the trusted foundation for AI at enterprise scale.
descriptions.1787856667830001EJ5c-1791588249975001CTh: Model router in Foundry Models continues to evolve with new capabilities that give developers greater control over how requests are routed across models. In this session, we'll highlight the latest innovations in model router and show how teams can optimize quality, latency, and cost for AI applications and agents. You'll see how model router helps simplify model selection, adapt to changing workloads, and improve application performance at scale.
descriptions.1787856669864001Eujb-1791588250417001CuC: As organizations move AI into production, they need visibility into how AI apps perform and how agents operate. See how Microsoft Foundry and Fabric Data Agent help teams monitor AI operations, investigate issues, and uncover insights. The new integration with Microsoft Agent 365 gives admins visibility into Fabric Data Agent usage and activity org-wide. Together, they offer a connected approach to troubleshooting and managing AI, from applications to the enterprise agent estate.
descriptions.1787856673290001ExAh-1791588250644001CLR: A deleted identity can quickly become a major business disruption, especially when it has dependencies across applications, groups, policies, and access. See how Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery helps protect critical identity data and recover from accidental or malicious changes. Learn how to build resilience into your identity environment before deletion becomes downtime.​
descriptions.1787856673748001EFw9-1791588295086001CkU: Securing your riskiest agents is now as simple as choosing an outcome. Discover new intent-based playbooks that help security teams protect, govern, investigate, and remediate agents through a simple, guided experience. See how Dynamic Agent Risk continuously evaluates agent risks, permissions, exposure, and impact to prioritize what matters most and intelligently recommends your next best actions.
descriptions.1787856674816001Ec8w-1791588250868001CjC: Keeping data and AI workloads running smoothly requires more than reactive troubleshooting. In this theater session, we'll show how Workspace Monitoring, Monitor Hub, and Operations Agent work together to provide a unified view of your Fabric estate. Learn how to monitor across workspaces, detect issues earlier, accelerate root cause analysis with AI-powered insights, and improve operational reliability from a single experience.
descriptions.1787856680813001E6hI-1791588251100001CVQ: As agents connect to more MCP servers and enterprise tools, organizations need visibility into what can be accessed and how those interactions are used. Learn how to publish enterprise MCP servers, secure access to enterprise tools, apply runtime policies, and monitor agent interactions through a centralized gateway. Gain practical approaches for bringing MCP into enterprise environments with the visibility and controls required for production deployment.
descriptions.1787856686808001EuSe-1791588251326001Czb: Most agent stories automate a task. Source-to-pay changes how a whole business function runs - procurement, finance, legal and every employee who needs to buy something. We walk the process end to end: where guided buying in the flow of work meets agentic execution behind it, where the agent decides, where a human approves, and what the CFO office actually measures. A practical look at agentifying one complete function, and how partners can spot the next one.
descriptions.1787856692827001E6us-1791588251544001C4Z: Enterprise AI rarely scales when every team builds its own environment. WeÆll live onboard a second team against an existing estate, showing what breaks under inherited policies and why. Thriving community: 3,000 makers led adoption. Teamwork: customer, partner, and Microsoft sellers worked as one. Get the 3Ts playbook and see how Microsoft programs and incentives speed adoption.

descriptions.1787856575481001EroA-1791588264882001CNr: Work management is where goals become real: plans are shaped, owners align, tasks move, and teams need to know what changed. See how you can accelerate database optimization while retaining governance and control.

descriptions.1787856590169001E9rd-1791588161719001CG9: Big goals require people and teams with the skills to deliver them. descriptions.1787858595173001SQKr-1791588278343001Ccs: Enterprises want agents that get work done, not just answer questions. Building them requires identity, access, and orchestration. Microsoft Agent 365 provides identity and access, giving agents a Microsoft 365 presence, while n8n provides orchestration to reason over requests and act across your stack. descriptions.1787858595316001S5po-1791588328299001C9J: AI agents are changing how software is developed and introducing new considerations for software supply chain security.
