descriptions.1787856610049001EgNH-1791588175331001Cup: Choose the right Foundry build path for each agent without creating a platform dead end. Start quickly with simple prompt agents, add the Microsoft Copilot harness for skills, sandboxed execution, long-running work, and agent definitions managed as files through CI/CD, or use hosted agents when you need full control of your code and framework, including OpenClaw or Hermes. See how Foundry applies identity, authorization, governance, tools, and publishing across these paths, including autopilots.
descriptions.1787856617376001E61G-1791814922219001CGj: Azure DevOps customers can use GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows whether their repositories are hosted in Azure Repos or GitHub. In this session, we will demonstrate Copilot code review for Azure Repos and show how to use the Azure DevOps MCP Server with Visual Studio Code, GitHub CLI, and GitHub Copilot app. We will also cover how to use Auto fix with GitHub Advanced Security for Azure DevOps.
descriptions.1787856619486001EVFL-1791588310980001CFX: Enterprise AI is only as effective as the business context behind it. Discover how Microsoft IQ unifies knowledge across the Microsoft ecosystem and how Fabric IQ provides trusted business meaning that helps AI understand how an organization operates. Learn how enterprises can reuse existing data and knowledge to deliver consistent answers, make informed decisions, and enable agents to act with confidence.
descriptions.1787856623422001EYHx-1791588309175001Cna: Dozens of policies become hundreds, and changing one can break something downstream. See how a unified policy engine brings identity, network, device, and risk signals together to make access decisions without forcing teams to untangle dependencies. Learn how to scale adaptive access with confidence and control.​
descriptions.1787856623575001EYSY-1791588308940001CdC: Identity attacks move fast. Your teams need to move faster. See how Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Defender bring identity context and risk signals into SOC investigations, helping IAM and security teams detect, investigate, and disrupt threats faster with unified visibility and automation.​
descriptions.1787856628798001EPav-1791588308018001Cvo: Apps and AI agents rely on databases to serve data that's fresh, fast, and scalable. But with so many types of databases - relational, NoSQL, open-source, and more - how do you know which database is right for your project? Join experts as they explore different Azure Databases, and share insights on how to choose for your next project.
descriptions.1787856629889001EwSt-1791588244141001C6l: Go from an idea to an AI-ready SQL app with the MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code and GitHub Copilot. Build it step by step: prototype locally with the Azure SQL Database container, design your database with Microsoft SQL Agent Skills, build retrieval augmented generation(RAG) using native vector support, create a data API, and deploy to the cloud. See how the tools work together so you can spend less time on database setup and more time building your app.
descriptions.1787856633644001Eort-1791587923721001FVw: AI adoption and AI-enabled cyberthreats are proliferating in the browser—hourly. In this session, IT and security teams will learn practical ways to address both: use Edge for Business to help reduce browser risk and protect sensitive data, while opening the door to new AI and agentic productivity. See how built-in visibility, policy enforcement, and compliance help you stay in control, even on unmanaged devices—without adding more tools to your security stack.​
descriptions.1787856636094001EKJc-1791588309857001CQX: Your infrastructure is distributed. Your control plane shouldn’t be. Discover how Azure Arc extends Azure management, security, and governance across servers, Kubernetes, databases, and applications wherever they run. See how a unified approach helps close security gaps, control costs, and improve operational consistency at scale while accelerating SQL Server modernization to Azure SQL Managed Instance.
descriptions.1787856636998001ES6L-1791588310080001CIf: As organizations pursue greater efficiency, scalability, and flexibility, they must also manage rising costs and operational complexity. In this demo-filled session, we will show how Windows Admin Center (WAC) Virtualization Mode helps you build cost-effective, cloud-connected on-prem virtualization solutions with the Hyper-V hypervisor in Windows Server.
descriptions.1787856638224001Ejm6-1791588310311001CoW: Linux estates rarely consist of a single distribution. See how Azure helps you preserve the Linux choices you have while expanding what your teams can do. Follow a multi-tier logistics workload across RHEL, SUSE, Ubuntu, and Azure Linux as it moves from Hyper-V to Azure, gains capacity, and recovers from an audience-selected failure. Learn how Azure Migrate, Azure Monitor, and GitHub Copilot connect planning, visibility, and operations across the Linux estate.
descriptions.1787856639288001EBwb-1791588287757001C0S: The success of AI depends on more than models and compute. It depends on getting the right data to the right place at the right time. As organizations scale AI and cloud-native applications, storage is becoming a strategic differentiator. Join us to see how Azure Storage is advancing performance, resiliency, security, and intelligent data management, and learn how to prepare your architecture for the next generation of AI-powered applications.
descriptions.1787856644615001EMWj-1791588308717001ChG: Product Lifecycle Management is evolving into the digital backbone of the enterprise and core to the Digital Engineering Platform. Future PLM is integrated, model-based and AI-enabled, connecting product, software, service, compliance and operational data. AI improves decisions, impact analysis and data quality. Join Microsoft, SICK and Aras to learn how digital threads, virtualization and NVIDIA Omniverse enable connected engineering across the lifecycle and see these technologies in action.
descriptions.1787856649473001Eo9Q-1791588284843001CGr: Turn process reinvention into partner growth. See how Power Apps and Copilot Studio connect apps, agents, and workflows to move from AI strategy to governed deployment, agentic solutions, and continuous optimization. Explore innovations in orchestration, connectivity, governance and cost controls that help you scale. Leave with clarity on the partner opportunity, practical ways to differentiate, shorten delivery cycles, and deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.​
descriptions.1787856653112001EXqY-1791588307345001C7z: Learn how partners and customers can build agentic financial services solutions that turn trusted enterprise and market data into actionable intelligence. Explore architecture patterns that combine data, AI platforms, and agents to support research, relationship management, risk analysis, and investment workflows. Discover how to move from information access to faster decisions while maintaining the governance, security, and control required by financial institutions.​
descriptions.1787856653285001E5FA-1791588311210001C1H: AI-native companies run on Microsoft 365 to work smarter, then build on it to grow revenue. See how Litera adopted M365 E7, putting the full security stack and Agent 365 to work, then completed the legal workflow inside Word, Outlook and Copilot by building three MCP plugins. See how Litera's agentic tooling drives new seats and revenue. Live demos, architecture and the incentives that fund the build.​
descriptions.1787856654734001EUBe-1791588308496001Cm7: As AI systems take on increasingly autonomous tasks, leaders must determine which decisions should be delegated and which accountabilities should remain with people. This session introduces an executive framework for establishing observability at every layer, defining decision rights, and creating shared accountability across business, technology, risk, and governance teams. Learn how organizations can scale AI adoption while maintaining appropriate observability and informed decision-making. ​
descriptions.1792115855061001r812-1792437539967001n4T: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.​
descriptions.1787856583816001EHnb-1791588187749001CST: The Premier League is running the largest technology transformation in its history on Microsoft Cloud, AI, and security. We trace the connected intelligence behind it: how 30+ seasons of statistics, 300,000 articles, 9,000 videos, and live match data drove 20% year-over-year engagement growth across 60 million fans, and how the same foundation helps Premier League Studios create and localize content for global broadcasts, on a governed platform that protects fan data, content, and rights.
descriptions.1787856587353001EqNK-1791588277887001CdC: SAP Joule understands your business processes and enterprise data. Microsoft Copilot understands how people work. In this session, see how we’re bringing these worlds closer together through Work IQ and new integration patterns across SAP and Microsoft. Explore how agents can tap into richer context across both ecosystems, with identity and permissions providing the foundation for connected experiences. Learn what’s possible today and where the SAP and Microsoft integration is heading next.
descriptions.1787856590323001EyL3-1791588177933001CHW: Your goals and experience are uniquely yours—your learning should feel that way too. See how AI Skills Navigator can help you spend less time searching, focus on learning that matters to you, and build confidence by putting new knowledge into practice. You’ll leave with a clearer path from what you want to achieve to what you can do.
descriptions.1787856596088001EjX6-1791588327607001Ch1: "No more ETL" sounds great until migration week. Fabric mirroring can genuinely retire your pipelines, or quietly become the outage nobody planned for. This session is a field-tested playbook for migrating off legacy systems ETL onto Fabric mirroring: sequencing that doesn't blow up your quarter, where CDC actually saves money, and the day-one mistakes we only learned by making them. Leave with a migration plan template, not a feature tour.
descriptions.1787858587993001SE6q-1791588096550001Czt: Explore Muse Spark Open, Meta's open-weight model built for coding and agentic work, available through the Hugging Face collection in Microsoft Foundry Models. Learn how its 1M-token context window, codebase understanding, and tool calling support agents that plan changes, check results, and recover from failed steps. Discover how model capabilities and an agentic harness work together, and how to evaluate the model against your own repositories and tools.
descriptions.1787858598306001SSO4-1791588346861001CzH: Learn how to provide a robust security foundation with vulnerability management, backporting, CVE remediation, and more. Building on that foundation, Red Hat Lightwell and Red Hat Enterprise Linux share how Azure Red Hat OpenShift with hosted control planes and OpenShift Virtualization accelerate application delivery. Join us to learn how to provide a security-first approach to deploy and manage containers, VMs, and agentic AI systems.
descriptions.1787858598453001SIbA-1791588332605001Cb9: Catching a bad prompt, tool, or model change before it reaches production comes down to a repeatable loop: trace, evaluate, monitor, and test. Put this loop into practice with an agent deployed on Microsoft Foundry. Trace LLM and tool calls with Datadog Agent Observability to identify regressions and establish a repeatable framework for monitoring and governing AI applications at scale.
descriptions.1787858598600001STDp-1791588332841001Cbp: Your best answers are locked in enterprise file data - and copying it into an AI platform is a tax you shouldn't pay. In 25 minutes, watch a Microsoft Foundry agent get grounded directly on Azure NetApp Files with zero data copy, then answer real questions inside Microsoft 365 Copilot. Then go agentic with MCP: drive that agent from VS Code, and manage Azure NetApp Files at scale in natural language with the Azure MCP Server. One live demo, no copies, no copy tax.
descriptions.1787858598890001SaFo-1791588343701001CJ0: Microsoft and ServiceNow are developing new innovations together to help customers become frontier firms. See how recent releases are helping joint customers accelerate time to value, how Microsoft and ServiceNow co-design solutions that bring the two platforms together, and what’s ahead in the next wave of integrated capabilities.
descriptions.1787856666438001EnH1-1791588313442001CWT: Browser automation is becoming a core capability for agentic applications. This session explores how Remote MCP exposes Playwright Cloud Browser as a shared browser service across Copilot, Foundry, GitHub Copilot, and custom agents. Learn how it enables reliable web navigation, data extraction, and task execution, with built-in observability to simplify debugging. We’ll also demonstrate secure access to public websites and private VNet applications for enterprise-ready browser automation.
descriptions.1787856674965001EAz0-1791588349143001CQF: Learn how the latest developer experiences in Microsoft Fabric help teams deploy, operate, and optimize data solutions with confidence. Explore new capabilities for job scheduling, proactive and reactive monitoring, troubleshooting, versioning, and deployments, along with improvements in Git integration, CI/CD, automation, and observability. See how Fabric brings software engineering best practices to data workloads, helping teams move from development to production faster and more reliably.
descriptions.1787856678516001EFxK-1791588349592001CjQ: The security decisions organizations make today must stand up to tomorrow's computing breakthroughs. Learn how Windows is helping customers extend trust into the quantum era through post-quantum cryptography, compliance-ready capabilities, and platform investments designed to protect against future threats. Discover what post-quantum readiness means in practice, where organizations should begin, and how Windows is building the foundation for a trusted future.
descriptions.1787856687107001EFdA-1791588292449001Cpa: Frontier Accelerate is reshaping how partners drive Azure adoption. In this lightning talk, we'll unpack what Frontier Accelerate for Azure means in practice — the motions, incentives, and partner surfaces that turn pipeline into deployed workloads. You'll see a practical example of how partners accelerate Azure consumption and modernization, plus the top actions to plug in today. Built for questions — bring yours.
descriptions.1787856687706001ElrX-1791588314104001CPV: Explore how Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Security specializations help partners demonstrate expertise and build customer trust in the AI era. Learn what’s changing and how audit requirements connect to demonstrated security capabilities. You will gain: A clear view of specialization updates, what the audits assess, and practical steps to prepare your organization and communicate your value to customers.
descriptions.1787856690617001EnMZ-1791588314331001CwY: Most organizations are layering AI onto existing processes. But what if workflows were redesigned around AI from the start? This session explores how enterprises are rethinking operations, decision-making, and knowledge work in an era where intelligent agents can help coordinate complex tasks. Learn where organizations are seeing the biggest gains, the risks they're navigating, and the lessons emerging from early adopters.
descriptions.1787856690767001EK8y-1791588314560001Csl: Collaboration platforms make it easy to create teams, channels, sites, and AI-powered experiences, but unmanaged growth can create security, governance, and productivity challenges. This session examines practical strategies for maintaining control while enabling innovation. Discover how organizations are balancing user empowerment with governance as collaboration and AI become deeply embedded in everyday work.
descriptions.1787856704777001EzHG-1791588314781001CpC: See how Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence became the engine behind a fun, interactive, and engaging customer experience. We’ll share the technology behind the Fabric Real-Time Challenge, an Ignite Community activation that uses the product to power both the participant experience and the surrounding displays. We’ll discuss how the concept evolved from earlier RTI activations, how we built the project, and what we learned about making Fabric tangible and approachable for a crowd.
descriptions.1787856670978001EsJB-1791588348689001C6b: Learn how Work IQ and Agent 365 work together to build useful workplace agents and govern them at scale. Ground agents in Microsoft 365 context, then see how Agent 365 supports visibility, lifecycle management, policy, security, and operational control.
descriptions.1787856671900001ERmv-1791588315002001Cmm: Modern attacks move faster than human response. Join Microsoft security experts to learn how attack disruption helps stop attacks in progress, automatically containing threats and limiting attacker movement before damage occurs. Discover why autonomous defense is quickly becoming a core requirement for modern security operations.
descriptions.1787856678364001EItE-1791588349371001CNM: Developer productivity starts before the first line of code. Project Zenith brings together a ready-to-code Windows experience, curated tools, and focused settings so teams can begin faster and personalize the environment around how they work.
descriptions.1787856683462001Eb8s-1791588315247001CkQ: What if monitoring could tell you what’s healthy, what’s impacted, and why? Azure Monitor health models turn telemetry into a real-time health graph that understands your workload, dependencies, and what matters to your business. Learn how to model, evaluate, and propagate health across your architecture, investigate impact, and accelerate responses, while giving AI structured context to investigate incidents, identify root causes, recommend remediation, and drive intelligent operations.
descriptions.1787856690293001ENMR-1791588315467001CZD:
Less time adjusting. More time doing. Discover how Windows brings people with disabilities greater independence and control, and more ways for everyone to work comfortably, from Narrator and braille to Magnifier, Screen Tint, and voice access.
Call to action
Bring one useful discovery back to your organization.
Explore more : aka.ms/windowsaccessibilityresources
Share feedback: aka.ms/ContactWindowsAccessibility
descriptions.1787856695434001Ear9-1791588303294001CKU: Everybody's talking about AI, but many of the best productivity features are already sitting on your Windows device waiting to be used. Join this fun, demo-packed session where we'll explore Copilot on Windows, voice, Recall, Windows 365 integrations, and other hidden gems that will save time, help you work smarter and have a better day with your Windows device. No technical deep dives - just intelligent work at your fingertips.
descriptions.1787856576228001E5Fl-1791588293107001Cgq: Building an agent is just the start. Watch a continuous improvement loop in action: use traces to spot a quality issue, review a proposed fix, optimize the agent, and measure what changed. See how improvements in quality, token use, and latency help you decide what to deploy and what to improve next.
descriptions.1787856576376001EuuR-1791588265344001CyO: Open models are only as good as the platform that runs them. In this session, see how Fireworks on Microsoft Foundry takes frontier open models from evaluation to production — better price-performance, workload-specific sizing, and enterprise-grade reliability on Azure and learn how to use open models on Fireworks on Foundry to build agentic workloads for your customers.
descriptions.1787856577168001E6rK-1791588300168001CZl: We share how developer infrastructure can support larger projects and more concurrent reads and writes. Explore the engineering behind scaling throughput and designing for reliability, and what these changes mean for development teams.
descriptions.1787856581700001EulX-1791588274511001CDJ: VMware customers are at an inflection point: many are making strategic decisions on their VMware footprint, but few can move everything at once. See how Azure has practical options for every stage of that journey. We’ll cover patterns for stabilizing critical VMware estates in Azure, connecting them to Azure data services and Foundry, and creating a durable bridge to AI adoption for SQL Server, Oracle, and other business-critical workloads.
descriptions.1787856586737001ENLF-1791588258688001CV0: Agent loops made autonomous behavior possible; graphs make entire agent systems programmable. Learn agentic graph engineering: a stable graph defining which agent owns each capability, and a dynamic work graph defining what runs now. See a live build in Microsoft Foundry where a planner decomposes a goal, a WebIQ research agent and specialists run in parallel, a validator confirms evidence, and the graph adapts. Leave with a blueprint.​
descriptions.1787856591574001EYIh-1791588249319001CDN:
Join Microsoft’s Aneesh Raman for a candid, audience-driven conversation about moving beyond AI anxiety toward human agency. Together, we’ll explore the fears and questions people are wrestling with as work changes, what becomes more valuable when technology can do more, and why human capability matters more, not less, in the age of AI.
Bring your questions, concerns, and curiosity. This is an open conversation about the future of work and the role each of us can play in shaping it.
descriptions.1787856595767001EITE-1791588316800001CmM: What if AI could understand your business data and help decide what happens next? In this demo-heavy session, weÆll use Microsoft Fabric Data Agent and Microsoft Foundry to investigate a real-world retail sales decline across sales, inventory, and operations data. Watch AI uncover causes, connect trusted enterprise context, and recommend actions. WeÆll then go beyond Q&A with secure access, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and human oversight.
descriptions.1787858599037001S3X3-1791588347092001CQN: Copilot is transforming individual work, but many conference rooms were designed for AV, not AI. Copilot and Facilitator experiences benefit from the intelligence the room provides, including identified voices and better representation of remote participants. From Surface Hub transitions and Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows deployments, DTEN shows how AI-grade compute, room awareness, and meeting intelligence extend Copilot's value from the individual to the whole meeting.
descriptions.1787858599197001SmYc-1791588347311001CKj: AI is only as good as the data it can access. In this live demo, the audience becomes the dataset. Responses submitted during the session are written directly into MongoDB Atlas and immediately used by AI agents powered by Foundry IQ, Fabric IQ and Work IQ. Watch agents uncover insights, compare trends, connect knowledge and recommend actions in real time. Learn how to build AI on operational data while reducing pipelines, avoiding separate vector stores, and simplifying retrieval architectures.
descriptions.1787858599341001SsB5-1791588354542001C19: Remote onboarding is a high‑risk, Zero Trust phase for many organizations. Shipping a laptop and YubiKey is easy but proving a remote user’s identity before key registration is not. Attackers increasingly exploit Day Zero helpdesks to bypass MFA. Join Yubico and CLEAR to see an Entra‑powered workflow that verifies identity, issues a verifiable credential, and binds a YubiKey with no helpdesk needed. Come for the insights, leave with a blueprint for zero‑touch provisioning and reduced fraud.
descriptions.1792115891774001qdxL-1792437573219001Fm6: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.
descriptions.1787854974691001tm13-1791588224527001CPU:
What makes Microsoft 365 Copilot understand your work, not just your prompt? Join this small-group discussion to explore what powers Work IQ, how the Work IQ toggle changes Copilot’s grounding, the multi-model capability and how Copilot compares with other AI solutions. Through simple visuals, demos, and peer discussion, we’ll examine how workplace intelligence delivers more relevant and actionable outcomes for your organization.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856895264001hFX6-1791588191500001CNh:
Agentic commerce promises a future where AI agents can discover, evaluate and purchase on behalf of users. But are customers ready? Join product teams, developers and business leaders to discuss trust, governance, payment controls and approval workflows. Explore where genuine customer demand exists today, which scenarios show the most promise, and what challenges must be solved before autonomous purchasing becomes mainstream.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856905462001hKkL-1791588261779001CuN:
Bring your hardest Oracle migration question. Discuss assessment gaps, unsupported objects, schema and code conversion, data movement, validation, downtime, and cutover with Microsoft experts and peers. Leave with practical next steps for your migration plan to PostgreSQL on Azure and a clearer view of where Microsoft first-party tooling fits.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856907685001hKaZ-1791588092091001C4w:
Business continuity and disaster recovery are shifting from point solutions to a connected platform. This table talk explores how protection, recovery, orchestration, and resilience management can work together across applications and infrastructure. We’ll discuss how partners can build differentiated solutions, address complex recovery needs, and help customers continuously validate readiness. Join us to identify the biggest partner opportunities and what to build next.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856925191001hibr-1791588281722001CsH:
Continue the conversation on the shift from app-specific RAG to shared context layers. Discuss what this means for developers, architects, and business leaders building grounded agents with Foundry IQ and Microsoft IQ.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856930038001hBdV-1791588254916001C9M:
Using real-world scenarios, we’ll explore questions customers face today: How do you know an application is truly resilient before an outage? How do you balance recovery goals, cost, and complexity? Can readiness be continuously measured and validated? And how does cyber recovery change when recovery must happen in trusted clean rooms? Join us to share experiences and shape the future of getting resilient, staying resilient, and recovering confidently.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1790726801107001gV3R-1791898443108001pJZ:
Partner firms sell labor. Agents reduce the labor a project needs. That is good for the customer and hard for a business priced by the hour. This discussion is for leaders working out what their firm sells when delivery hours fall. The group covers what to price instead of time, which parts of a services catalog are most exposed, how to discuss a smaller number with a customer without losing the account, and what the first repriced offer looked like for firms that have tried it.
Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
descriptions.1787856666129001E8X8-1791588320160001Cit: AI agents are moving beyond chat and code. They can now navigate websites use business tools collect information and complete work across applications. See practical examples and learn how to decide what agents can access where they should stop and when a person must approve the next step. Built for IT admins security teams and technology leaders.
descriptions.1787856667680001EhLa-1791588320383001CpC: Prompt-based agents helped developers get started, but production workloads demand more. This session explores the evolution from prompt agents to hosted agents, covering identity, sessions, tool integration, resiliency, deployment pipelines and enterprise governance. Learn how teams are moving from prototypes to scalable AI systems while preserving developer productivity and choice.
descriptions.1787856673138001EhVB-1791588320610001CNk: External users expect every interaction with your application to be fast, seamless, and secure. Attackers are looking for the gaps in that experience. See what’s new in Microsoft Entra External ID, with innovations that help you deliver low-friction customer experiences while strengthening protection for customer identities.
descriptions.1787856682850001EAlO-1791588275894001Cn7: Bringing AI and cloud-native applications closer to users often means running workloads beyond the datacenter. Learn how AKS Flex Nodes extend Kubernetes to edge environments, enabling consistent operations across cloud and edge. See how organizations deploy AI inferencing, data processing, and mission-critical applications closer to where data is generated while maintaining centralized management, security, and scalability with Azure Kubernetes Service.
descriptions.1787856690926001E1Od-1791588320830001C65: See Foundry Local and other AI agent factories running live on the brand-new Surface Laptop Ultra's RTX Spark chip. Beyond the demo: why local-first AI is becoming a compliance strategy for enterprises under regulations like GDPR and the EU AI Act. We compare cost, latency, and data-residency tradeoffs, and show how Purview labels and Entra ID secure device-based agents. Walk away with a practical framework for deciding when local beats cloud ù and how to defend that choice to compliance teams.
descriptions.1787856691402001EjtR-1791588321075001C4w: An app registration was built for predictable code. What changes when software can plan, choose tools, and act autonomously? Learn four decisions every organization must make before granting an AI agent access: identity type, operating context, trust boundary, and identity granularity. See a classic service principal evolve into a governed Agent ID with accountability, auditing, and lifecycle controlsùand leave with a practical framework for production-ready agents.
descriptions.1787856692062001EVMA-1791588321296001C5w: Real-time voice agents are generally available in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. The demo always works. Production is harder. I build one live: barge-in, DTMF fallback, mid-call language switching, and deterministic handling for identity checks. Then I break it and show the escalation that carries full context to a human rep. You leave with a latency budget, the guardrails that matter, and the three failures that hit every deployment.
descriptions.1787856694529001EJdj-1791588321516001C7b: Microsoft 365 Copilot already reads your workplace: the meetings, the threads, who works with whom. That is Work IQ, and it is half of an HR answer. The other half, headcount, tenure, movement and engagement, sits in Snowflake where Copilot cannot see it. This session joins them, through the Cortex Agents app inside Microsoft 365 Copilot and a Copilot Studio agent when you need control, so HR people who have never written SQL get answers carrying both the numbers and the context.
descriptions.1787854982790001tctI-1791588322423001C9o: AI pilots are easy. Running agents at scale is where partners create lasting value. Learn how to govern, monitor, and optimize AI agents across customer environments, turning agent operations into recurring, outcome-based engagements. See how to build the operational layer, scale it across customers, and create a sustainable AI services practice with Ingram Micro.
descriptions.1787854985772001tuQE-1791588339665001Cka: Customers are accelerating their journey to become Frontier Enterprises by modernizing cloud and AI platforms. This customer panel will share how they are modernizing cloud infrastructure, applications, and data to enable AI adoption at scale. Hear how investments in agent marketplaces and context intelligence are helping agents operate with greater accuracy and efficiency. The discussion will also explore agent governance and AI observability approaches to trust, security, and FinOps.
descriptions.1787854985981001tBGq-1791588102520001C6h: Manufacturers are using AI to rethink operations, supply chains, engineering, workforce productivity, and customer value. In this 45-minute breakout, NTT DATA will be joined by Celanese to share real-world perspectives on moving AI from experimentation to enterprise-scale impact. Hear how these industry leaders are applying AI, data, cloud, automation, and intelligent agents to address complex business challenges, improve decision-making, and unlock new opportunities
descriptions.1787856606082001E6wr-1791588324221001CNQ: Most organizations have the content they need, but it remains scattered across files, sites, and business processes. Learn how Copilot in SharePoint helps transform content into organizational knowledge by modernizing information architecture, enriching content with AI, scaling expertise through reusable skills, and strengthening Copilot and agent experiences across Microsoft 365.
descriptions.1787856606232001EOEz-1791814921046001C62: As AI becomes part of everyday work, content plays a more important role than ever. Discover how OneDrive helps people find knowledge, organize information, collaborate across teams, and move from information to action with Copilot. Through practical demonstrations, explore new experiences that make it easier to work across files, libraries, and shared content while keeping work secure, connected, and ready for the flow of work across Microsoft 365.
descriptions.1787856607340001ECcD-1791588326038001CPl: Your organization is already using AI, but is it delivering real value at scale? In this session, we’ll compare Microsoft 365 Copilot to alternative AI solutions across real work scenarios. See how Work IQ, organizational context, multi-model intelligence, security, and trust work together to deliver more relevant results and higher-quality outcomes. Bring your laptop and evaluate the differences firsthand!
descriptions.1787856607815001EKGX-1791588309634001CZB: You know where you want AI to take your business, but getting there can raise as many questions as answers. Where do you start? What foundation do you need? Which AI opportunities should you pursue? How do you scale what works? Through this session, you will learn how Frontier Accelerate brings together Microsoft experts, investments, and skilling to help you navigate those decisions, how customers are putting these benefits to work, and leave knowing what to do next and how Microsoft can help.
descriptions.1787856608450001EK50-1791588335828001Csc: How do you know which AI delivers the most value for your organization? In this session, you'll learn how to use a repeatable framework and methodology to evaluate Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and common AI tools across real work scenarios. You'll see side-by-side testing that measures accuracy, trust, speed, and cost, and leave equipped to test your own scenarios, evaluate where each AI tool delivers value, and share feedback that helps shape better Copilot experiences.
descriptions.1787856610351001EtOJ-1791588199498001CmN: What if your AI agents could read documents, understand images, and process audio and video to act on business content? In this session, learn how Azure Content Understanding and Document Intelligence turn unstructured, multimodal content into actionable insights and automated workflows. Through live demos, see how to ingest content, extract structured data, and orchestrate AI agents using trusted enterprise content, spanning process automation, knowledge extraction, and agent-driven workflows.
descriptions.1787856611535001Ejk2-1791588235003001CQh: AI adoption is expanding to fleets of agents, making governance an operational challenge. Explore how AI Gateway, Responsible AI controls, agent identity, FinOps, and governance integrations provide visibility and control across your AI estate. Microsoft Foundry provides the governance foundation for AI systems, integrating with Agent 365 for enterprise operations and administration. Leave with a practical framework for running AI securely from development to production.
descriptions.1787856618592001EPDX-1791588235919001Cbb: Why does agentic retrieval matter, and what does it take to build it yourself? In this session, we will first code an agent loop that decomposes a question, runs parallel searches, inspects evidence, and decides whether to search again. Then we'll see how Foundry IQ can replace that plumbing with a managed agentic knowledge base. Learn how we made the managed service cheaper, faster, and better, thanks to serverless execution, compression, fine-tuned task-specific models, and built-in ranking.
descriptions.1787856621205001EEjt-1791588323995001CuF: What threats and challenges are Microsoft experts seeing on the frontlines of cyber defense? Hear directly from frontline experts and explore practical guidance for making threat intelligence actionable, operationalizing AI agents, and building cyber resilience.
descriptions.1787856622050001EBwu-1791588323772001CF1: Outpace endpoint risk with AI-powered insight and governed remediation. See how Microsoft helps IT and security prioritize exposure, apply patches or mitigations, stage change safely, and verify risk reduction without disrupting work.
descriptions.1787856629569001E325-1791588323323001CNG: Your SQL workloads demand a platform built for performance, security, and what’s next. Join us and see how Azure can unify SQL across on-premises, cloud, and Fabric to simplify operations and maximize existing investments. Modernize mission-critical workloads and empower developers to build AI-ready apps without sacrificing reliability or control. Hear why customers like H&R Block are building their business on Azure SQL Hyperscale.
descriptions.1787856630208001ERlU-1791588285982001CQ6: Learn how to move existing MongoDB applications to Azure DocumentDB with less migration risk and disruption. We'll walk the migration journey—from assessing compatibility and moving data to validating behavior and optimizing for production—while showing how familiar MongoDB drivers, tools, and patterns preserve existing investments. See how the latest Azure DocumentDB capabilities help teams move beyond migration and modernize on Azure.
descriptions.1787856630540001E0Tx-1791588285537001CIc: Customer service is evolving beyond traditional CRM and agent desktops into autonomous operations where people and AI agents resolve issues faster and deliver better experiences. Discover how Dynamics 365 Customer Service brings together Copilot, AI agents, customer engagement, Teams, and contact center capabilities to turn systems of record into systems of action. Learn how organizations modernize self-service, empower teams, automate processes, and reduce operational complexity.
descriptions.1787856634424001Eth1-1791588335374001ChB: Not sure where to start with modernizing on-premises VDI? See how Azure Virtual Desktop and Windows 365 let you modernize at your own pace, from extending existing investments to embracing cloud-managed desktops, with lessons from real customers.
descriptions.1787856638686001EsPu-1791588322196001Cv6: In an era where compute is an increasingly sought after resource, it's more important than ever to ensure your workloads can expand and adapt to grow cost efficiently. Learn how Azure is investing in ways for customers to dynamically and cost-optimally obtain, allocate, and manage appropriate compute resources across workloads. Discover how organizations are architecting and modernizing their IaaS estate to take advantage of the latest compute flexibility and cost-efficiency innovations.
descriptions.1787856642349001EIdC-1791588286208001Cit: Securing grant funding is critical to nonprofit impact, yet the process remains time-intensive for many organizations. In this session, we'll demonstrate how Microsoft Copilot and AI agents can transform the grant lifecycle by identifying funding opportunities, evaluating eligibility, assessing readiness, and accelerating proposal development. Through a live demo attendees will see how agent teams reduce administrative burden, improve proposal quality, and help nonprofits secure funding faster.
descriptions.1787856649919001ENaF-1791588307118001CQ1: AI agents and usage-based AI are redefining how customers buy, consume, and measure value from technology. As traditional partner services models face increasing pressure, partners must evolve. Explore the Partner of the Future vision and discover how leading firms are modernizing operating models, transforming go-to-market strategies, and shifting toward value- and outcome-based approaches to unlock growth in the age of AI.​
descriptions.1787856652205001EWmk-1791588321970001CfF: Discover how Microsoft’s EMEA leadership is empowering partners to drive transformation with Enterprise customers. ​Learn how to align with FY27 priorities. This session will spotlight key initiatives, partner recognition, and actionable next steps to deepen engagement and fuel growth.​
descriptions.1787856655942001EVFB-1791588322880001CY4: AI is changing not just how fast software gets built, but where intelligence runs and how much control developers retain. Mark and Scott explore frontier models, private local inference, agentic coding, and the limits of autonomous system. Through candid debate and live demos, they examine what AI can build today, where it still fails, and how developers can stay in control of what comes next.
descriptions.1787856870784001hIYY-1791820693652001XJV:
Agents are only useful when they can act. Join the Teams Platform team to build one hands-on: scaffold an agent with the Teams SDK, ground it in your data, and give it real reach with Channel Agent + MCP tools. Then go no-code — create an agent-powered workflow in natural language and see how 1P agents like Researcher and Analyst, plus third-party low-code agents, land in Teams. Leave with working code and patterns you can ship. No prior Teams development experience required.

Define resiliency goals for a sample workload, assess readiness against zonal and regional failures, identify gaps against RTO/RPO targets, and apply guided recommendations to improve resiliency. Perform clean-room recovery to restore trusted data after an attack and leave with a practical, repeatable approach using Azure resiliency capabilities and AI-assisted guidance.

descriptions.1790705177215001bKjW-1791912040945001pPf: Get hands-on with local AI model fine-tuning in this beginner-to-intermediate, instructor-led workshop. Using Unsloth on an AMD Ryzen AI Strix Halo laptop, you'll prepare a dataset, format prompts, and work through the fine-tuning pipeline step by step, with no cloud required. Pick up practical tips from industry experts, then put your newly fine-tuned model to the test in a short challenge, all running locally on your machine.
descriptions.1790705299182001YkwU-1791912134700001kpH: An always-on agent is only worth having if you can trust it with real work. In this hands-on lab, you'll build an agent on an AMD Ryzen™ AI PC and define what it can access and do. Use Lemonade Server to keep model calls local across the NPU and GPU, and Microsoft MXC to run the agent in a sandbox with policies you control. You'll use a synthetic dataset and simulated environment to build and experiment with a fun productivity use case.
descriptions.1787856579280001ECS8-1791588327155001CQQ: Rayfin makes it easy to build, connect, and run intelligent applications powered by enterprise data and AI. See how Rayfin brings together Fabric, business data, APIs, functions, and AI models into a single developer experience. Learn how developers and makers can go from idea to production-ready applications, deploy directly from Microsoft Copilot, and create experiences that users can discover, share, and use where work happens every day.
descriptions.1787856582154001EA3N-1791588300382001CDx: Physical AI applications, from robotics to industrial automation, demand infrastructure that runs where the work happens. Azure Local’s small form factor options and Foundry Local bring sovereign AI capabilities to edge and constrained environments, giving organizations the ability to deploy AI close to physical operations while maintaining the same governance and control as their core data center.
descriptions.1787856589705001Eg1g-1791588135518001CNX: Modernizing mission-critical services with AI while maintaining public trust requires more than technology, it requires skilling. Public sector organizations must build workforce confidence and capability as they pursue responsible adoption. In this customer conversation, hear how one organization is navigating these realities, putting employees at the center, and using skilling to accelerate adoption and turn AI ambition into meaningful public impact.
descriptions.1787858599485001SqLO-1791588294858001C7Y: Build on Microsoft’s essential security foundation with a layered approach to zero-payload threats and outbound data leaks, one that understands user communication behaviors, automates with explainable verdict evidence, and calculates a unified Risk Score to measure security program effectiveness. Join to see why Microsoft selected KnowBe4 as an inaugural ICES Vendor Ecosystem partner and ranked KnowBe4 Defend #1 across every reported uplift metric in the 2026 email security benchmark report.
descriptions.1787858599632001ShlA-1791588301277001CQx: Explore key network security challenges across your Azure implementation and beyond. See how cloud firewall functionality delivered as a service through Microsoft Marketplace can support a consistent approach to security. Examine reference architectures, Azure migration in flight, and approaches to securing AI workloads.
descriptions.1787858600081001STy3-1791588347763001CUb: As organizations expand AI adoption on Azure, securing agents, applications, data, and MCP activity across the AI lifecycle becomes increasingly important. Learn how Fortinet security capabilities integrate with Microsoft Azure to strengthen protection from cloud governance through runtime security. See how customers are using Fortinet Security Fabric on Azure to support secure cloud and AI adoption.
descriptions.1787858600372001Sr0J-1791588355011001Cp1: Engineering organizations need to innovate faster while managing increasingly complex simulation workloads. See how Siemens Simcenter X brings trusted engineering applications, scalable HPC, and AI-enabled capabilities to Microsoft Azure. Learn how engineering teams can expand design exploration, use predictive modelling, and make faster, more informed engineering decisions.
descriptions.1787858600514001SR4L-1791588355236001CYk: Recursive self-improvement is a closely scrutinized concept on the AI frontier. But for people building agents, it also presents compelling possibilities: giving agents the opportunity to train against synthetic customers, fix their own tools when they fail, and proactively improve. Napster CTO Edo Segal breaks down how to build AI agents with RSI capabilities responsibly, how RSI can improve agent performance, and what Agentic RSI means for future deployment of AI agents.
descriptions.1787856663504001E7ZU-1791588329442001C5b: Communities succeed because people help people. Learn how agents built on communities, conversations, and organizational knowledge can answer questions, surface expertise, connect people to content, identify trends, and turn conversations into reusable knowledge, while keeping humans at the center. See how these signals power AI experiences like Cowork, Autopilot, Work IQ, and the workplace of the future.
descriptions.1787856676507001E1ap-1791588329664001CRM: Upgrades stall when compatibility and rollback risk aren't proven early. See how to turn your Azure Database for PostgreSQL evaluation for PostgreSQL 19 into a repeatable test plan that checks extensions, performance, operations, and rollback. Build a move first shortlist.
descriptions.1787856678978001EXBG-1791588329888001C6T: Rising hardware costs are forcing organizations to rethink the traditional PC refresh. In this demo-heavy session, see how Windows 365 Boot can give existing devices a new role, and how Cloud PC devices like Windows 365 Link can provide a simple and secure way to connect to Windows 365. Learn how to reuse what you have, replace differently, and get more from every hardware investment.
descriptions.1787856682086001E3ts-1791588330774001C0H: Serverless is an architecture decision, not just a deployment target. This session covers practical patterns for building agent-ready serverless apps on Azure Container Apps and tuning them for microVM-backed compute from scale-to-zero and cold-start behavior to right-sizing CPU and memory for per-second billing, isolation boundaries for untrusted and agent-generated code, and snapshot and resume for stateful work. Leave with patterns you can apply to your own workloads.
descriptions.1787856691080001ESgI-1791934184420001JzQ: Agents are appearing across Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Foundry, and third-party platforms. Learn how to move from agent inventory to governed operations using Agent 365 and a practical governance framework. Through real-world scenarios, you'll see where Agent 365 provides visibility and control, where additional platform controls remain essential, and how to prioritize governance as your agent estate grows.
descriptions.1787856693605001EVSB-1791588303068001CnC:
SharePoint Skills let users turn repeatable tasks, document reviews, metadata tagging, content summarization, information extraction, into reusable AI experiences anyone with the right permissions can run. Just faster, more consistent results.
In this fast-paced session, we'll cover the essentials: what Skills are, how they work, where they live, and who can create, manage, and use them. Then we'll move straight into live demos, showing you how to build Skills that solve real business problems.
descriptions.1787856576078001Ecnk-1791588289790001Cnq: You don't have a tool problem. You have an integration problem — every agent team wiring the same MCP servers, APIs, and credentials over again. See how Toolboxes in Foundry unifies MCP servers, OpenAPI services, A2A agents, built-in tools, and skills behind a single MCP contract any framework can call. Change tools without touching agent code, send the model 3 relevant tools instead of 127, and govern identity, policy, and audit in one place.
descriptions.1787856578081001EXvd-1791588265786001CtD: Learn what developers need to know when moving from Grounding with Bing to Web IQ. This practical session will explain what changes, how to approach the transition, and how to start building with Web IQ. It will bring together migration guidance, a concise product walkthrough, and answers to common implementation questions, giving attendees a clear path forward and access to Web IQ experts.
descriptions.1787856581551001ERGj-1791588331232001CPV: Plan, manage, and optimize cloud spend with AI for FinOps. Discover how Azure Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and coding agents bring cost insights, investigation, estimation, and optimization guidance into the tools you use every day—right where decisions are made. Through real-world scenarios, learn how to identify idle and underused resources, forecast costs before code ships, and use agentic workflows to turn cost signals into action for engineering and FinOps teams alike.
descriptions.1787856661437001ES5N-1791588330328001CLz: Customers in regulated industries and government clouds often face a tradeoff between AI innovation and compliance requirements. Discover how compliant web search enables Microsoft Copilot to safely access and ground responses in web content while supporting privacy, compliance, and sovereignty needs. Learn how compliant web search help you unlock web-connected AI experiences with the controls and confidence required for highly regulated environments.
descriptions.1787856672510001E9Sd-1791588348917001CDg: In this session we will walk through two scenarios that leverage agents to prioritize and remediate posture in Project Perception.
descriptions.1787856688753001EBP9-1791588330993001CyP: AI transformation requires more than a technology strategy. It requires leaders to make clear decisions about where AI can deliver value, how work and accountability may evolve, and what the organization needs to scale. This session explores leadership practices for moving from AI experimentation toward broader organizational adoption.​
descriptions.1787856691250001EuoX-1791588330107001Cf9: For extremely sensitive (for ex Federal govt.) data, the answer is disconnected workloads and monitored agents. In this session, we build a complete on-prem agentic system live: Microsoft Foundry Local for inference (with Ollama for vision), a pipeline that stops misusing the LLM for OCR, action through MCP tools, and kernel-enforced containment with MXC (preview feature). Then we pull the cable real time and it still works. We will discuss run-time selection matrix, edge and local architecture.
descriptions.1787858600958001SAMQ-1791588328988001Cbb: AI agents are gaining greater autonomy, but treating them only as software can limit how we think about trust and control. Organizations have faced this problem before: How do you delegate real authority without giving up control? The answer may already exist in a place few AI teams are looking. Explore an unexpected model for thinking differently about AI agents and the authority we give them.
descriptions.1787854975641001tFYp-1791588165825001CNW:
Voice agents are expanding well beyond the contact center. This interactive discussion explores emerging use cases across internal copilots, enterprise workflows and multimodal experiences that combine voice, text and reasoning. Join the conversation on conversational design, developer tooling, speech-enabled workflows and the practical challenges organizations face when adopting voice-first experiences at scale.

Building a multi-agent AI system? The hard part isn't the agents — it's the data layer underneath. In this 45-minute table talk, let's compare how we handle memory, conversation history, shared state, and retrieval when many agents run at once. We'll debate short- vs long-term memory, isolating each agent's context while sharing world state, grounding agents in live data, and scaling to thousands of sessions. Bring your architecture and questions and share ideas with the Cosmos DB team.

Organizations can deploy Copilot, but deployment alone doesn't create adoption. The opportunity is helping employees discover where Copilot can make their work easier, see meaningful early wins, and learn from one another. In this interactive table talk, we'll explore what organizations are seeing as they move from Copilot seats to Copilot usage. Participants will share what's working, where adoption is getting stuck, and practical ways to build stronger AI habits across their organizations.

descriptions.1792115960878001uLL6-1792437604498001DQq: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.​
descriptions.1787856581384001EMGH-1791588248872001CQi: Watch an AI-guided experience turn your requirements into a secure, resilient, and scalable Azure landing zone in minutes. See how agentic deployment applies governance and Microsoft best practices, reduces manual effort and configuration risk and creates a reliable cloud foundation that helps teams migrate faster and scale with confidence.
descriptions.1787856582007001EDno-1791588290449001CWk: Resilience isn't proven by design alone, it must be validated. Join us to see how Azure Chaos Studio is evolving beyond fault injection to enable continuous resilience validation. Through new AKS testing capabilities and emerging agent-driven operational experiences, learn how teams uncover hidden weaknesses, validate recovery strategies, and build confidence that critical applications can withstand real-world disruptions.
descriptions.1787856592525001ENZL-1791588293767001Ckr: You already know infrastructure, networking, storage, and HA. In 25 minutes, we'll map what you know to its Kubernetes equivalent — VM to pod, load balancer to Service, disks to PersistentVolumes — so AKS feels like an evolution, not a reset.
descriptions.1787856921997001hBZj-1791588318405001CEy: Organizations are deploying AI agents faster than they can govern them. Unlike traditional apps, agents can reason, act, and interact across systems. In this fast-paced session, learn how to govern agents across Microsoft 365, Entra, Purview, and Foundry before they become your next security and compliance headache. Leave with a practical framework to answer: Who owns it, what can it access, how is it monitored, and who can shut it down?
descriptions.1787858600227001ShOV-1791588347984001CVc: Security teams face noisy, growing telemetry volumes, a challenge accelerated by AI workloads, increasing data-ingestion costs and slowing investigations. See how Cribl Stream filters and enriches security data in motion, sending only clean, high-value signals to Microsoft Sentinel. Then learn how AI-powered investigations with Cribl Search connect to Microsoft Copilot, giving analysts a faster, more complete path from signal to answer.
descriptions.1787856664277001EvZO-1791588330550001Cpx: AI is moving beyond responding to prompts toward understanding you and your work. Learn how Work IQ memory helps Copilot retain what matters and build understanding over time, while Work IQ context grounds each interaction in the information most relevant to the work at hand. See how memory and context work together to deliver more relevant, personalized responses that move your work forward and drive better business outcomes.
descriptions.1787856674359001EoYx-1791588301722001Cds: Regulatory demands are outpacing evidence. Understand how Microsoft Purview turns global AI and data requirements into assigned actions, operating protections, and reviewable records across data security, insider risk, and compliance management.
descriptions.1787856679747001EfAI-1791588313889001CeB: AI agents are changing how work gets done. Learn how Windows uses MXC to provide containment, policy enforcement, and governance for agents across Windows 11 and Windows 365, creating a trusted runtime for AI.
descriptions.1787856681271001ESHF-1791588333537001Cof: Discover how Azure Confidential Enclaves enable highly sensitive cryptographic operations and confidential workloads in isolated, hardware-backed environments. Learn how confidential VMs, enclaves, and containers protect critical data and code while supporting demanding scenarios such as payment processing, digital trust, identity verification, and secure transactions. See how organizations can strengthen security and compliance without compromising performance or scale.
descriptions.1787856684388001EryF-1791588333764001Cg6: Which AI investments deliver measurable value on the factory floor? This session uses new research conducted by Microsoft with IoT Analytics to show how manufacturers are applying AI across asset maintenance, production optimization, exception response, frontline guidance, and operational knowledge. Learn which scenarios can improve throughput, uptime, quality, and workforce productivity, what separates scaled deployments from pilots, and how to prioritize investments across factory operations.
descriptions.1787856687557001EJTg-1791588333991001Cqt: AI is reshaping how customers choose partners. Explore how the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program is evolving to help partners differentiate and grow across Cloud & AI Platform and Healthcare. Learn about in-demand capabilities, emerging specialization pathways, and new investments supporting cloud innovation and AI transformation. Gain insights to align your capabilities, demonstrate greater value, and accelerate growth in the AI era.
descriptions.1787856691553001EEve-1791588334211001CQH: Build apps, sites, automations, AI experiences, and complete business solutions in minutesùnot days. Explore how Agentic AI, Power Platform, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, MCP servers, and AI Skills are transforming software development. Through practical demos, discover how AI can accelerate solution design, generate data models and workflows, orchestrate business logic, and deliver enterprise-grade solutions while maintaining governance, security, and scalability.
descriptions.1787856692370001EF2V-1791588334435001C2a: See what GitHub Copilot can do when given real Azure architecture and security requirements. This code-led session builds a Bicep solution for a secure workload, then examines the generated modules, parameters, identities, networking, and deployment configuration. Learn how to detect omissions, correct unsafe assumptions, and validate AI-generated infrastructure before deployment.
descriptions.1790726600151001gonb-1791934177911001MNR: The bar has been raised for earning Microsoft Security Specializations, with partners needing to pass a third-party audit. Join this panel to learn what's changing, where partners commonly fall short, and how to prepare before timelines become compressed. Experts who've helped 40+ partners through specialization audits will share guidance on documentation, customer evidence, operational readiness, and audit preparation.
descriptions.1787856606537001E7eU-1791588336053001C2T: As Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility grows, governance can get complex. Learn how the Copilot plugin registry creates one source of truth for plugins, connectors, MCP servers, skills, and agents across Chat, Cowork, Scout, Code, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. See how unified publishing, approval, security, and governance help IT reduce overhead, improve discovery, and scale trusted AI innovation.
descriptions.1787856612311001EcDa-1791588242520001CJu: Deterministic and non-deterministic thinking are the core of why Copilot Studio enables mixing Workflows and Agents. See how we're taking this to the next level with new workflow authoring experiences, integration with agents, and enhanced reliability.
descriptions.1787856612609001ExWS-1791588098847001C5f: Visibility into AI spend is just the beginning. Learn how leading organizations optimize investments across IT, business leaders, makers, and end users. Discover how new capabilities, help you manage costs, prove value, and scale the AI initiatives that deliver the biggest results.
descriptions.1787856615724001Em6f-1791588336956001Cip: Coding agents can write code in minutes. Security teams need confidence that both the agent and its output can be trusted. Learn how GitHub helps organizations secure agent-driven development with isolated sandboxes, protections against supply chain threats, and automated validation of AI-generated code before deployment. Discover how to scale the use of coding agents while maintaining security and governance across the development lifecycle.
descriptions.1787856615873001Ew1V-1791588337175001CYi: With agentic development, developers are shipping faster than ever, while attackers are rapidly shrinking the window from public disclosure to exploitation. Security teams can't review every change, and headcount won't scale. See how GitHub Advanced Security uses AI to extend your reach: scanning surfaces multi-step exploits, secret scanning with push protection stops leaked credentials, and Agentic Autofix delivers fixes as ready-to-merge PRs.
descriptions.1787856619788001EmTv-1791588337631001CRr: Enterprise AI does not have one cost model. It has three: people, consumption, and capacity. Through a retail AI scenario and a live cost estimation demo, this session shows how Work IQ, Foundry IQ, Fabric IQ, and Web IQ create different cost shapes, and how to optimize each one for scale, value, and control.
descriptions.1787856623106001EMAS-1791588131744001CwD: As AI accelerates access to information, organizations need stronger protections for sensitive data. Learn how Microsoft Purview combines classification, permissions insights, and controls to reduce oversharing and secure data across AI.
descriptions.1787856624031001EWH5-1791588353204001CkJ: Before deploying Copilot broadly, Microsoft focused on the fundamentals: understanding sensitive data, managing access, reducing oversharing, and establishing governance. Learn the strategies and lessons from our AI readiness journey.
descriptions.1787856624637001E5B5-1791588217692001Cy4: Local agents can unlock major productivity, but unmanaged adoption introduces risk leaders cannot ignore. Learn how to close the visibility gap, reduce risk, and enable trusted agent adoption without slowing innovation.
descriptions.1787856632105001EFPk-1791588118374001CWB: Modernizing CRM and ERP doesn't have to take months. See how AI-powered agents can automate discovery, assessment, configuration, and migration tasks to accelerate moves from legacy platforms to Dynamics 365. Learn from customers about how they are using agentic migration to reduce effort, increase confidence, and modernize faster.
descriptions.1787856633035001ES8o-1791588216792001COC: Windows 11 offers a suite of developer productivity tools designed to accelerate coding workflows and to align with enterprise IT priorities. You will learn about new experiences coming to Windows Terminal, PowerToys, and WSL boosting productivity.
descriptions.1787856638991001ERxL-1791814913627001CdR: Cloud infrastructure is entering a new era driven by AI, custom silicon, and intelligent automation. Join us for a strategic look at the latest Azure Compute innovations and how they are helping organizations prepare for the future. Learn how Azure is evolving its compute platform to support emerging AI workloads, improve workload efficiency, simplify operations, and provide the scalability required for the next generation of digital transformation.
descriptions.1787856644012001EVfQ-1791588338991001CX5: Localization, QC, versioning, rights, and fulfillment are where media velocity dies, and where agents deliver the fastest measurable return. With Kantar as the anchor example, we show what agentic operations look like at production scale, with live demos of first-party agent-to-agent workflows built on Microsoft Agent Framework and Foundry. We'll cover open A2A and MCP standards, agent observability, and cost and reliability at scale so operations teams keep control as autonomy increases.
descriptions.1787856647502001ERx1-1791588334689001C7J: Great AI starts with great data. As SMB customers prepare for AI adoption, database modernization has become one of the fastest-growing opportunities for partners. Learn how Azure helps customers modernize SQL workloads while reducing risk and preserving existing investments. We'll explore the partner opportunity across migration, modernization, and managed services, how to lead the customer conversation, and the Microsoft investments available to accelerate your practice.​
descriptions.1787856647812001EaqH-1791588339213001CrD: The SMB market is moving fast, and AI is reshaping how partners win, serve, and grow their customers. Building on Microsoft's cross-solution approach to customer engagement, this session explores what it takes to lead in the SMB space and how successful partners are adapting to meet rising customer demand. Join Microsoft leaders and partners to see how a unified SMB conversation turns AI ambition into durable customer growth — and to learn a repeatable way to capture the opportunity ahead.​
descriptions.1787856651272001EUOu-1791588335150001Cc9: AI is reshaping the partner ecosystem. Discover how MAICPP Frontier offers help Channel and Services Partners to build differentiated AI practices, demonstrate expertise, and accelerate growth. Learn how the Frontier Transformation Engineer badge and Agentic Partner Capability Score highlights AI readiness and capability, how Frontier Specializations recognize advanced partners, and how these innovations help you stand out, win more opportunities, and lead in the AI economy.​
descriptions.1787856656838001EYVA-1791588339439001CQH: The demo worked. Then real users, real data and real consequences showed up. Join Scott Hanselman and four customer practitioners for a candid conversation about what it takes to make AI useful beyond the happy path: getting the right context, knowing when an answer is wrong, deciding what an agent is allowed to do, and keeping the experience reliable and responsive. Hear the tradeoffs behind systems customers already use, what the teams changed along the way, and what they would do differently. No slides or polished customer pitches - just practitioners comparing notes.
descriptions.1792115999448001q9dC-1792437797169001eQx: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.​
descriptions.1787856662410001E1wm-1791588340113001CnV: Work happens everywhere, and OneDrive is evolving to help you stay productive wherever you are. Explore the latest OneDrive experiences across web and mobile, designed to help you quickly find, organize, and act on content from any device. See new innovations, real-world productivity scenarios, and how OneDrive helps you stay connected, streamline tasks, and work smarter across Microsoft 365.
descriptions.1787856670825001Eh64-1791588340336001CDw: Meet Work IQ Dev Tools (WIQD) and see the plugin developer lifecycle in action. Build, validate and publish a Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork plugin through a streamlined developer experience, from project scaffolding to organizational sharing.
descriptions.1787856672207001EWPs-1791588341011001Cnt: Have questions about Microsoft Threat Intelligence? Join an interactive discussion with product experts. Dive deeper into architecture, capabilities, and use cases. Bring your toughest questions and we'll answer them live with demos and real examples.
descriptions.1787856679584001EUvo-1791588341239001Cwe: When devices fail to boot or business-critical incidents disrupt productivity, IT teams need recovery options that are fast, scalable, and secure. In this session, we’ll share the latest enhancements in Windows recovery capabilities and how organizations can quickly recover affected devices.
descriptions.1787856684077001Evi6-1791588341480001CfL: Most organizations have run the pilot. Far fewer are running AI in production against their own data — in telecommunications, just 29% are ready to scale AI on their data, with skills and cost cited as the barriers. In 15 minutes, we'll look at what separates the ready from the stalled: end-to-end visibility across customer, service, and operational data; a common business context that agents can actually reason over; and a data foundation built to scale rather than to demo.
descriptions.1787856689070001E5ie-1791588341702001CFX: Moving an AI agent from pilot to production is more than a technical decision. Leaders need to consider how the organization will operate, govern, and scale agents as they become part of business processes. Learn the key questions leaders should consider across business value, risk, accountability, data, and operational readiness before moving agents into production, and how to develop a repeatable approach for moving from experimentation toward broader organizational adoption. ​
descriptions.1787856695133001E8tJ-1791588341918001CFw: In addition to a SIEM, which is reactive, every shop needs insight into misconfiguration issues and compliance risks in the cloud--a logical extension of Zero Trust policies. Learn how the multi-cloud features of Defender for Cloud integrated with Defender XDR continuously monitors cloud infrastructure including DevOps platforms for gaps in security policy enforcement across all clouds and all platforms. Leverage agentless vulnerability scanning, secrets scanning, and Security Copilot plug-ins.
descriptions.1787856584566001ECtm-1791588342148001C3O: BNY and Microsoft FDE have built a secure agent-to-agent negotiation network in which software agents can discover counterparties and negotiate within human-defined objectives, risk limits, and approval controls. Initial use case is Microsoft Treasury trading with BNY, with future applicability to FX, repo, collateral, and legal agreements.
descriptions.1787856587203001Eq14-1791588290888001C6Q: As sovereignty expands beyond data residency to jurisdiction, proof, AI governance, and resiliency, customers are rethinking cloud and AI. Explore the four shifts redefining sovereignty, Microsoft’s approach to Sovereign Cloud and Sovereign AI, and how partners can address regulatory, geopolitical, and AI-era needs. Learn where EMEA opportunities are emerging and how to turn thought leadership into pipeline.
descriptions.1787856589237001E1WX-1791588087938001Cz5: A new study reveals why some organizations create value with AI faster than others. Explore insights from Microsoft's Total Economic Impact™ study on workforce readiness, adoption, and business outcomes, and learn what helps turn AI investments into measurable results.
descriptions.1787856598732001EBiO-1791588247726001Cjz: Every community leader starts somewhere—helping a colleague, joining a user group, sharing what they've learned, finding a mentor, becoming a champion, or taking the leap to speak for the first time. Hear real stories from people who turned those moments into opportunities to lead, connect others, and create impact. Whether you're an AI champion, aspiring speaker, community organizer, MVP candidate, or simply looking for your next step, you'll leave with practical ideas for growing your influence, building your network, sharing your expertise, and finding your place in the Microsoft community.
descriptions.1787856600124001EIJS-1791926728345001MSA: Join Microsoft product teams, MVPs, and developer advocates for a live discussion on the latest Microsoft Foundry updates. We'll cover new capabilities, share real-world insights, answer community questions, and discuss what's next for developers building AI applications and agents. Bring your questions, connect with experts, and leave with practical ideas you can apply immediately.
descriptions.1787858600661001SjTP-1791588317934001CLp: Organizations have more customer data than ever, but turning insight into action remains complex. Bring customer experience intelligence into the flow of work with Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Discover how AI can bring customer context into the flow of human ambition, helping teams accelerate decisions, coordinate action, and turn customer intelligence into action.
descriptions.1787858600812001SVTr-1791588301500001Cjn: AI has been improving meeting experiences since before most of us heard of ChatGPT or Copilot. But now it’s moving beyond the room itself and giving IT admins a new set of tools. See how it’s changing the in-room experience and walk through how it’s giving IT greater visibility and control.
descriptions.1787858601261001SCVJ-1791588333075001CCl: Your AI agents need more than data. They need trusted data and the enterprise context that gives it meaning. In this fast-paced, demo-first session, see how Informatica and Microsoft work together to deliver both. Watch an agent built in Microsoft Foundry explore business definitions, lineage, and governance before it ever touches the data. Then go behind the scenes to see how Informatica's deep Microsoft Fabric integrations provide the trusted data and context that make it possible.
descriptions.1787856870612001hIPz-1791820466076001iPn:
Learn how to transform content into organizational knowledge and put AI to work across your team. You'll use Copilot in SharePoint to organize information, enrich content with metadata, create pages and reports, build reusable skills, and automate common processes. Along the way, you'll see how better-organized knowledge helps strengthen Copilot experiences across Microsoft 365. Leave with practical techniques you can apply immediately to build a modern, AI-powered knowledge workspace.

Copilot Connectors securely bring your enterprise data into Copilot, grounding experiences in the information that matters most to your organization. In this hands-on lab, you’ll discover and acquire connectors, connect trusted data sources, and use interactive experiences, skills, and actions to make informed decisions and complete real-world workflows. Explore these end-to-end scenarios across finance, legal, engineering, and productivity

Use ASSERT to generate evaluations and test data from requirements, create scoring criteria with Rubrics, and implement controls with Agent Control Specification (ACS). Then use Microsoft Foundry observability, tracing, and evaluation signals to identify improvements, measure results, and iterate toward higher quality, lower cost, and safer outcomes.

AI is transforming how people work, but secure adoption starts with a strong foundation. In this hands-on lab, assess your security posture and apply Zero Trust principles across identities, devices, threats, and data. Gain practical experience strengthening access controls, reducing risk, protecting sensitive information, and responding to threats. Leave with the skills to build an AI-ready security foundation that enables confident AI adoption.

Build the skills to run multi-tenant isolated AI workloads in production. You will place a workload in the right isolation boundary for user separation, contain untrusted code, scale from zero, right size CPU and memory for per second billing, and snapshot and resume sessions so stateful work can continue. Everything runs on Azure Container Apps with microVM-backed compute. Leave with a decision tree and patterns you can apply to your own workloads.
