descriptions.1787856668173001EZrd-1791588344146001Cdy: Modern AI development requires more than models. Foundry Toolkit brings together development, testing, deployment and management experiences in one workflow. Discover how developers can accelerate agent engineering, connect tools and services, iterate faster, and reduce friction between local experimentation and enterprise deployment. Ideal for teams building production-ready AI applications at scale.
descriptions.1787856674663001Epme-1791588344372001CPi: Microsoft OneLake is designed to help you unify your data estate on a secure, AI-ready foundation. In this theater session, we'll highlight how you can use zero-copy, zero-ETL tools in OneLake to connect your data estate, and fuel AI experiences in Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, and Microsoft Copilot.
descriptions.1787856682385001EPQw-1791588344595001CN1: Watch a code repository become a live production grade application in under a minute. This session shows a code-first and agent-first workflow where build, deployment, branch and pull request environments, common application services and operational feedback all live in one place. See what developers and coding agents can ship together, how teams keep control while iterating, and how a simple start extends cleanly as requirements grow.
descriptions.1787856693133001Eq2Y-1791588345065001CNj: Deploying Microsoft 365 Copilot is only the first step. How do you know users are getting real value? In this session, learn practical strategies to drive adoption, measure impact, and help employees move from occasional use to daily productivity gains. We'll explore proven approaches for identifying high-value scenarios, building effective habits, and demonstrating ROI. You'll also see how capabilities like SharePoint agents and Agent Builder can further enhance the Copilot experience.
descriptions.1787856694220001Evhy-1791588345286001C23: You've spent years building semantic models ù but Fabric IQ Ontology asks for something different: entities, relationships, rules, and data bindings that ground AI agents in what your business actually means, not just what your tables contain. In 15 minutes, see a live before/after ù a hand-built lineage layer versus what ontology gives natively ù and get a straight answer to "do I need this yet?"
descriptions.1787856702748001EKHM-1791588345516001Cah:
Leadership doesn't always begin with a title. Sometimes it starts by answering a question, helping someone make a connection, volunteering, or creating space for someone else's idea.
A personal look at what working alongside community leaders and Microsoft MVPs can teach us about influence, trust, leadership, and impact.
descriptions.1787856703997001E4XT-1791588345742001Ctp: See how MVPs repurpose one strong idea into blog posts, talks, workshops, demos, and community resources for different audiences and skill levels.
descriptions.1792116040524001uzpA-1792437824353001DT9: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.​
descriptions.1787856576528001ECW6-1791588277197001Cmo: Every AI request pays for a prefill phase before it generates a single token, and most production apps recompute the same system prompts, tool definitions, and retrieved context on every turn. Prompt caching removes that waste.In this session, learn how prompt caching reduce AI application cost and latency while increasing throughput, and how to pick the right Azure OpenAI caching strategy for your workload, from automatic to fully managed.
descriptions.1787856596697001EuAn-1791588259340001CUL: Built on practical experience and proven best practices gathered since the early days of Microsoft 365, this end-to-end live demo shows how Microsoft Entra, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview, and Copilot security controls work together to create a productive and secure workplace. Gain a practical birdÆs-eye view of the Microsoft security ecosystem and understand how its technologies complement each other rather than operate as isolated products.
descriptions.1787856597469001EExW-1791588327847001C3u:
Soaring renewal quotes. Multi-year lock-ins. All-you-can-eat licenses that leave a bitter after-taste. When private-equity-owned EUC vendors rewrite the rules, your IT budget can quickly become their growth strategy.
This is the real-world story of a 12k-seat renewal that became a six-month migration race. Learn how we HDeXited, How Windows 365 provided the escape route, and the practical decisions, trade-offs, and lessons that got us out.
descriptions.1787856601105001EEot-1791588257574001Cxw: Building agents is only the first step. Sustainable adoption requires a community that helps people learn, experiment, share reusable practices, and move successful ideas forward. Explore how community-led agent building can create momentum for Copilot Studio, connect makers with experts, surface high-value scenarios, and help organizations scale agent adoption with greater confidence.
descriptions.1787858597857001SSQT-1791814920122001CNQ: Discover how Azure Databricks helps AI systems understand your business context, identify authoritative sources, and deliver trusted, governed answers grounded in your organization's data. From conversational analytics to autonomous AI agents and application development, see how teams can put trusted intelligence directly into Microsoft Teams and the tools they already use.
descriptions.1787858599777001SFDY-1791588347539001CKU: As Azure environments evolve, managed identities, role assignments, and network rules can accumulate long after their original purpose. AI gives attackers new ways to discover and exploit that access faster. See how to flip the model: compare configured access with observed access, define what should exist, and enforce it across identity and network, removing entire attack paths without breaking production.
descriptions.1787856610200001EYMD-1791587924228001FSU: Voice is the fastest-growing way people use agents, and the hardest to put in production. Voice-first agents in Microsoft Foundry give you one place to build a speech-native agent, ship it to web, mobile, Teams and telephony, and operate it with audio-aware tracing and evaluation. We'll cover what ships, how it differs from voice-enabling a text agent, and what enterprise customers are running today.
descriptions.1787856612459001EfZu-1791588174633001COA: Go behind the build of the new GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio. Learn how hooks, skills, multi-agent orchestration, models, context, and tools come together to power complex, long-running agents, and explore the Azure container architecture that underpins the runtime. See how this architecture helps organizations create agents that are more capable, reliable, reusable, and secure, while providing a durable foundation that evolves with AI models and business needs.
descriptions.1787856616168001EPp9-1791588352303001Cj3: Build AI apps and agents that are ready for production from day one. Learn an end-to-end approach for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry. See how Azure AI Landing Zones provide a proven architectural foundation and extensible implementation that accelerates infrastructure deployment and application development for AI solutions. Then explore how Foundry Models, Agent Service, Tools, Control Plane and Microsoft IQ come together.
descriptions.1787856616477001EQQz-1791588353428001C9V: GitHub Actions workflows can access credentials, networks, and production systems, making them high-value software supply chain targets. Using an attack-path map and before-and-after demos, we'll show how to defend against pull_request_target misuse, floating action refs, cache poisoning, over-permissioned credentials, widened trust boundaries, and open egress. You'll leave able to audit workflows, pin and scope what runs, contain blast radius, and expose malicious behavior.
descriptions.1787856617981001EHsD-1791588173465001CwI: Trust is the foundation of enterprise AI. Explore the governance controls that help administrators secure and scale Work IQ across apps and agents. Learn how to manage data access, apply policy controls, monitor consumption, and optimize costs so teams can innovate with confidence while maintaining security, compliance, and oversight.
descriptions.1787856620707001EyJO-1791588352983001C0o: Explore how agentic orchestration can transform incident management in production AIOps. This session examines how AI agents coordinate investigations, connect operational signals, and support human decisions. Discover practical design patterns, implementation challenges, and lessons for building reliable, responsible workflows that help teams respond to incidents more effectively.
descriptions.1787856622798001EzDM-1791588217247001C7C: Your teams are drowning in findings while attackers need one path. See the new Microsoft Security Exposure Management experience map frontline threat intelligence to your exposures, validate what's real, and produce an agent-assisted, risk-ranked plan of action.
descriptions.1787856624787001Ez7r-1791588351389001CNy: AI agents are the next attack surface. Learn how Microsoft Defender helps apply Zero Trust, reduce agent risk, and defend against AI attacks such as prompt injection, tool misuse, and identity abuse, with guidance mapped to OWASP and MITRE.
descriptions.1787856625561001EjZQ-1791588351635001CIY: AI agents are multiplying across organizations. Without the right governance foundation, it becomes difficult to know which agents exist, who owns them, what they can access, and whether they're operating as intended. Learn how Agent 365 helps organizations govern AI agents at scale with centralized oversight, accountability, policy and tools management, and lifecycle governance. Through practical examples and demos, learn how to confidently manage, govern, and secure a growing agent ecosystem.
descriptions.1787856626929001EC2l-1791588350937001C0T: Learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse workloads to Microsoft Fabric. This session covers migration strategy, workload assessment, pipeline and dataflow modernization, warehouse and lakehouse patterns, CI/CD, governance, customer case studies and operational best practices to reduce risk and accelerate analytics and AI on Fabric.
descriptions.1787856630041001EHZe-1791814912444001Caz: Applications need fast, reliable data access as demand grows. Sitecore, a global content and digital experience provider, built Content Hub to govern, structure, and distribute content and assets across digital channels. Sitecore will share how it uses Azure Managed Redis to support Azure Kubernetes Service-based workloads and complement database-backed applications. Explore caching patterns, practical guidance, and agent kit resources to improve performance and scalability.
descriptions.1787856631314001Eynh-1791814918515001Csp: Building a solution is only the beginning. Learn how to deploy, govern, and operate Power Platform solutions at enterprise scale. Explore strategies for environments, application lifecycle management, security, monitoring, and administration that help IT maintain control while enabling makers and developers to move quickly.
descriptions.1787856632886001EI37-1791588350267001CNO: Help your organization's applications stay secure, compatible, and deployable at scale. Learn how Baseline Security Mode, service deprivileging, NTLM-to-Kerberos migration, code signing, and Admin Protection can strengthen security while reducing support and future migration costs.
descriptions.1787856633795001E6cQ-1791587923965001FkP: Microsoft is enabling resiliency across physical devices and Cloud PCs. Explore how we’re securing the driver ecosystem, delivering Windows recovery innovations, and enabling Windows 365 Reserve to reduce downtime and accelerate recovery.
descriptions.1787856637461001ETKM-1791588350040001CQC: Serving open-weight models, post-training on new data, and running agents that take action each place different demands on GPUs, isolation, and cost. This session shows how Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and open source give platform teams control across all three: scaling GPU capacity, serving models, and isolating agents, with Ray for distributed post-training and MCP for connecting agents to tools. Hear how a customer runs AI in production on AKS and leave with patterns for your own tenant.
descriptions.1787856638070001EJmp-1791588351856001C2t: Hybrid is an operating model, not just a step on the way to cloud. Microsoft and Red Hat share their unified vision for Red Hat workloads on Azure, including what’s available today and what’s coming next across virtualization, cloud economics, and hosted control planes. Hear how joint engineering is simplifying hybrid operations, anchored by Goethe-Institut’s real-world modernization journey with Azure Red Hat OpenShift.
descriptions.1787856638839001EFeZ-1791588352078001C1s: The rise of AI and hybrid environments is redefining enterprise security. The new security perimeter is no longer the network. It's the infrastructure stack itself. Explore how Azure IaaS delivers a defense-in-depth approach spanning compute, storage, networking, identity and operations to help organizations protect their most critical workloads. Learn why leading enterprises are taking a system-level approach to security and how Azure helps them stay secure while embracing AI-driven innovation.
descriptions.1787856640822001EOGB-1791814917804001CM5: Learn how the recent Quantum news (embargoed) relates to agentic scientific R&D and our emerging Microsoft Discovery platform. Understand how customers are utilizing Discovery to push their scientific development and how it could accelerate your business.
descriptions.1787856649769001EzGq-1791588306895001C71: The opportunity for Dynamics 365 Business Central partners has never been bigger. Learn how to build or expand a Business Central practice using Microsoft investments, incentives, sales resources, AI capabilities, and partner-to-partner opportunities. Discover how partners are accelerating customer acquisition, increasing deal velocity, and unlocking new revenue streams with Business Central, Copilot, and agents. Walk away with practical resources and next steps to grow your business in FY27.​
descriptions.1787856650665001EBIO-1791588174165001CdN: Microsoft is rebuilding the partner experience around AI — and it is shipping now. See a live, end-to-end walkthrough of the AI-enabled partner journey: agentic co-sell in Partner Center, context-aware sales and upsell recommendations, and AI-guided benefits and licensing, and a personalized Partner 360 front door across Partner Portal and Partner Center. Hear how partners use these experiences to grow pipeline and cut cycle times — and how to build your own agents on the foundation.​
descriptions.1787856652650001E9Ew-1791588245733001Cg8: Learn how clinical ISVs launch solutions, integrate with Dragon Copilot, and publish through Microsoft Marketplace. Follow GW RhythmX’s journey from publishing a vetted solution to certification, deployment, and first clinical use. Discover how Microsoft Marketplace accelerates impact in healthcare by helping innovative solutions reach providers and patients faster. Hear firsthand how it simplifies integration, compliance, and deployment—creating value for partners and Dragon Copilot customers.​
descriptions.1787856654883001EYY7-1791588217020001C3I: Leaders should not have to choose between AI innovation and enterprise risk management. This session explores an approach for aligning AI initiatives with organizational risk appetite and identifying governance and security capabilities that can support adoption. Learn how leaders can establish clear guardrails that accelerate adoption, strengthen trust, and give teams the confidence to innovate at scale. ​
descriptions.1787856575778001Efqr-1791588265104001Cdc: As organizations move from AI-assisted productivity to AI agents, security and governance become essential. In this demo-driven session, discover how Microsoft protects both Microsoft Copilot and enterprise AI agents. Through real-world scenarios, see how teams can discover AI activity, enforce policies, safeguard sensitive data, monitor agent behavior, investigate risks, and maintain control at scale. Leave with practical guidance for building a secure, compliant, and governable AI foundation.
descriptions.1787856582609001E7gr-1791588180641001C7V: As AI usage grows across applications and agents, costs can become difficult to predict and manage. Learn how AI Gateway helps platform teams understand and control AI consumption using centralized visibility, token quotas, rate limits, semantic caching, and intelligent routing. See how to apply FinOps controls directly in the AI runtime to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support AI adoption at scale.
descriptions.1787856586584001EOhk-1791588249091001CIv: The AI gold rush is here. The question is no longer Can you build it? It's Can you monetize it? Discover how leading partners are turning AI curiosity into measurable business outcomes. Learn how they’re building repeatable offerings, AI-powered IP, and agentic solutions that unlock new revenue streams. We’ll share practical playbooks, lessons learned, and proven strategies to help you get started and successfully package, sell and scale AI solutions that drive growth and deliver customer value.
descriptions.1787856595933001EDe5-1791588266445001Cif: Build a customer-retention agent that turns Fabric data into action. Train a churn model with Fabric Machine Learning, enrich customer feedback at scale with AI Functions, and expose governed business context through a Fabric Data Agent and Fabric IQ, part of Microsoft IQ. Add an Agent Skill for investigation and escalation, then connect the pieces in Microsoft Foundry. See how predictions, semantic context, and reusable workflows combine to help agents reason and act on trusted enterprise data.
descriptions.1787856597161001Ep4M-1791588278118001Ckh: AI agents don't just read enterprise data anymore. They act on it. In this fast-paced investigation, we follow a risky agent interaction from prompt to tool execution, then use Microsoft Purview to block sensitive data, trace agent activity, and reconstruct what happened with Audit and eDiscovery. You'll leave knowing which controls matter before, during, and after an agent acts.
descriptions.1787856597314001Ery9-1791588317023001CW6: Your most important business system is fifteen years old, has no API, and nobody will sign off replacing it. So people do the clicking. Windows 365 for Agents changes that. The agent checks out a real Entra-joined, Intune-managed Cloud PC, does the work a person would, and hands it back. I will show an agent we built and now run internally that stands up projects across three systems, then build the same pattern live against a legacy desktop app. Including where it breaks and what a run costs.
descriptions.1787856601255001EaAa-1791588248645001CLe: Moving an agentic business application from an idea to production takes more than technology. It requires engaged users, practical feedback, shared standards, and a repeatable path from experimentation to business value. Learn how community programs can identify promising scenarios, connect builders and decision makers, and support the responsible scaling of agentic business applications.
descriptions.1787856601557001EBvm-1791588257788001CqO: Careers rarely grow through hard work alone. Often, an important opportunity began because someone offered advice, opened a door, made an introduction, provided honest feedback, or simply said, "You should go for it." Hear candid stories about the relationships that changed career trajectories and explore the roles mentorship, sponsorship, allyship, and community can play in professional growth. Leave with practical ideas for strengthening your network, finding mentors and sponsors, becoming a better ally, and creating opportunities for others.
descriptions.1791504961204001LIcR-1791926732429001WyP: Your customer bought Copilot. So why aren't they using it? They finished the training workshops, but then adoption stalls. Employees return to work, old habits take over, and reinforcement becomes difficult to sustain. Learn how partners are identifying what's blocking adoption and using AI to personalize support for every employee, at scale. Leave with the exact steps you can take to increase Copilot usage, reinforce new habits, and turn adoption support into a recurring services opportunity.
descriptions.1790726380494001T0Ry-1791926616522001MfF: Microsoft resets priorities every July 1, and AI is rewriting how customers buy. With 40 years in the ecosystem and 300+ conversations with partner leaders, Vince Menzione shares the 7 Operating Principles behind the partners Microsoft sellers reach for first: Growth Mindset, Executive Commitment, Vision and Value Alignment, Maniacal Focus, Brand and Story, Getting Results, and Adaptability. Leave ready to sharpen co-sell and Marketplace execution and turn FY27 changes into growth.
descriptions.1787856577619001E7og-1791814914803001CVj: Take your idea beyond a browser prototype and onto a phone. Native mobile development brings platform tooling, device behavior, and build failures that generated code alone cannot solve. Watch GitHub Copilot agents help implement features, run builds and tests, and fix failures as we move from an idea to an app running on a device. Learn how to give agents the context and tools to do the work, while you guide the experience and review the results.
descriptions.1787856593148001ELAZ-1791588327380001CaM: Your data records what happened, but rarely what it means to your business. In this session we take one real business scenario and build an ontology in Fabric IQ that captures its concepts, relationships and rules, then follow it through into data agents and Foundry. Leave able to model your own domain and give your agents the vocabulary your business actually uses.
descriptions.1787856598884001EQuZ-1791814914566001Cns: Deploying Copilot is only the beginning. Lasting adoption happens when people understand the value, build confidence, learn from one another, and discover new ways of working. Explore how champions, peer learning, storytelling, and community can turn initial experimentation into sustained adoption. Hear practical approaches for creating momentum, surfacing success stories, building confidence, and helping employees develop AI habits that last.
descriptions.1787856606849001Eyyj-1791588324460001CcX: Small businesses want outcomes, not setup. Join this session to see how Copilot plug-in packages bring pre-built skills, scenarios, and connections to key systems of record together in one turnkey experience. See demos focused on key outcomes—like month end accounting—to show how the right skills, integrations, and workflows light up instantly. We'll walk through the top SMB scenarios end to end, showing how to drive measurable outcomes. Leave this session ready to get work done with Copilot.
descriptions.1787856616021001ERrz-1791588337402001CGF: Getting ready for AI means getting ahead of security debt. As development accelerates, security teams need a better way to prioritize risk than severity scores alone. Learn how organizations identify the vulnerabilities, dependencies, and secrets most likely to matter, then drive remediation at scale through security campaigns and agentic autofix that help teams reduce backlogs and focus on what needs fixing.
descriptions.1787856616625001EWVs-1791814914100001CGC: Every codebase carries quality debt, and AI adds to it faster than teams can pay down. Performance issues inflate cloud cost, maintainability debt slows every future change, and reliability gaps surface as incidents. GitHub Code Quality catches these across new and existing code where developers work, recommends fixes, and gives engineering leaders governance to enforce standards. Agentic autofix then remediates findings at scale, turning backlogs into reviewable pull requests.
descriptions.1787856623271001Eb0f-1791814912680001CaG: Modern applications span cloud resources, identities, data, containers, and networks. Learn how Microsoft Defender and Azure Firewall and DDoS protection help uncover attack paths, detect runtime threats, and respond to multi-stage attacks.
descriptions.1787856629730001EVsw-1791588307796001C2w: Build AI agents on operational data and turn every interaction into insight with SQL database in Microsoft Fabric. See how native vectors, governed data access, MCP, and built-in mirroring to OneLake connect agentic applications with analytics on a shared data foundation.
descriptions.1787856633959001Ee8N-1791588117904001CT8: You invested in AI. Now it's time to maximize its value. Learn how Windows helps organizations drive AI adoption, improve productivity, support data sovereignty requirements, and get more from AI investments, including Microsoft Copilot.​
descriptions.1787856636701001ERm4-1791588336506001Cin: Cloud scale shouldn’t mean scaling toil. Discover how Azure SRE Agent helps operations teams move from reactive firefighting to proactive reliability. See how AI SRE agents investigate and resolve issues faster, automate operational workflows, and strengthen resilience across growing environments—giving engineers more time to improve platforms, ship new capabilities, and build what’s next.
descriptions.1787856655030001E5vx-1791588268236001CGJ: As AI moves from experimentation into everyday business operations, growing usage alone does not tell leaders whether an investment is working. Learn how organizations can connect AI consumption to measurable business value, establish the visibility and accountability needed to manage it, and determine whether the economics continue to hold as adoption grows. Leave with a practical approach for deciding where AI has earned the right to scale, where to adjust, and where continued investment may not be justified.

Explore advanced AI-powered administration and troubleshooting with TCH Insights in TAC Copilot, Custom RBAC, Remote Log Collection, Client Repair, and unified monitoring across meetings, calls, and rooms. Set up and administer Teams devices with Teams Device Management in the Pro Management Portal. Learn how these capabilities simplify day-to-day administration and help IT operate proactively at scale.

descriptions.1791404048974001d13C-1791930977477001a2w: You know how to build an agent in code. So what does Copilot Studio add? In this session, we’ll show how developers can bring familiar pro-code practices like GitHub repo-backed development and agentic editing to Copilot Studio's connectors, monitoring and no-code experience. Build what your org needs locally in Visual Studio or even a terminal, then hand off to business owners to maintain and manage in Copilot Studio. Come see how Copilot Studio can complement the way you already build!
descriptions.1787856581086001E9A0-1791814915525001CFI: Whether you’re an IT professional, security practitioner, or technology partner, discover how Microsoft and its partners are working together to advance driver quality, reduce kernel risk, and shape the future of a more reliable and resilient Windows platform and ecosystem.
descriptions.1787856591909001ER2j-1791588266230001Cfk: AI access is growing, even for non-developers—but access isn't adoption, and training without measurable goals often fails. Join this session to see how GitHub uses proficiency modeling, hands-on skilling, certifications, and learning pathways to drive real impact.
descriptions.1787856590477001Ea28-1791588181586001C9n: What if your next learning journey began with a question you were already asking at work? For Microsoft Copilot users and leaders, this session shows how Learning Agent uses personal and company context to recommend relevant learning from AI Skills Navigator and your organization. See how a real work need can become a clear next step toward lasting capability—right in the flow of work.
descriptions.1787856608132001E8GI-1791814917119001C1a:
In the AI era, trust is your organization's most important capability.
Join Microsoft Corporate Communications and product leaders to learn how Microsoft supports 200K+ employees through workplace transformation. Discover practical strategies to create clarity during change, build psychological safety, scale shared knowledge, and accelerate AI skills through leadership engagement, communities, Teams events, Copilot, and agents—and preview upcoming Viva Engage and Microsoft 365 innovations.
descriptions.1787856614544001E44o-1791588288436001CKa: You build software across more than one tool, and GitHub Copilot can meet you in each of them. See how Copilot supports the full development lifecycle across IDEs, the terminal, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and mobile devices. Follow work from planning and building through review, security, and release, choosing from multiple AI models along the way. Understand how Copilot connects these experiences to improve developer flow and help organizations deliver better software faster.
descriptions.1787856618898001EAOa-1791588268002001CvT: See how information workers and developers use Work IQ to power intelligent experiences across declarative agents, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and third-party platforms. Learn how Work IQ combines organizational context with connectors, agent-to-agent experiences, and external systems to create secure, personalized solutions grounded in your organization's knowledge, processes, and permissions.
descriptions.1787856620099001Ex57-1791814911505001Cti: Better context leads to better AI applications, but improvement requires more than trial and error. In this session, we'll build an evaluation loop for Microsoft IQ applications, using evaluations to compare retrieval configurations, context strategies, prompts, and models. Learn how to identify weak spots, measure the impact of changes, and systematically improve application quality. See how evaluations can transform context engineering from guesswork into an iterative, data-driven practice.
descriptions.1787856620252001EUUi-1791814916888001CTV: Join Microsoft and a customer to explore how Web IQ enables enterprise-grade AI agents grounded in the public web. Through a real-world customer experience, learn how Web IQ supports high-value business scenarios while meeting enterprise requirements for security, governance, quality, and scale. Hear directly from the customer about the business need, implementation journey, key learnings, and outcomes achieved with Web IQ.
descriptions.1787856623724001E2uS-1791814919196001Cab: See how Defender Security Research turns real-world attacks into coordinated protection. Learn how the unified security graph connects signals and threat intelligence to power detection, prevention, attack disruption and built-in agents.
descriptions.1787856624484001E5xH-1791588233652001Crh: AI agents can access data and automate work at unprecedented scale. Learn how Microsoft Purview helps discover agent activity, protect sensitive information, detect risk and meet compliance requirements for a growing landscape of AI agents.
descriptions.1787856626777001EA7r-1791814916661001CfY: See how Fabric Data Factory helps teams connect, transform, govern, and operationalize enterprise data for AI. Learn patterns for pipelines, Dataflows, Copy Jobs, Mirroring, OneLake integrations, data quality, and analytics engineering with dbt to deliver trusted data for copilots, agents, and analytics. Additionally, learn how to modernize your data estate by migrating Azure Data Factory workloads to Microsoft Fabric.
descriptions.1787856640669001EqlK-1791814917579001CtB: Learn how Azure Confidential VMs on the next-generation VR72 platform help organizations run frontier-scale AI workloads with hardware-backed protection for models, prompts, data, and infrastructure, enabling trusted AI innovation without compromising performance or scale.
descriptions.1787856644921001EHQp-1791814918034001CG4: What happens when IT, OT, and AI converge on the factory floor? Big River Steel and Sight Machine share how Azure-powered industrial AI transformed galvanizing operations by connecting process, quality, and business data into a closed-loop optimization system. Learn how industrial AI helped reduce process variability, improve operational efficiency, and deliver sustainable cost savings while maintaining product quality and customer commitments.
descriptions.1791404150314001eN1N-1791934911494001JBQ: AI innovation goes beyond models and GPUs. Enterprise value comes from the complete cloud system connecting compute, data, networking, storage, security, orchestration, and applications. This session follows an AI request across Azure to show how an open, connected infrastructure helps organizations build with Microsoft or their technology of choice and operate at enterprise scale.

You'll use Copilot in SharePoint to organize information, enrich content with metadata, create pages and reports, build reusable skills, and automate common processes. Along the way, you'll see how better-organized knowledge helps strengthen Copilot experiences across Microsoft 365. Leave with practical techniques you can apply immediately to build a modern, AI-powered knowledge workspace.

Learn how IT can drive usage by becoming a champion for change and showing employees how new tools help them work smarter and get more done.
descriptions.1787856607497001EUVD-1791588309408001Cb2: Organizations often evaluate AI through individual tools and models, but lasting transformation requires an AI operating system, not a patchwork of offerings. In this session, we’ll explore the layers of Frontier Transformation: Infrastructure, Data, Context and Knowledge, AI Platform, Build Tools, Productivity and Collaboration, and Security. You’ll see how these layers work together to enable enterprise AI at scale and gain a framework for evaluating AI platforms holistically.
descriptions.1787856609086001Ev89-1791588156050001C3d: As organizations extend Copilot, skills, connectors, MCP servers, tools, and agents can create fragmented catalogs, publishing paths, and controls. Learn how Microsoft’s plugin ecosystem brings these capabilities into a shared lifecycle, from building and importing to publishing, discovering, deploying, governing, evaluating, and maintaining them across supported Copilot experiences. See how the pieces relate and what the model means for users, IT, developers, and partners.
descriptions.1787856611856001EVuB-1791588235695001CGb: Bring AI closer to users, data, and decisions. This session shows developers how to build responsive, private, and resilient AI applications and agents on-device — running across Windows, macOS, Linux, and emerging mobile scenarios, without requiring a cloud connection for every inference.
descriptions.1787856614691001Eo5M-1791588310531001CNW: AI coding should not make you choose between delegating the work and staying close to the code. Follow a real task through GitHub Copilot in VS Code, from handing it off in the agents window to reviewing, editing, and debugging in the editor. See how familiar Claude and Codex workflows carry over while your files, terminal, extensions, and project context stay within reach. You will leave with a practical understanding of when to use each experience and how they work together.
descriptions.1787856620560001E6PE-1791814921993001CD2: The web can bring fresh knowledge to AI, but great grounding takes more than search. In this session, learn how to use Web IQ to retrieve relevant web information, generate grounded answers, and connect responses to supporting sources. We’ll cover the end-to-end architecture and show how latency, token usage, and traces help optimize experiences from prototype to production. Leave with practical patterns for agents, copilots, and AI apps.
descriptions.1787856623881001E2PK-1791814922666001CoK: Attackers don't need to steal your password to compromise your identity or account. See how AI-powered phishing, impersonation, compromised accounts, and identity-based attacks are changing the game, and how identity, email and collaboration security help defenders detect and disrupt threats before they spread.
descriptions.1787856625865001EIu7-1791588351167001CAb: As data grows and AI accelerates how quickly it’s accessed, shared, and used, organizations need a scalable way to protect sensitive information. Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels provide persistent protection and context that travels with your data. Learn how to build an effective labeling strategy and use auto-labeling to automate protection and prevent oversharing in Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions.
descriptions.1787856641125001Eql1-1791814921285001Cbj: As AI, regulatory, sovereignty, and edge requirements reshape application design, organizations need architectures that operate consistently across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. Discover Adaptive Apps, Microsoft’s approach for separating application intent from platform implementation using Azure Arc, Radius, and Kubernetes. Learn proven patterns for building portable, governable, and resilient applications that adapt to changing business, compliance, and technology needs.
descriptions.1787856655493001Eeqv-1791814922444001C4t: 本セッションでは、Microsoft Ignite で発表された主要なアナウンスと技術的インサイトを、日本からご参加の皆様に向けて日本語で凝縮して解説します。マイクロソフトのロードマップが、アーキテクチャ、セキュリティ、運用、データ、開発ワークフロー、そしてビジネス戦略に何をもたらすのか。本セッションにご参加いただくことで、すぐに実践に活かせる知見と、「何が変わり、なぜ重要で、自組織として次に何を検討すべきか」という社内共有に使える明確なストーリーを、あわせてお持ち帰りいただけます。 A focused recap of key Microsoft Ignite announcements and technical insights, delivered in Japanese.
descriptions.1787854993291001tORF-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.
descriptions.1787854993391001t8OJ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Microsoft 365 administration still means jumping between portals, reports, exports, and scripts. In 20 minutes, Microsoft MVP Richard Harbridge shows how AI agents and MCP can shorten that path. See agents investigate governance data, prioritize risk, generate evidence, and prepare action while keeping human approval, permissions, and accountability clear.
descriptions.1787854993498001t4wP-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Recurring tickets drain IT resources when teams already have more to support and secure. Learn why these issues persist and what leading organizations are doing to prevent them.
descriptions.1787854993607001tbOL-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: As AI, automation, and cloud services expand the identity surface, Microsoft Entra ID and Intune become even more critical to access and business continuity. Explore a practical identity resilience model built around change visibility, configuration control, targeted recovery, and continuity planning, and see how Backupta helps teams keep Microsoft identity operations dependable as environments become more dynamic.
descriptions.1787854993715001tzj2-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Enterprise data is scattered across SQL Server, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and other systems. Learn how to unify that data in OneLake, continuously extract and maintain context from operational data, and bring it into Fabric IQ so Copilot, AI agents, and Power BI can work across enterprise data without adding more pipelines, compute, storage, or data movement. The result is an AI-ready data foundation that makes enterprise context easier to access and put to work.
descriptions.1787854993817001tjNn-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Ensuring the manufacturing provenance of hardware is critical for customers to minimize financial losses, reputational damage, system downtime, and recovery delays caused by counterfeit‑related hardware risks. This video introduces Intel® Assured Supply Chain, a modern supply chain security solution that enhances transparency in semiconductor manufacturing by delivering a digitally attestable chain of custody for each chip.
descriptions.1787854993948001t97P-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Leaders across every industry highlight data leakage, privacy, compliance, and regulatory risk as top concerns. In this session, we'll talk about what sovereign AI really means and identify the blockers slowing down the adoption of sovereign AI.
descriptions.1787854994049001tpzL-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Most organizations have moved past asking whether AI delivers value. The challenge now is scaling it. Many have deployed AI platforms and piloted agents, but few have built the governance and digital foundations required for enterprise-wide transformation. Learn how to move from isolated AI wins to business-wide impact through agent governance, operating models, and responsible adoption practices. Leave with a practical framework for scaling AI across your organization.
descriptions.1787854994152001ttBQ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI is moving beyond individual assistance toward enterprise agents that work across teams, data, and systems. EY explores how organizations can select agents, govern data access, scale personal agents into enterprise assets, and balance speed, risk, and human accountability. Gain a practical view of the operating models, validation approaches, controls, and ways of working needed to move from copilots and experimentation to responsible, scalable AI agent ecosystems.
descriptions.1787854994356001t6LG-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Enterprises are adopting foundation models at an unprecedented pace, creating new challenges around governance, risk, cost, and model quality. This demo shows an automated evaluation and promotion framework built on Microsoft Foundry, using benchmark datasets, safety testing, and cost analysis to assess candidate models. Attendees will see how organizations can establish trusted baselines, automate decision-making, and deploy AI solutions with governance and operational controls at scale.
descriptions.1787854994461001tlTx-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Wires and sanctions holds run across systems, rules, and reviewers. Most AI agents can’t carry that work to a consistent outcome. See how enterprise AI can be grounded in trusted data, governed across complex workflows, and continuously evaluated at every step, using Kore.ai pre-built agents on Microsoft Azure.
descriptions.1787854994565001tAtp-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Explore Muse Spark Open's multimodal capabilities, available through the Hugging Face collection in Microsoft Foundry Models. With text, image, video, and audio inputs and a 1M-token context window, Meta's open-weight model can reason across what it sees, hears, and reads. Learn how developers can connect documents, screenshots, and recordings with code and tasks and combine multimodal understanding with tool calling in an agentic harness.
descriptions.1787854994671001tugJ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: What defines a Frontier Firm, and how does an organization become one? Explore a practical path from individual AI use to governed agents and redesigned workflows. Learn which activities matter, where Microsoft 365 E7 fits, and how SoftwareOne services support readiness, adoption, security, and ongoing operations. Leave with a framework to choose your next steps.
descriptions.1787854994774001tUF2-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Every organization is adopting AI, but what does it take to become truly AI-native? Discover a practical blueprint for moving from early experimentation to operational transformation with Atlassian Rovo. Learn how leading teams evolved from manual processes to deploying AI agents that run in the background, surface critical insights, and power everyday workflows across delivery, operations, and knowledge management.
descriptions.1787854994879001tpEZ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: When delivery routes exceed truck capacity, planners make rapid decisions that affect cost, service levels, and operational efficiency. EPAM and Ahold Delhaize share how they captured expert planner knowledge and turned it into an AI-powered decision-support solution built on Microsoft AI. Learn how AI, real-time optimization, and human-in-the-loop decision making reduced standby truck usage, improved route utilization, and created a foundation for intelligent supply chain operations.
descriptions.1787854994981001tryh-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Enterprise migrations fail when infrastructure, application, and database workstreams run separately. Each team handoff is a potential failure point. Concierto's unified AI platform assesses, migrates, and modernizes all three layers together in a single coordinated execution, from any source to Azure. One assessment pass covers your entire estate. One platform takes it to completion - in weeks, not the several months that fragmented approaches routinely take.
descriptions.1787854995084001tI3n-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI, evolving security threats, workforce expectations, and greater IT complexity change what enterprises need from technology. In this on-demand session, Brian Madden explores what it means to become an adaptive enterprise and how Citrix helps organizations respond to change with greater agility, resilience, and control while they provide secure, high-performance work experiences across complex environments.
descriptions.1787854995185001tU8a-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI mistakes are happening. Learn three key things to help you confidently scale AI with Microsoft 365 and Veeam. See what AI can actually reach, clean up what it shouldn't, and keep the whole estate recoverable if needed. You'll leave with three checks to run before your next AI rollout.
descriptions.1787854995289001tFZ8-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA:
When Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams go down together, most IT teams have backup, but no plan for what comes back first. Rubrik heard this everywhere, including from Simpson Strong-Tie: nobody had defined critical people in advance, so recovery got improvised, costing days.
In this fireside, Varun Grover and Mohammad Akram cover Autonomous Business Recovery: restoring the Minimum Viable Company first. Recovery that took 7-10 days now lands under 3 hours.
descriptions.1787854995397001trHv-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Learn what to consider when building a Linux environment that can stay secure, consistent, and manageable across your enterprise. Explore four key areas: silicon and cloud compatibility, ecosystem support, codebase consistency, and security and compliance. See how Ubuntu and Landscape put these principles into practice with fleet management and automation, plus integration with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
descriptions.1787854995527001tUOc-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Modernizing mission-critical systems is complex, but delaying change can increase risk. Join Kyndryl and Microsoft to explore how agentic AI can accelerate modernization across complex application estates while maintaining governance, resiliency, and control. Learn how AI-powered insights help assess workloads, prioritize opportunities, reduce complexity, and speed transformation. Discover practical approaches that deliver measurable business value and support an AI-ready future.
descriptions.1787854995639001tN7M-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Think migrating Oracle AI Database from an on-premises environment to Azure is complex and risky? Think again. Discover a proven framework that takes the guesswork out of migration. See how Oracle Zero Downtime Migration minimizes disruption, and how programs like Microsoft Cloud Accelerate Factory provide deployment assistance and architecture guidance from Azure experts. Gain the tools, expertise, and confidence to plan and execute a smooth migration to Oracle AI Database@Azure.
descriptions.1787854995743001tVop-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Zero Trust verifies your laptops and servers, but what happens when an AI agent reads, classifies, and routes every document moving through your print and scan environment? Corey Ercanbrack, CTO of Vasion, runs a live audit: agent identity against verify explicitly, folder scope against least privilege, and a hidden prompt inside a real document against assume breach. Walk out with three questions to take back to your own security team.
descriptions.1787854995846001tRLT-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Getting value from Copilot goes beyond licensing. Adoption efforts can rely on guesswork, and requests for more tokens can be inconsistent and ungoverned. This session tackles both challenges. Organizations that succeed with Copilot run targeted adoption campaigns and turn requests for additional AI budget into a governed cycle tied to stated business needs. Join this session to learn how to turn your Copilot investment into ROI you can prove.
descriptions.1787854996044001tae4-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI-era threats don’t wait for Windows to load, so endpoint security can’t either. Discover ASUS ExpertGuardian, the enterprise-grade, multi-layer security architecture built into ASUS ExpertBook business PCs. See how a physically isolated Security Processor Unit, self-healing BIOS Recovery, chassis intrusion detection, NIST SP 800-193-aligned resilience, post-quantum cryptography, and UEFI-level media sanitization help keep your fleet protected, compliant, and future-ready.
descriptions.1787854996247001tt0T-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Licensing changes and rising costs in legacy virtualization are prompting infrastructure teams to rethink where workloads run. See how Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) on Azure extends the Nutanix software stack to Azure BareMetal Infrastructure. Learn how to migrate VMware workloads to Azure while preserving familiar tools, skills, and operating practices and minimizing the disruption of adopting a new stack.
descriptions.1787854996349001tiUR-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: As enterprises navigate the next phase of digital transformation, artificial intelligence serves as an important enabler of productivity, agility, and employee experience. In this leadership conversation, Jared Spataro of Microsoft and Shishank Gupta of Infosys share insights on the digital workplace and how enterprises can prepare for a more intelligent, connected future of work.
descriptions.1787854996559001tZeQ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Discover how HPE ProLiant Compute Premier Solutions for Azure Local simplify hybrid cloud with pre-integrated infrastructure, Azure integration, and enterprise-ready performance. Learn how these solutions help organizations modernize, scale, and deploy from edge to cloud.
descriptions.1787854996771001tViV-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI is transforming ITSM. See how Azure AI Language and Azure AI Foundry, with deep, native integrations across Microsoft Teams, Intune, and Office 365, can help automate ticket triage, resolve requests faster, and unify service management across applications. See these capabilities in action with TeamDynamix through a no-code platform built for power without complexity and low admin overhead. Walk away with a practical, real-world blueprint for modernizing ITSM in your organization.
descriptions.1787854996873001tCNY-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI has accelerated enterprise change, but validation remains manual and slow. As remediation timelines shrink from days to hours, IT teams can face a difficult choice: delay critical updates or deploy without proof. See how Microsoft’s agent platform enables continuous, autonomous validation with governed identity, audit-ready evidence, and human approval at every critical step through a demonstration from WorkspaceDNA CTO Samit Halvadia.
descriptions.1787854996972001tKbw-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AIOps has moved past the demo stage and into real on-call rotations, but its effectiveness sits somewhere between the hype and the skepticism. This talk is a field report from running LLM-driven remediation in production: what it fixed, what it broke, and where automation has to stop and human judgment has to take over.
descriptions.1787854997100001tuBm-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: An Autopilot enrollment is a black box: it either finishes, or it doesn't. Reconstructing what happened from logs on a wiped device can be difficult. See how Autopilot Monitor tracks enrollments live with 200+ signals per session, event timelines, automatic diagnostics, failure analytics, and fleet health. Through live demos, explore how companies and MSPs can investigate enrollment issues and query telemetry using an AI assistant over MCP.
descriptions.1787854997202001thw1-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Business mergers, acquisitions, and modernization demand speed and accuracy. Identity expert Conrad Murray demonstrates how PowerSyncPro automates AD synchronization and enables workstation migrations while preserving user profiles, apps, and identities. See the solution in action and learn how to simplify identity and device migrations while minimizing disruption.
descriptions.1787854997306001tVjZ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Managing AI initiatives while navigating the potential risks to your cyber resilience? You aren’t alone. Agentic and generative AI are multiplying the number of non-human identities (NHIs), secrets, and access paths in your environment. Explore how these shifts are changing the risk profile of Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta, and what IT and cybersecurity teams can do now to stay ahead of AI-related threats.
descriptions.1787854997411001tf0W-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and shrinking the time IT teams have to respond. Can your ITOps team keep pace without sacrificing governance, security, or control? Explore why endpoint management is critical in the AI era, where automation can introduce risk, and how policy-driven operations can help your team move from reactive work to proactive endpoint readiness. See how Automox approaches Frontier Pace Governance to help IT move quickly while maintaining control.
descriptions.1787854997515001tgUL-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Coding agents have transformed how software gets written. Bringing that same impact to infrastructure operations is harder: context is scattered across tools, systems are live, and actions can affect production. Explore those challenges and see how Plural addresses them with hosted agents, connected infrastructure, and configurable permissions. Through practical examples, learn how to configure agents to investigate issues, gather evidence, and reduce manual effort.
descriptions.1787854997832001trvH-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA:
AI is changing enterprise communications, but the real opportunity comes when conversations connect to the wider business.
More insight. More efficiency. Better customer experiences.
In this session, we share three real-world examples showing how voice, conversational intelligence, workflows, and AI can improve customer experiences, automate processes, unlock actionable insights and deliver more value from your Microsoft 365 investment. Experience practical examples of what’s possible.
descriptions.1787854998034001tkVl-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: One platform. Every contact. Every calendar. Every device. This live virtual demo shows how CiraSync keeps contacts and calendars connected across Microsoft 365 and employee endpoints, automatically, securely, and at enterprise scale. See how CiraSync takes manual updates and duplicate data entry off IT Teams plate, saving hours of support tickets every month while giving them one less thing to manage.
descriptions.1787854998237001tt8n-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: See how a privileged access management solution delivers the security depth large organizations demand while being designed around the people who actually run IT. Watch it in action and learn how it can simplify privileged access management for your IT teams.
descriptions.1787854998441001tvm1-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI answers are only as trustworthy as the knowledge they draw from. See how getAbstract curates and verifies knowledge across industries and job roles, then brings that knowledge into Microsoft Copilot. Explore how organizations can provide role- and sector-relevant knowledge for areas such as consulting, regulatory compliance, and financial services to help users get more grounded, trusted answers.
descriptions.1787854998542001tVSU-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Microsoft ADCS is a proven foundation, but CA sprawl, shorter certificate lifetimes, AI and post-quantum security are increasing operational pressure. Learn how Entrust helps simplify and govern ADCS environments, strengthen lifecycle management, protect critical CA keys with crypto-agile nShield HSMs, and preserve Microsoft investments while building a more resilient, post-quantum-ready PKI.
descriptions.1787854998664001tRwZ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: As organizations rely more on Microsoft 365, identity is essential to business continuity. Access to email, applications, devices, collaboration, and administration depends on Microsoft Entra ID, while many organizations still operate Active Directory and hybrid identity environments. Learn where recovery gaps emerge, how administrative and synchronization failures disrupt operations, what Microsoft’s native capabilities address, and how to build a more resilient identity recovery strategy.
descriptions.1787854998771001t7OQ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Employees paste customer records, source code, and financial data into AI tools every day, often without security visibility. Learn how to protect sensitive data across an AI-enabled workforce using data classification, DLP, and DSPM, supported by identity, endpoint, and Zero Trust controls. Through a real deployment, we cover data labeling, Copilot prompt governance, and Shadow AI risk mitigation, leaving you with an L300 blueprint and actionable next steps.
descriptions.1787854999002001tAbJ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Modernize your SAP estate with an ontology-driven intelligence layer that connects transactional data with Microsoft IQ and Microsoft Foundry. Explore how unified business ontologies connect core enterprise entities to support insights across supply chain, inventory, assets, and plant operations. Through customer case studies and demos, learn how AI systems help organizations move from reactive analytics toward proactive, automated decision processes.
descriptions.1787854999208001tVly-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Every Intune admin knows the drill: download an installer, hunt for the silent switch, write a detection rule, test it, and start over when a vendor ships an update. In this demo, Microsoft MVP Maxime Guillemin shows how an AI-powered workflow handles package creation, detection logic, validation, and built-in security checks, turning a raw installer into a validated, Intune-ready package. The result: less time spent on repetitive packaging work and a faster path from update to deployment.
descriptions.1787854999410001tytV-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA:
You run Microsoft DNS and DHCP. You also run everything else. That fragmentation leaves network and security teams with an incomplete view of what is on the network.
This demo-led session shows how EfficientIP overlays Microsoft, Azure, and third-party DNS, adds IPAM and asset discovery, and builds one authoritative network view. See how that intelligence feeds network and security workflows to strengthen governance, reduce risk, and accelerate anomaly investigation.
descriptions.1787854999619001t25A-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: LLMs are great at drafting but not designed for repeatable output. When AI generates a contract or invoice, consistency matters. See how Doctavian uses MCP to interpret intent, render deterministic output, and add eIDAS-compliant digital signatures and audit trails. Learn a practical approach to building consistent, compliant agent-driven document workflows in Microsoft 365 and beyond.
descriptions.1787854999722001t6Kw-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Migrating to or expanding use of Microsoft Teams is only the beginning. Learn how to move from one-time migrations to governed collaboration operations at scale. See how to unify readiness assessment, validated planning, and governed provisioning across hybrid environments with Akkadian Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform. Use drift detection and event-driven orchestration to help reduce risk, cut manual effort, and maintain auditable control.
descriptions.1787855000037001tICI-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI has become remarkably capable at analysis, correlation, recommendation, and prediction. Yet the closer AI gets to decisions with real operational consequences, the more administrators insist on human authority in the final dispatch. Using 2026 survey data from more than 1,000 sysadmins, this session examines where that boundary exists, why it persists, and what it tells us about the future of autonomous IT.
descriptions.1787855000261001tlg8-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Securing AI infrastructure on Azure requires consistent visibility and control. In this demonstration, see how customers can gain visibility into the AI applications running in their Azure environment. Explore transitioning from discovery to enforcement using Palo Alto Networks' firewall portfolio to apply consistent, AI-powered security policies.
descriptions.1787855000371001tnjj-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Many organizations have piloted AI and deployed copilots, but scaling across the enterprise requires production-grade governance. This session shares frameworks for moving from experimentation to measurable impact: governance models, LLMOps/AgentOps, risk management, and human oversight. Attendees leave with practical guidance for turning AI investments into repeatable business outcomes.
descriptions.1787855000495001tDk4-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Complex companies live and die by how fast they can turn a pricing decision into a quote a buyer can act on. When pricing and quoting operate separately from CRM, handoffs can add delays and slow deals. See how Conga�s pricing and CPQ solutions work within Microsoft Dynamics 365 to bring intelligent, guided selling into the sales workflow, helping teams make informed pricing and margin decisions and move from pricing to quote more efficiently.
descriptions.1787855000824001tgmf-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Identifying eligible customers, qualifying opportunities, estimating Azure growth, and managing incentives from nomination through claim approval can be complex. See how SDC, ISV, and services partners can navigate Microsoft’s Frontier Accelerate incentives with experts from TPM. Learn how partner-led models work, how Microsoft connects incentives to customer ACR, and what to know about eligibility, customer qualification, governance, and proof of execution.
descriptions.1787855000923001tdVj-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI companies can experience rapid growth that places new demands on in-memory data infrastructure, from thread bottlenecks and resharding to tail latency and backup memory use. Explore how two teams address these challenges. Hugging Face split its Redis setup as the Hub reached 3 million models, then adopted Dragonfly to simplify operations. Instacart replaced 348 ElastiCache nodes with 100 Dragonfly nodes and reduced average and P99 latency by 40–50%, with no customer impact.
descriptions.1787855001132001tlwL-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: We built a database in .NET and pushed the runtime to its limits. In this session, we’ll dissect the engineering decisions we made, extracting hard-won lessons you can use to build truly high-performance software. Expect battle-tested techniques you can apply to any demanding .NET service, even if it’s not a database. Explore JSON & Beyond, The Memory Game, Taming the State Machine, Beyond Cache Line, and more.
descriptions.1787855001233001txnt-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Discover how to connect Microsoft 365, Microsoft Places, and Copilot to the built environment with Eptura. In this technical session, explore the architecture, data, and orchestration that turn digital context into physical workplace action. Learn how to coordinate people, buildings, rooms, desks, visitors, assets, and services through one connected experience.
descriptions.1787855001334001tNIt-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Enterprises often treat migration and governance as separate phases by moving data first and then planning to clean up permissions and compliance gaps once the dust settles. When that cleanup doesn't happen on schedule, the gap becomes a growing liability the moment AI agents and Copilot start touching that same ungoverned data. Explore how to approach migration and governance as one project and build governance into your Microsoft 365 migration from the start.
descriptions.1787855001449001tSik-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Microsoft Teams plays an important role in how organizations communicate and collaborate, which makes private chat history an important consideration for Microsoft 365 migrations. The Teams Private Chat Migration capability in MigrationWiz helps organizations migrate private chat history as part of a tenant-to-tenant migration.
descriptions.1787855001552001tlwl-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Explore the evolution from traditional MDR to an agentic SOC through three simulated security incidents of increasing severity. Learn how machine-speed investigation and response, combined with security context, pre-authorized actions, and granular governance, enable faster threat containment without sacrificing control. Gain practical guidance for evaluating modern security providers based on speed, decision quality, policy integration, and auditability.
descriptions.1787855001654001tdIb-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Identity systems are prime targets for ransomware and AI-driven attacks, making recovery planning an essential part of cyber resilience. Explore what organizations should consider protecting across Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, app registrations, and Conditional Access policies. Learn how backup and recovery strategies can complement Microsoft’s identity capabilities, help organizations prepare for compromised accounts, accidental deletions, and misconfigurations, and reduce recovery
descriptions.1787855001996001tfdP-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Learn how to move beyond periodic reviews and manual updates. See how continuous intelligence and agent-led workflows strengthen risk coverage, reduce operational costs, and build regulatory confidence within your existing tech stack.
descriptions.1787855002205001thge-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Modernizing identity, cloud, and virtual desktops is only part of the journey. Legacy installers, packaging backlogs, and slow application delivery can still stand in the way. See how appCURE works with Microsoft technologies to turn legacy and new applications into clean MSIX packages, then deliver and manage them at runtime. Learn how Microsoft Entra and appCURE work together to help organizations modernize application access and delivery.
descriptions.1787855002308001tHeP-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: As AI works across enterprise data, understanding emerging security risks is essential to using it with confidence. Explore three vulnerabilities identified by Varonis Threat Labs: Reprompt, SearchLeak, and CoSnitch, all responsibly disclosed and fixed in collaboration with Microsoft. Learn from this research and explore practical steps organizations can take to strengthen security as they adopt Microsoft Copilot.
descriptions.1787855002818001tZ3T-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: The challenge with Microsoft 365 Copilot isn't understanding what it can do—it's knowing where it can create real business value and being ready to scale it. Join New Charter to explore a practical approach to identifying use cases, preparing your data and governance, and driving adoption. We'll share real-world lessons and introduce our Wayfinder approach for moving from AI experimentation to measurable outcomes.
descriptions.1787855002921001twpp-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: .NET 8 and .NET 9 reach Microsoft end of support on the same day, November 10, 2026. Learn what this transition means for security, compliance, and cyber insurance considerations. This session covers why the shared deadline matters for mixed .NET 8 and .NET 9 environments, what changes after support ends, how auditors and insurers assess unsupported software, and how to evaluate applications for migration to .NET 10 or continued security support.
descriptions.1787855003025001t10i-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: An AI agent can stay within every permission, touch only allowed data, pass every security check and still potentially cause harm. Cut through the noise around agentic guardrails and governance with two anchors: Can vs. Should, which asks whether an agent’s next action makes sense beyond permission; and Point-in-Time vs. the Chain, which shows how risk can emerge across a sequence of individually reasonable actions. Learn how to question governance claims and build more effective controls.
descriptions.1787855003332001txao-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Watch Neat CEO Javed Khan and Ilya Bukshteyn, Corporate VP of Microsoft Teams Calling, Meetings, and Devices, discuss the evolution of intelligent collaboration spaces, modern IT management, and how Neat and Microsoft work together to support shared customers and their Microsoft Teams Rooms investments.
descriptions.1787855003451001tiC6-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Join Foxit's Lisa Caudillo and Connor Porter to see how employees can use AI on their documents while IT stays in control. Learn the three ways Foxit AI Assistant runs: cloud models including Azure OpenAI from Microsoft Foundry, on-device models from Microsoft Foundry, or your own endpoint. See AI Workspace turn Microsoft 365 content into finished work. Then watch Foxit roll out with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Purview.
descriptions.1787855003555001tDBt-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Walk through a full demo of Yealink MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro. With straightforward deployment, these devices can seamlessly transform your meeting spaces and boost collaboration efficiency. See the MeetingBar A50 and MeetingBoard Pro in action and explore their capabilities firsthand.
descriptions.1787855004002001tJ5g-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Bring autonomous engineering into your existing Microsoft environment with BuildEngine by Eido. Use Microsoft Foundry to access models from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and others while keeping execution, governance, and control inside your Azure tenant. See agents tackle real engineering tasks with Windows 365 for Agents and existing Intune policies, with human approval gates, audit history, model choice, and cost controls.
descriptions.1787855004210001tbfZ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Building AI agents is easy. Keeping them accurate, cost-efficient, governed, reliable, and secure in production is the hard part. As AI multiplies code volume, engineering teams face "agent sprawl" and technical debt. Learn how to transform your SDLC into a self-improving software factory, with real-world examples for private agent evaluations, governance, and cost management, regardless of the coding agent harness.
descriptions.1787855004312001txXJ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Client conversations can take place across mobile messaging channels. See how employees can communicate with WhatsApp clients from Microsoft Teams while conversations are captured and retained for governance and audit purposes. Explore how these records can support the use of agents in client communications.
descriptions.1787855004413001tmPJ-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: See how AI agents, human review, and business systems work together in an accountable workflow. Follow a customer inquiry from information review through human decision points to response preparation, and explore the platform that supports the application, data, identity, and operational visibility across the process.
descriptions.1787855004513001tYUT-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Synthesize and store context scattered across tools—like past decisions, judgements, and learnings—to build a living memory. As an always-on curation engine, Stack Internal resolves stale, conflicting, and missing information in real-time, eliminating manual documentation and costly knowledge loss. Verified knowledge is mapped to role-based permissions and domain-specific scopes, and surfaced where the work is happening.
descriptions.1787855004613001t51l-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: AI agents are moving from copilots to autonomous action. But agents need trusted enterprise context to reason, decide, and act with confidence. Learn how Reltio, an SAP company, puts trusted data and business context to work for agentic AI, turning fragmented information into grounded intelligence that helps AI agents deliver real business outcomes.
descriptions.1787855004926001tI3n-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Frontier Firms emerge when AI becomes part of governed business and technology operations. Reaching this point requires trusted data, production-ready platforms, clear controls, and teams ready to adapt. Improving shares practical patterns across Azure AI landing zones, Microsoft Fabric data foundations, agent development, GitHub Copilot adoption, governance, and workforce enablement. Explore the next phase of enterprise AI and the operating changes required to support it.
descriptions.1787855005049001toJp-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA: Managing AI risk requires connecting governance, compliance, exposure management, and security operations. Learn how to protect agents, identities, data, endpoints, and infrastructure while maintaining human accountability. See how CyberMSI AI Trust, built on Microsoft’s Unified Security Operations platform, combines AI-driven protection, 24x7 MDR, and analyst-on-the-loop oversight to help organizations manage AI risk.
